CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned on Tuesday that hackers are now exploiting a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks vulnerability in attacks.
Cisco BroadWorks is a cloud unified communications (UC) software platform and the underlying engine allowing telecom carriers and managed service providers (MSPs) to provide branded cloud PBX, voice, and collaboration services to business customers.
Tracked as CVE-2026-20320, the security flaw stems from an improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) reference weakness in the Open Client Interface (OCI) XML Parser that can allow unauthenticated, remote attackers to read sensitive configuration information from vulnerable systems by sending maliciously crafted XML messages.
"This vulnerability exists because XML entries are improperly parsed due to external entity resolution being allowed by default. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted XML message to the Open Client Interface - Provisioning (OCI-P) service," Cisco explained when it patched the bug in August.
CISA flagged CVE-2026-20320 as actively exploited and added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog on Tuesday, ordering Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies to secure their systems within two weeks, by November 24, as mandated by Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04.
Although BOD 26-04 targets only federal agencies, CISA urged all security teams, including those in the private sector, to prioritize patches for this vulnerability to defend their networks against ongoing attacks.
"These types of vulnerabilities are a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise," it warned. "While BOD 26-04 applies only to FCEB agencies, CISA encourages all organizations to adopt risk-based vulnerability management and prioritize remediation of KEV Catalog vulnerabilities."
While CISA didn't share more details on attackers exploiting CVE-2026-20320 in the wild, threat intelligence firm Malbear Labs said over the weekend that a Chinese-speaking threat actor has exploited the flaw with the help of a jailbroken DeepSeek Flash artificial intelligence model in attacks targeting a European telecommunications provider and thirteen organizations that used its data centers and cloud infrastructure.
The attack focused on the telecom provider's BroadWorks XSP (eXtended Services Platform), and Malbear Labs found that the BroadWorks Provisioning Server (which stores subscriber configuration for all users) was also exposed via an unauthenticated directory listing.
"The agent exploited CVE-2026-20320, an unauthenticated XXE in the BroadWorks OCI XML parser. A crafted OCI request to port 2208 causes the XML parser to read arbitrary files from the server filesystem and no prior authentication required," Malbear Labs said.
"From the XSP host, the agent recovered the system identity private key, three SSL credential sets, and three additional private keys with certificate matches confirmed. The system identity key is used by the BroadWorks platform to authenticate between its own components; possessing it allows impersonation of the XSP in inter-component communication."
Since November 2021, CISA has added 103 Cisco vulnerabilities to its list of actively exploited flaws, seven of which have also been abused by ransomware gangs.

2025年11月26日香港大埔宏福苑大樓發生大火，造成168人死亡。（中央社檔案照片）
（中央社台北11日電）11月26日是香港大埔宏福苑大火1週年，能否在宏福苑現場及教會等場所舉辦悼念活動受到關注。近日有神父談及當天會舉行彌撒後表示，有自稱警察的「朋友」到教堂「關心」彌撒詳情。香港保安局局長鄧炳強此前被問到如何確保市民能自由哀悼時表示，只要依法辦事，當局必定協助。
去年11月26日香港宏福苑發生大火，造成168人死亡。綜合明報等港媒近日報導，天主教香港教區大埔聖母無玷之心堂原定15日下午舉行追思彌撒，悼念宏福苑死難者，但相關貼文在社交媒體刊出後不久被刪去。該堂10日改為宣布，15日將舉行「為全年已亡的兄弟姊妹祈禱」彌撒。
此外，灣仔天主教聖母聖衣堂26日會舉行彌撒，該堂主任司鐸羅國輝神父昨天早上在電台節目表示，11月是天主教「煉靈月」，每年均會舉行彌撒為亡者祈禱。至於會否加入宏福苑作彌撒主題，他稱若有人為此事祈禱就會祈禱，「不需要加，不需要減」，強調是為所有人祈禱。
明報記者昨天下午致電羅國輝，他表示，昨午有3名自稱警察的「朋友」前來教堂「關心」他，查詢當日彌撒詳情，包括預計多少人參加；他說對方「沒用權力威嚇」。
羅國輝並稱，「民間是民間的事，宗教是宗教的事，不可干預宗教正常生活」。
香港天主教會轄下的天主教區全人發展委員會昨天表示，11月是煉靈月，今天起會每星期紀念在災難中逝去的生命，「在盼望修和的同時，仍堅持追尋真相與公義」。
據明報及有線新聞5日報導，香港保安局局長鄧炳強被問及有關宏福苑的悼念安排，如何確保市民能自由哀悼時表示，非常理解很多死者家人及朋友想在這日子悼念，「任何這些行為，只要根據法律處理，我們都會盡量促進。我相信依法辦事的話，我們一定會協助」。（編輯：陳鎧妤/朱建陵）1151111

content:
民主党横扫参众两院，特朗普沦为“跛脚鸭”？图像来源: Mandel Ngan/AFP
德国之声：中国对美国中期选举结果反应谨慎。外交部发言人毛宁在例行记者会上被问及对美国中期选举的看法时表示，中期选举是美国内政。中方愿继续同美方一道，维护好落实好两国元首重要共识。您怎么看这样的表态？
费多丽教授：首先，中国评价美国选举结果态度审慎是非常典型的做法。他们通常不会明确表达倾向，而是往往以“这是内政”作为回应。不过，“中方愿继续同美方一道，维护好落实好两国元首重要共识”这种措辞显示，中方预料到，外界可能会认为中国对选举结果会不那么满意，因为他们刚刚才和特朗普达成了安排。换句话说，他们认为民主党人，或者很多人认为民主党人，现在会采取更进一步的行动。因此中方强调，“我们仍然愿意合作。”
德国之声：中国看来有些担心中期选举的这一结果可能会对中美关系产生一些影响。那么您认为影响会有多大？
费多丽教授：根据近年来的经验，中国政府担心民主党人对华的态度会比特朗普更具批判性。特朗普被指折服于习近平的领导才能，在这一层面上建立了不一样的关系，因此在处理对华关系方面对抗性有所降低。但必须指出的是，美国在特朗普执政期间也对中国实施了制裁措施。虽然他们今年还没有向台湾交付武器，但也并没有真正对中国采取友好，或者和解的态度。情况非常复杂。可以说，过去这些年，无论谁入主白宫，在对华问题上都相对一致。拜登并没有完全推翻特朗普第一任期对华政策，特朗普也没有推翻拜登的做法。当然，他们的优先事项不同，处理方式也截然不同。但从根本上讲，共和党人和民主党人都认为中国是主要挑战，需要采取战略性应对措施。
德国之声：具体而言，中期选举后，美国在外交、贸易和关税政策上可能有不同的做法吗？
费多丽教授：就外交政策，包括贸易政策和关税政策而言，现任总统很明显不怎么遵循国会的建议。因此，我们不知道，民主党主导国会后，是否真的有能力通过国会正常的、合法的、既定的程序来阻止特朗普在这些领域采取独立行动。或许可以提起诉讼，但这需要时间。所以，目前情况很复杂。这不仅关系对华政策。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
观察人士认为，民主党可能会试图对白宫施加更大的压力。但实际上——正如有人所说——特朗普现在这个所谓的“跛脚鸭”，在接下来的两年内，也可能变成一只愤怒的鸭子，想要强行推进某些事情。因此，我们对接下来会怎样其实一无所知。我们可以看看月底的APEC峰会上发生什么。我相信习近平和特朗普的会晤仍将按计划举行。或许我们能从中窥见事态的发展方向。我认为我们不会立即看到巨大的变化，短期内美国的对华政策不会有大的变化。
费多丽教授：我不是台湾问题专家，但如果我理解没错的话，在特朗普执政期间，原计划今年运往台湾的武器已被暂停。理论上讲，可以想象民主党人会更加努力地推动对这批武器的交付。但努力归努力，最终是否能促成此事就完全是另一回事了。
德国之声：您能简单总结一下特朗普执政两年来，中美的地位和力量对比发生什么变化吗？
费多丽教授：中国的确也受了特朗普政府制裁的打击，但我认为，目前最关键的是，世界其他地区，尤其是全球南方国家，认为特朗普政府在各种领域的政策都难以预测，很难知道特朗普政府下一步会做什么，想要什么，以及它的声明有多可靠。这包括贸易战，但也延伸到伊朗战争和类似问题。特朗普政府的这种等级森严且难以预测性，导致了中国形象和实力的普遍提升。但与此同时，也有另外一种趋势。在欧洲，我们也感受到了在美国蔓延的对中国的恐惧。这种恐惧正在欧洲日益扩散。
不过，如果我们暂时忽略这些因素，只关注特朗普及其政府在国际政治中的行为，那么中国无疑已经从中受益，中国在世界上的地位似乎得到了加强。
至于特朗普对中国的经济政策，中国现任领导层可以把功劳归于自己，说我们对特朗普的反应是正确的，我们挺身对抗他，展现了实力，事实证明这很有效，正因为如此，特朗普现在才相对放过了我们。有些人从心理层面分析，认为特朗普确实喜欢强人，所以他才会在某种程度上欣赏中国。不过，涉及实际的贸易冲突、安全冲突、信息和虚假信息问题等等，中国也并非完全占据上风。大家都在摸索，试图找到解决这些冲突的方法。
此外，中国经济目前面临着诸多问题，包括一些需求方面的问题。近期股市的疲软也被解读为对人工智能能力缺乏信心。中国经济目前似乎正处于低迷状态，但这种情况我们现在在美国也看到了。但这些问题并非主要由中美双边关系决定，中国目前面临的困境也并非出口市场之类的问题，而是与中国的经济政策、政策的实施方式以及优先事项的设定密切相关。
德国维尔茨堡大学费多丽教授（Dr. Doris Fischer）图像来源: Uni Würzburg
德国之声：美国对中国商品，比如电动汽车等商品进口有很多限制，这样的趋势还会继续吗？
费多丽教授：我不认为国会会向白宫施压，要求对中国实施更多贸易限制，至少不会以太多商品从中国流入美国为由。如果真有什么动向，那也只会是出于安全方面的考虑。但我认为他们不会把这作为首要任务。民主党首先需要理顺内部事务，弄清楚如何应对这种新局面，如何稳定现在这股浪潮，从而在两年后再次赢得总统大选。而且国会现在是否真的拥有影响力并能带来巨大变革，比如在关税政策方面，我对此表示怀疑。如果主要目的是抑制通货膨胀，他们也许会说，或许我们应该降低关税。但通货膨胀当然也很大程度上受能源价格的影响，而关税对能源价格没有影响。所以情况很复杂。我预计民主党人需要一些时间来站稳脚跟，适应他们的新角色。

title: China's foreign minister says call with Rubio was 'positive and constructive'

summary: 中国外交部长表示与卢比奥的通话是“积极和建设性的” - 日经亚洲 中国外交部长表示与卢比奥的通话是“积极和建设性的” 会谈将在特朗普可能会见习近平和普京的活动举行前一周进行据中国官方通讯社新华社报道，美国国务卿卢比奥周三与北京表示愿意加强沟通与合作

中国外交部长表示与卢比奥的通话是“积极和建设性的” - 日经亚洲
中国外长表示与卢比奥的通话是“积极和建设性的”
会谈将在特朗普可能会见习近平和普京的活动举行前一周进行
美国国务卿马可·卢比奥 © 路透社
2026 年 11 月 12 日 03:40 日本标准时间
北京/华盛顿（路透社）——据中国官方通讯社新华社报道，中国外交部长王毅周三与美国国务卿卢比奥进行了“积极和建设性”的通话，北京表示愿意与华盛顿加强沟通与合作。
这次会谈大约在亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议在中国深圳举行之前一周举行，预计习近平主席和唐纳德·特朗普总统将在会上举行会议。
王毅表示，当前中美关系的稳定来之不易，这是“两个大国基于各自和共同利益作出的理性选择”。
美国国务院没有立即公布这一电话内容。
习近平和特朗普今年已经会面两次，卢比奥周二告诉记者，正在安排在亚太经合组织间隙举行三边会议，其中包括特朗普、习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。
卢比奥表示，特朗普希望举行这次会议，并补充道：“我们认为这应该是可能的。”
特朗普周日表示，他认为他将在深圳会见习近平和普京，讨论结束伊朗战争和无核化。
他在十月份表示，他对与习近平和普京进行三方军控会谈持开放态度，他表示会谈将重点讨论核武器，尽管中国似乎不太热衷于此类讨论。
中国外交部上个月表示，其“核实力与美国和俄罗斯根本不在同一水平”，“现阶段要求中国加入所谓三边核裁军谈判既不公平、不合理、也不现实”。
据《华尔街日报》报道，普京已提议利用三边会议来讨论结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的长期战争。
今年的特习会似乎有助于稳定关系，但对缩小这两个战略竞争对手之间的广泛分歧几乎没有作用。
9月在华盛顿，他们同意将原定于11月到期的贸易休战延长两个月，但关税、中国购买美国商品、稀土出口和技术限制等方面的争端仍未解决。
周二，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，双方将就人工智能展开新的对话，但不应对双方的分歧抱有幻想，因为双方在争夺人工智能霸主地位的同时寻求管理技术风险。

China's foreign minister says call with Rubio was 'positive and constructive' - Nikkei Asia
China's foreign minister says call with Rubio was 'positive and constructive'
Talks come week ahead of event where Trump could meet Xi and Putin together
U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio © Reuters
November 12, 2026 03:40 JST
BEIJING/WASHINGTON,(Reuters) -- Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi held a "positive and constructive" call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Wednesday, China's state news agency Xinhua reported, with Beijing expressing willingness to strengthen communication and cooperation with Washington.
The talks come roughly a week ahead of the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in China's Shenzhen, where Presidents Xi Jinping and Donald Trump are expected to meet.
The current stability in China-US relations has not come easily, Wang said, calling it "a rational choice made by the two major countries based on respective and shared interests," the Xinhua report said.
There was no immediate readout of the call from the US State Department.
Xi and Trump have met twice already this year and Rubio told reporters on Tuesday there was work underway to arrange a trilateral meeting on the APEC sidelines involving Trump, Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
Rubio said Trump wants that meeting to happen and added: "We think it should be possible."
Trump said on Sunday he thought he would meet Xi and Putin in Shenzhen and discuss ending the war in Iran and denuclearization.
He said in October that he was open to three-way arms control talks with Xi and Putin, which he said would focus on nuclear weapons, although China has appeared less keen on such discussions.
China's foreign ministry said last month that its "nuclear strength is by no means at the same level with that of the US and Russia" and that it would be "neither fair, reasonable nor realistic to ask China to join the so-called trilateral nuclear disarmament negotiations at this stage."
The Wall Street Journal has reported that Putin has pitched using a trilateral meeting to discuss an end to Russia's long-running war in Ukraine.
This year's Trump-Xi summits appear to have helped stabilize relations, but done little to narrow the broad differences between the two strategic rivals.
In Washington in September they agreed a two-month extension of a trade truce that had been due to expire in November but disputes over tariffs, Chinese purchases of US goods, rare earth exports and technology restrictions remained unresolved.
On Tuesday, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that the two sides would advance a new dialogue on artificial intelligence, but should harbor no illusions about their differences as they seek to manage the technology's risks while competing for AI supremacy.

title: III MEF Extends Curfew for Junior Members in Okinawa Following Murder Indictment
zh_title: III MEF 在谋杀案起诉后延长冲绳初级成员的宵禁
summary: 2026 年 10 月 31 日，美国军人、冲绳县警察和酒吧老板在冲绳市 Koza Gate 街进行联合巡逻，以促进负责任的基地外行为并加强与当地社区的关系。 III MEF 照片 美国军方延长了原定于周日到期的冲绳初级军人宵禁，并继续对购买和消费酒精实施限制。据报道，E-1至E-4年级的宵禁延长了30天，并限制他们在凌晨12点至凌晨5点呆在自己的私人住宅内。
content:
2026 年 10 月 31 日，美国军人、冲绳县警察和酒吧老板在冲绳市 Koza Gate 街进行联合巡逻，以促进负责任的基地外行为并加强与当地社区的关系。 III MEF 照片 美国军方延长了原定于周日到期的冲绳初级军人宵禁，并继续对购买和消费酒精实施限制。根据美国海军陆战队第三远征军 (MEF) 周四发布的新闻稿，E-1 至 E-4 级人员的宵禁延长了 30 天，并从上午 12 点到凌晨 5 点限制他们呆在个人住房内。宵禁此前曾针对较高级别人员实施，但后来被取消。但是，午夜后禁止所有人员在其主要住所之外购买或饮用酒精饮料。一名被指控在冲绳那霸抢劫并杀害一名妇女的海军陆战队员被捕，导致行动暂停 48 小时，随后于 10 月 8 日实施宵禁。该海军陆战队队员于 10 月 25 日被起诉。服务新闻稿中写道，在经过详细分析以及联合和跨机构领导人的反馈后，第三海军陆战队远征部队选择延长宵禁。本杰明·T·中将
第三远征军司令兼冲绳地区协调员沃森会见了冲绳地区协调委员会的代表，讨论了降低整个部队风险的前进方向，并在日本驻日美军的同意下发布了更新后的自由指南。该指南涵盖的时期为11月8日至12月。 7. 指挥官保留在条件允许时在各自指挥范围内制定更具限制性的自由政策的能力，并鼓励指挥官向部队明确传达这些决定。 2026 年 10 月 6 日，美国海军陆战队中将、第三海军陆战远征军司令本杰明·T·沃森（中右）在日本冲绳考特尼营举行的参谋会议上与主要领导人发表讲话。沃森向第三海军陆战队远征军领导人发表讲话，强调了海军陆战队的核心价值观以及他对整个部队的标准、纪律和问责制的期望。指导意见中写道：“在未来几周内，冲绳地区协调员将把反思期间制定的更广泛的评估结果和建议转发给驻日美军供考虑。”更新后的自由准则恰逢周六宵禁期间冲绳一名海军陆战队员因涉嫌酒后驾车被捕，这引发了对美军确保冲绳人员纪律的批评。
日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎在周一的新闻发布会上被问到时表示，日本防卫省已要求美国确保其人员严格纪律，采取有效措施防止再次发生，并严格执行夜间宵禁。根据文字记录，小泉表示：“我希望他们认真对待这段反思期间发生的事情，彻底执行纪律，确保此类事件不再发生。”日本防卫大臣表示，美国和日本官员正在讨论如何采取措施防止事件发生。 “我们的目的是尽快得出结论、公布并付诸行动。我们将继续与美方密切合作，彻底解决此事。”

【原文 English Original】
U.S. service members, Okinawa Prefectural Police officers and bar owners conducted a joint patrol at Koza Gate Street in Okinawa City to promote responsible off-base conduct and strengthen relationships with the local community on Oct. 31, 2026. III MEF photo The U.S. military extended a curfew on Okinawa for junior service members that was scheduled to expire on Sunday and is continuing to impose restrictions on the purchase and consumption of alcohol. The curfew for grades E-1 through E-4 was extended for 30 days and restricts them to their personal housing from 12 a.m. to 5 a.m., according to a Thursday news release from the III Marine Expeditionary Force (MEF). The curfew was previously in place for higher grade personnel but was lifted. However, all personnel are prohibited from the purchase or consumption of alcohol outside of their primary residence after midnight. The curfew was implemented on Oct. 8 following a 48-hour operational pause in response to the arrest of a Marine accused in the robbery and death of a woman in Naha, Okinawa. The Marine was indicted on the charges on Oct. 25. The III MEF opted to extend the curfew following a detailed analysis and feedback from joint and interagency leaders, reads the service release. Lt. Gen. Benjamin T. Watson, commanding general of III MEF and Okinawa Area Coordinator, met with representatives from the Okinawa Area Coordinating Committee to discuss the way forward to reduce risk across the force, and with concurrence from U.S. Forces Japan issued the updated liberty guidance. The guidance covers a period from Nov. 8-Dec. 7. Commanders retain the ability to establish more restrictive liberty policies within their respective commands when conditions warrant and are encouraged to clearly communicate those decisions to the force. U.S. Marine Corps Lt. Gen. Benjamin T. Watson, center-right, the commanding general of III Marine Expeditionary Force, speaks with key leaders during a staff meeting on Camp Courtney, Okinawa, Japan, Oct. 6, 2026. Watson addressed III MEF leaders, reinforcing the Marine Corps’ core values and his expectations for standards, discipline, and accountability across the force. US Marine Corps photo “In the coming weeks, the Okinawa Area Coordinator will forward the results of the broader assessment and recommendations developed during the Period of Reflection to U.S. Forces Japan for consideration,” reads the guidance. The updated liberty guidelines coincide with the Saturday arrest of a Marine in Okinawa during the curfew hours on suspicion of drunk driving, which has prompted criticism of the U.S. military’s efforts on ensuring personnel discipline in Okinawa. Japan Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi, when asked in a Monday press conference, said that his Ministry have requested that the U.S. to ensure strict discipline among its personnel, implement effective measures to prevent a recurrence and strictly enforce the nighttime curfew. “I want them to take seriously what happened during this period of reflection and to thoroughly enforce discipline and ensure that such incidents do not recur,” said Koizumi, according to a transcript . U.S. and Japanese officials are in discussions on how to implement measures to prevent incidents from occurring, the Japanese Defense Minister said. “Our intention is to reach conclusions as soon as possible, announce them and put them into action. We will continue to work closely with the U.S. side to thoroughly address this matter,” said Koizumi. For exercise Keen Sword, which ran from Oct. 19-29, the municipal authorities of Yonaguni Island and Ishigaki Island requested the Japan Ministry of Defense to ensure U.S. military personnel carrying out training on their islands during Keen Sword were restricted to the training areas, not allowed liberty, prohibited from consuming alcohol and when moving through civilian areas were accompanied by Japan Self-Defense Force personnel, according to documents posted on municipal government website. Japan Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has also made it a priority to address the issues surrounding the U.S. presence in Okinawa. “Even now, more than 80 years after the end of the war, Okinawa Prefecture still has a large concentration of U.S. military facilities and areas and we take seriously the heavy burden of these bases that the people of Okinawa bear. What is important is to steadily produce results one by one, and we will do our utmost to realize a reduction of the base burden in Okinawa in a tangible way,” the Japanese Prime Minister said during the Okinawa Policy Council meeting on Friday . Friday’s meeting was the first one held in 13 years, which saw Takaichi and her cabinet ministers meeting with Okinawa Governor Genta Koja and prefectural officials to discuss matters pertaining to the island, which included the U.S. military presence as well as economic and development issues. In a Friday post on X , Koja outlined his request in regard to the U.S. military presence in Okinawa. “Regarding the reduction of the burden related to military bases, we called for the removal of the dangers posed by Futenma Air Station as soon as possible, the establishment of a clear timeline for its return, the prevention of any recurrence of incidents involving U.S. military personnel and a fundamental review of the Japan-U.S. Status of Forces Agreement,” reads the post. In his regularly scheduled press conference on Friday , Koizumi said he told Koja that the MOD would take the governor’s request seriously and do its utmost to reduce the burden of U.S. military bases on Okinawa. “The Ministry of Defense will promptly consider what kind of response is possible based on the requests received today,” said Koizumi.

Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Posted Aug 14, 2026 by Martin Armstrong |
The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some 84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.
This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.
The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.
Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.
Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.
A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.
A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA blockade, while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.
This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.
Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.
What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.
This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.
If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

summary: 证监会将大阪 21 世纪酒店项目列为可疑投资 |中国劳工公告牌 星期四, 12 11 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 证监会将 21 世纪大阪酒店项目列为可疑投资 香港证券及期货事务监察委员会已将与 21 世纪相关的酒店式公寓项目列为可疑投资产品，警告该项目未获授权在香港出售，并提供有限的投资者保护。香港证券及期货事务监察委员会（证监会）将21世纪关联的酒店式公寓项目列为暂停上市项目
content:
证监会将大阪 21 世纪酒店项目列为可疑投资 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
证监会将大阪 21 世纪酒店项目列为可疑投资
香港证券及期货事务监察委员会已将与 21 世纪相关的酒店式公寓项目标记为可疑投资产品，并警告称该项目未获授权在香港销售，且对投资者的保护有限。
香港证券及期货事务监察委员会（证监会）已将与 21 世纪相关的酒店式公寓项目列为可疑投资产品，并警告称该项目尚未获得在香港销售的授权。监管机构提醒公众，该产品不受证监会监管，这意味着投资者仅获得有限的保护，并且可能会损失全部投资。
据证监会称，该安排涉及日本大阪一个潜在的中央管理房地产项目。确定的营销代理是世纪21文化中心地产和华记正能量YouTube频道创始人杨冠华。公开记录显示，杨还创立了21世纪文化中心地产。他此前在香港经营十多家房地产代理分公司，随后于2014年缩减本地业务并进军日本房地产代理市场。
证监会表示，该投资安排已通过在香港举行的营销活动向投资者传达，也可通过 Facebook、YouTube 和 Instagram 等社交媒体账户访问。敦促公众对该项目保持谨慎态度，并关注相关宣传活动、社交媒体账户和帖子。
记录显示，杨的 YouTube 频道在 2025 年 1 月 2 日的视频中提到了该公寓楼，并表示其公司正在与日本开发商 SEIWA 合作开发该项目。 2025年1月23日，该频道发布了另一则有关投资大阪高端宾馆的视频，并预告了将于2025年2月1日至2日在尖沙咀半岛酒店举行的销售展览。

Thursday, 12 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
SFC flags Century 21 Osaka hotel project as suspicious investment
Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission has flagged a hotel-style apartment project linked to Century 21 as a suspicious investment product, warning it is not authorised for sale in the city and offers limited investor protection.
Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has listed a hotel-style apartment project linked to Century 21 as a suspicious investment product, warning that it has not been authorised for sale in the city. The regulator reminded the public that the product is not regulated by the SFC, meaning investors have only limited protection and could lose their entire investment.
According to the SFC, the arrangement involves a potential centrally managed property project in Osaka, Japan. The marketing agents identified are Century 21 Culture Centre Property and Alex Yeung Kwun-wah, founder of the Wah Kee Positive Energy YouTube channel. Public records show Yeung also founded Century 21 Culture Centre Property. He previously operated more than ten real estate agency branches in Hong Kong before scaling down local operations and expanding into the Japanese property agency market in 2014.
The SFC stated that the investment arrangement has been disseminated to investors via marketing events held in Hong Kong and is also accessible on social media accounts, including Facebook, YouTube and Instagram. It urged the public to be cautious about the project and to pay attention to related promotional activities, social media accounts and posts.
Records show that Yeung's YouTube channel mentioned the apartment building in a video dated 2 January 2025, stating that his company was cooperating with Japanese developer SEIWA on the project. On 23 January 2025, the channel released another video about investing in high-end Osaka guesthouses and previewed sales exhibitions to be held at the Peninsula Hotel in Tsim Sha Tsui on 1 and 2 February 2025.

content:
联合国教科文组织前总干事敦促葵青青年拥抱全球机遇 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
联合国教科文组织前总干事敦促葵青青年拥抱全球机遇
周三，联合国教科文组织前总干事伊琳娜·博科娃 (Irina Bokova) 在葵青举办的青年论坛上担任主角，向近 400 名学生和教育工作者发表讲话。官员们敦促年轻人平衡本土根源与国际参与，与香港第一个五年计划和国家发展目标保持一致
联合国教科文组织前总干事伊琳娜·博科娃周三在葵青举办的青年发展论坛上担任主角，敦促数百名当地学生在扎根社区的同时拥抱全球机遇。该活动在圣公会林护纪念中学举行，吸引了来自荃湾、葵青及青衣区10所中学的近400名学生、校长和教师。
主办方表示，论坛旨在激励年轻人充分利用香港的独特优势，将本地根基与全球机遇联系起来。讨论的重点是青年如何配合香港的第一个五年计划，并准备为国家发展和国际市场做出贡献。
葵青区民政事务专员梁胜龙向观众表示，政府致力培育具有强烈国家认同、文化自信和全球视野的新一代。他表示，为地区层面提供参与平台是帮助年轻人登上国际舞台的关键。梁振英还援引了孙中山的遗产，敦促年轻人从他“复兴中华”的号召中汲取灵感，“与世界上平等对待我们的人民结成联盟，共同奋斗”。
论坛第一部分，博科娃发表题为“亚非欧共同未来发展对话”的主旨演讲，探讨日益全球化的世界中跨区域合作的机遇。论坛最后举行了一场关于青年国际机会的圆桌会议，前教育局局长吴克俭讨论了教育政策和人才发展如何帮助年轻人为应对全球挑战做好准备。
来自教育、青年事务、技术和体育领域的政府官员、学术领袖和专家也参加了论坛，全天与学生和教育工作者进行交流。

Former UNESCO chief urges Kwai Tsing youth to embrace global opportunities | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 12 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Former UNESCO chief urges Kwai Tsing youth to embrace global opportunities
Former UNESCO Director-General Irina Bokova headlined a youth forum in Kwai Tsing on Wednesday, addressing nearly 400 students and educators. Officials urged young people to balance local roots with international engagement, aligning with Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan and national development goa
Former UNESCO Director-General Irina Bokova headlined a youth development forum in Kwai Tsing on Wednesday, urging hundreds of local students to embrace global opportunities while staying rooted in their communities. The event, held at SKH Lam Woo Memorial Secondary School, drew nearly 400 students, principals and teachers from 10 secondary schools across the Tsuen Wan, Kwai Tsing and Tsing Yi districts.
Organisers said the forum aimed to inspire young people to make the most of Hong Kong's unique advantages, bridging local roots with global opportunities. Discussions focused on how youth can align with Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan and prepare to contribute to both national development and the international market.
Kwai Tsing district officer Edric Leung Sing-lung told the audience that the government is committed to fostering a new generation with a strong national identity, cultural confidence and a global perspective. He said providing platforms for participation at the district level is key to helping young people step onto the international stage. Leung also invoked the legacy of Sun Yat-sen, urging youth to draw inspiration from his calls to 'revive China' and 'ally ourselves in a common struggle with those peoples of the world who treat us on the basis of equality.'
During the first part of the forum, Bokova delivered a keynote speech titled 'Asian-African-European Dialogue on Shared Future Development,' exploring opportunities for cross-regional cooperation in an increasingly globalised world. The forum concluded with a roundtable on international opportunities for youth, where former Secretary for Education Eddie Ng Hak-kim discussed how education policy and talent development can help young people prepare for global challenges.
Government officials, academic leaders and specialists from education, youth affairs, technology and sports also joined the forum, engaging with students and educators throughout the day.

content:
香港卫生官员敦促医生主动提供新冠疫苗注射建议中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港卫生官员敦促医生主动提供新冠疫苗注射建议
香港卫生防护中心敦促医务人员主动提醒患者接种Covid-19疫苗，并援引一项调查发现近40%的医生没有这样做。该中心还澄清了暂时停止成人疫苗供应的情况，并确认预计将有新的发货
2026 年 11 月 11 日 21:20 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 12 日 04:25 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港卫生防护中心对医疗机构的一项调查表示担忧，该调查显示近 40% 的医生没有主动提醒患者接种 Covid-19 疫苗。该中心敦促医护人员积极告知患者及时接种疫苗的重要性，即使他们的诊所不提供这项服务，也要提供有关政府 Covid-19 疫苗接种计划的详细信息，以帮助保护公众健康。
该中心发表上述声明是为了回应一家医疗机构的询问，该机构报告称一些医生缺乏Covid-19疫苗库存，并对疫苗接种率低感到担忧，并回应了相关媒体的询问。
此前，该中心宣布，儿童和成人LP.8.1疫苗的有效期分别为7月中旬和9月初，新成分疫苗的生产和交付需要时间。自 10 月 29 日以来，该中心一直为 6 个月至 11 岁的儿童提供 Spikevax XFG 信使 RNA 疫苗。
针对12岁及以上人士，第一批新型Spikevax XFG Covid-19疫苗预计将于下个月抵达香港，恢复市场供应，并允许私人医生照常向制药公司下订单。在等待生产和交付的过渡期间，成人未接种 Covid-19 疫苗被描述为正常且暂时的。
该中心补充说，合资格人士可以在现有的所有疫苗接种点接种流感疫苗和Covid-19疫苗，包括相关公立医院专科门诊诊所、家庭医学诊所和私人诊所，并且认为没有立即需要进一步扩大疫苗接种地点。

Hong Kong health officials urge doctors to proactively offer Covid jab advice | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 12 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong health officials urge doctors to proactively offer Covid jab advice
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection urges medical staff to proactively remind patients about Covid-19 vaccinations, citing a survey that found nearly 40 per cent of doctors do not do so. The centre also clarifies the temporary pause in adult vaccine supply and confirms new shipments are expecte
11 Nov 2026 at 21:20 HKT · updated 12 Nov, 04:25 · 1 min read
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection has expressed concern over a medical organisation survey indicating that nearly 40 per cent of doctors do not proactively remind patients to receive a Covid-19 vaccine. The centre has urged healthcare workers to actively inform patients about the importance of timely vaccination and, even if their clinics do not offer the service, to provide details about the government's Covid-19 vaccination programme to help protect public health.
The centre issued the statement in response to queries from a medical organisation, which had reported that some doctors lack Covid-19 vaccine stock and are worried about low vaccination rates, as well as to related media inquiries.
Earlier, the centre announced that the LP.8.1 vaccine for children and adults had expiry dates of mid-July and early September respectively, and that production and delivery of vaccines with new ingredients take time. Since 29 October, the centre has been providing the Spikevax XFG messenger RNA vaccine for children aged six months to 11 years.
For individuals aged 12 and above, the first batch of new Spikevax XFG Covid-19 vaccines is expected to arrive in Hong Kong next month, restoring market supply and allowing private doctors to place orders with pharmaceutical companies as usual. During the transitional period while waiting for production and delivery, the absence of adult Covid-19 vaccination is described as normal and temporary.
The centre added that eligible people can receive both influenza and Covid-19 vaccines at all current vaccination points, including relevant public hospital specialist outpatient clinics, family medicine clinics and private clinics, and it sees no immediate need to expand vaccination locations further.

香港部长在商业颁奖典礼上赞扬女性的领导力
香港文化部长在 2026 年杰出商界女性领袖奖上赞扬了女性在商界和政府中日益重要的作用，并指出她的局中三分之二的高级官员是女性。
香港文化体育及旅游局局长于 11 月 11 日在 2026 年杰出商界女性领袖颁奖典礼上致辞，强调女性在商界、政府和体育界的影响力日益增强。该活动由香港商报主办，已举办十年，旨在表彰各行业的女性领袖。
国务卿指出，一项调查显示，在过去 20 年里，全球企业担任高级职务的女性比例已从 19.4% 上升到 34%。她表示，这体现了妇女对经济社会发展的影响日益增强，体现了“妇女顶半边天”的精神。
在她自己的局内，三分之二的首长级公务员是女性，包括常任秘书长、副秘书长、旅游专员及其副手、体育专员和创意产业专员。康乐及文化事务署首长级的女性比例亦达三分之二，包括总监及两名副总监。
体育方面，在爱知名古屋举行的第20届亚运会上，香港运动员约占一半，香港共赢得11枚金牌和54枚奖牌。游泳运动员西奥布汉·豪伊 (Siobhan Haughey) 赢得了两枚金牌和两枚银牌。在亚洲残疾人运动会上，女子运动员赢得了三枚金牌中的两枚，41枚奖牌中，女运动员获得了23枚，另外还有9枚来自混合项目。残奥会游泳选手陈锐霖、硬地滚球张元、击剑选手余翠儿和唐阿廷均获得多枚奖牌。
国务卿向金融、房地产、法律、医疗保健和会计领域的过去和现在的获奖者表示祝贺，并表示她们的故事激励其他女性追求自己的抱负。她希望更多女性为香港的文化、体育、旅游事业，为香港更广阔的发展作出贡献。

Hong Kong minister hails women's leadership at business awards ceremony
Hong Kong's culture minister praised women's growing role in business and government at the 2026 Outstanding Business Women Leaders Awards, noting that two-thirds of senior officials in her bureau are female.
Hong Kong's Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, speaking at the 2026 Outstanding Business Women Leaders Awards ceremony on 11 November, highlighted the increasing influence of women in business, government and sports. The event, organised by Hong Kong Commercial Daily, has run for a decade and recognises female leaders across sectors.
The secretary noted that globally, the proportion of women in senior corporate roles has risen from 19.4 per cent to 34 per cent over the past two decades, according to a survey. She said this reflects women's growing impact on economic and social development, embodying the spirit that 'women hold up half the sky'.
Within her own bureau, two-thirds of directorate-level civil servants are women, including the Permanent Secretary, Deputy Secretaries, the Commissioner for Tourism and her deputy, the Commissioner for Sports and the Commissioner for Creative Industries. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department also has a two-thirds female directorate ratio, including the director and two deputy directors.
In sports, female athletes accounted for about half of Hong Kong's contingent at the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, where the territory won 11 gold medals and 54 medals in total. Swimmer Siobhan Haughey won two gold and two silver medals. At the Asian Para Games, women won two of three gold medals, and 23 of 41 medals were earned by female athletes, with nine more from mixed events. Paralympians including Chan Yui-lam in swimming, Cheung Yuen in boccia, and Yu Chui-yee and Tong Ah-ting in fencing achieved multiple medals.
The secretary congratulated past and present award winners from finance, property, law, healthcare and accounting, saying their stories inspire other women to pursue their ambitions. She expressed hope that more women would contribute to Hong Kong's culture, sports and tourism sectors, and to the territory's broader development.

香港卫生当局澄清 Covid-19 疫苗推出细节 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 12 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港卫生当局澄清 Covid-19 疫苗推出细节
香港卫生防护中心澄清了 Covid-19 疫苗接种安排，指出高危人群的初始接种率较高，但加强接种率较低。由于新的配方生产和交付时间表，它确认了直到 12 月为止成人疫苗供应暂时存在缺口。
2026 年 11 月 11 日 21:00 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 12 日 04:25 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
香港卫生防护中心（CHP）就Covid-19疫苗接种安排发表澄清，强调科学证据显示疫苗可有效降低严重疾病和死亡风险。 CHP 遵循世界卫生组织及其科学委员会的建议，鼓励及时接种疫苗，以降低 Covid-19 造成严重后果的风险。经过政府和业界多年努力，香港首剂疫苗接种率超过90%，在国际上名列前茅。
关于加强剂量，联合科学委员会仅建议高危人群接种，间隔时间至少为最后一剂疫苗或 Covid-19 感染后 180 天（以较晚者为准）。这自然会导致助推器吸收率降低。许多感染者由于重复感染或接种疫苗，症状较轻并且不寻求医疗护理，这限制了政府准确计算群体疫苗接种率的能力。
卫生防护中心早前宣布，儿童及成人LP.8.1疫苗分别于2026年7月中旬及9月初到期，新配方疫苗的生产及交付尚需时日。自10月29日起，该中心已为6个月至11岁的儿童提供Spikevax XFG信使RNA疫苗。第一批针对12岁及以上人群的新型Spikevax XFG疫苗预计将于12月抵达，恢复市场供应并允许私人医生照常向制造商订购。在此过渡期间暂时缺乏成人 Covid-19 疫苗是正常且短暂的。
在疫苗接种地点方面，政府在全港设立75个地点，包括公立医院专科诊所、家庭医学诊所、私家诊所及母婴健康中心，以平衡便利性、减少疫苗浪费及确保功效。卫生防护中心建议重点人群同时接种季节性流感疫苗和 Covid-19 加强疫苗，以减少合并感染导致的严重并发症和死亡风险。符合条件的人可以在所有现有的 Covid-19 疫苗接种点接种这两种疫苗。该中心认为现阶段无需进一步扩大疫苗接种点。
一项调查显示，近40%的医生没有主动提醒病人有关Covid-19疫苗接种的事宜，卫生防护中心对此表示关注，并敦促医护人员提醒病人及时接种疫苗。即使他们的诊所不提供疫苗接种服务，他们也应该提供有关政府 Covid-19 疫苗接种计划的信息，以保护公众健康。中心将继续通过线上线下渠道加强宣传教育，一旦新的12岁及以上儿童用品到位，就提醒重点人群接种疫苗。

Thursday, 12 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong health authority clarifies Covid-19 vaccine rollout details
Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection clarifies Covid-19 vaccination arrangements, noting high initial uptake but lower booster rates among high-risk groups. It confirms a temporary adult vaccine supply gap until December, due to new formulation production and delivery timelines.
11 Nov 2026 at 21:00 HKT · updated 12 Nov, 04:25 · 2 min read
The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) of Hong Kong has issued a clarification on Covid-19 vaccination arrangements, emphasising that scientific evidence shows vaccines effectively reduce severe disease and death risks. The CHP follows recommendations from the World Health Organization and its own scientific committees, encouraging timely vaccination to lower the risk of severe outcomes from Covid-19. After years of government and sector efforts, Hong Kong's initial-dose vaccination rate exceeds 90 per cent, ranking high internationally.
Regarding booster doses, the joint scientific committee recommends them only for high-risk groups, with a minimum interval of 180 days after the last vaccine dose or Covid-19 infection, whichever is later. This naturally results in a lower booster uptake rate. Many infected individuals, due to repeat infections or vaccination, have mild symptoms and do not seek medical care, limiting the government's ability to accurately calculate group vaccination rates.
The CHP earlier announced that LP.8.1 vaccines for children and adults expired in mid-July and early September 2026 respectively, with production and delivery of new-formulation vaccines taking time. Since 29 October, the centre has provided Spikevax XFG messenger RNA vaccines for children aged six months to 11 years. The first batch of new Spikevax XFG vaccines for people aged 12 and above is expected to arrive in December, restoring market supply and allowing private doctors to order from manufacturers as usual. The temporary absence of adult Covid-19 vaccines during this transition is normal and short-lived.
On vaccination locations, the government has set up 75 sites across Hong Kong, including public hospital specialist clinics, family medicine clinics, private clinics and maternal and child health centres, to balance convenience, reduce vaccine waste and ensure efficacy. The CHP recommends that priority individuals receive both seasonal influenza and Covid-19 booster vaccines simultaneously to reduce severe complications and death risk from co-infection. Eligible people can receive both vaccines at all current Covid-19 vaccination points. The centre believes no further expansion of vaccination sites is needed at this stage.
Responding to a survey indicating nearly 40 per cent of doctors do not proactively remind patients about Covid-19 vaccination, the CHP expressed concern and urged healthcare workers to remind patients about timely vaccination. Even if their clinics do not offer vaccination services, they should provide information on the government's Covid-19 vaccination programme to protect public health. The centre will continue to enhance promotion and education through online and offline channels, reminding priority groups to get vaccinated as soon as the new supplies for those aged 12 and above become available.

title: Austal Cuts First Steel on Landing Craft Heavy for Australian Army
zh_title: 奥斯塔为澳大利亚陆军首次切割重型登陆艇钢材
summary: 澳大利亚政府于 2026 年 11 月 11 日宣布，为澳大利亚陆军采购的两艘两栖登陆艇中的第二艘目前正在建造中。重型登陆艇 (LCH) 的第一批钢材于 10 月下旬完成生产，一个月前中型登陆艇 (LCM) 项目也取得了类似的里程碑。造船商 Austal 绘制的计算机插图中的 Damen LST 100 重型登陆艇 (LCH)。澳大利亚国防镜头。澳大利亚国防部长 2026 年 11 月 11 日发布的媒体报道 澳大利亚陆军转型为一支优化部队
content:
澳大利亚政府于 2026 年 11 月 11 日宣布，为澳大利亚陆军采购的两艘两栖登陆艇中的第二艘目前正在建造中。重型登陆艇 (LCH) 的第一批钢材于 10 月下旬完成生产，一个月前中型登陆艇 (LCM) 项目也取得了类似的里程碑。造船商 Austal 绘制的计算机插图中的 Damen LST 100 重型登陆艇 (LCH)。澳大利亚国防镜头。澳大利亚国防部长发布的媒体报道（链接）2026 年 11 月 11 日澳大利亚陆军向两栖作战和远程打击优化的部队转型正在推进，西澳大利亚州登陆艇的建造现已进入新阶段。陆军重型登陆艇的建造工作正在按计划进行，第一艘舰艇已于上月底进行了钢材切割。阿尔巴尼亚政府已授予价值超过 50 亿美元的合同，为陆军提供 18 艘中型登陆艇和 8 艘重型登陆艇，该项目已经促进了就业和当地经济活动。该项目将为西澳创造1,100个直接就业岗位和2,000多个间接就业岗位，并直接支持政府对该州持续造船的承诺。
这些舰艇能够运输多兵种陆地系统，包括高机动火炮火箭系统、艾布拉姆斯主战坦克以及侦察和步兵战车，将增强澳大利亚国防军将潜在对手置于危险之中并确保战略地形安全的能力。这一重大进展表明了阿尔巴尼亚政府致力于建设陆军未来濒海舰队，同时推进国防战略和综合投资计划的优先事项，加强澳大利亚的主权国防工业基础，并创造熟练就业。为了进一步增强澳大利亚的主权造船能力，阿尔巴尼亚政府的国家重建基金公司 (NRFC) 上个月宣布向澳大利亚奥斯塔防务造船有限公司提供 2.45 亿美元贷款，以支持澳大利亚海军陆战队内重型登陆艇设施的建造和装修。该项目是阿尔巴尼亚政府创纪录的国防投资的一部分，是自第二次世界大战以来陆军滨海能力最大规模的资本重组。 “陆军登陆艇舰队建造的进展标志着从设计到交付的过渡，也是澳大利亚国防军关键能力建设的重要一步。随着建设活动的增加，我们正在为当地人创造数千个就业机会，为企业提供投资和发展劳动力所需的信心。
这两个登陆艇项目对于阿尔巴尼亚政府在西澳的持续造船计划至关重要，该计划将为子孙后代提供就业保障，并使澳大利亚人更加安全。”国防工业部长 Pat Conroy MP – 声明结束 – 2026 年 9 月下旬在奥斯塔第一艘 LCM 船的 1 号区块首次焊接。图片来自奥斯塔通过澳大利亚国防部拍摄的镜头。 《海军新闻》评论：继 2026 年 9 月 29 日中型登陆艇 (LCM) 实现类似里程碑之后，重型登陆艇 (LCH) 两栖登陆舰于 10 月下旬宣布进行首次钢材切割。正如《海军新闻》在之前的报道中概述的那样，这两项工作现在都在进行中

The Australian government announced on 11 November 2026 that construction is now underway on the second of two amphibious landing craft-procurements for the Australian Army. First steel for the Landing Craft Heavy (LCH) was cut in late October, followin a similar milestone for the Landing Craft Medium (LCM)-program one month earlier. The Damen LST 100-based Landing Craft Heavy (LCH) in a computer illustration by shipbuilder Austal. Footage Australian Defence. Media release of the Australian Minister for Defence (Link) 11 November 2026 The transformation of the Australian Army into a force optimised for amphibious operations and long-range strike is advancing, with construction in Western Australia of landing craft vessels now progressing to a new phase. Construction of the Army’s Landing Craft Heavy is now underway and on schedule with steel cut on the first vessels late last month. The Albanese Government has awarded over $5 billion in contracts to deliver 18 Landing Craft Medium and eight Landing Craft Heavy for Army, a project that has already boosted employment and local economic activity. The project will create 1,100 direct jobs and more than 2,000 indirect jobs in Western Australia and directly support the Government’s commitment to continuous shipbuilding in the state. Capable of transporting combined-arms land systems, including High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems, Abrams main battle tanks, and reconnaissance and infantry fighting vehicles, the vessels will strengthen the Australian Defence Force’s ability to hold potential adversaries at risk and secure strategic terrain. This significant progress demonstrates the Albanese Government’s commitment to delivering Army’s future littoral fleet, while advancing the priorities of the National Defence Strategy and Integrated Investment Program, strengthening Australia’s sovereign defence industrial base, and creating skilled employment. In a further boost to Australia’s sovereign shipbuilding capability, the Albanese Government’s National Reconstruction Fund Corporation (NRFC) last month announced a $245 million loan to Austal Defence Shipbuilding Australia Pty Ltd to support the construction and fit out of Landing Craft Heavy facilities within the Australian Marine Complex. The project – part of the Albanese Government’s record investment in Defence – represents the largest recapitalisation of Army’s littoral capability since the Second World War. “Progress in constructing Army’s landing craft fleet marks the transition from design into delivery and an important step in building a critical capability for the Australian Defence Force. As construction activity ramps up, we are creating thousands of jobs for locals, providing businesses the confidence they need to invest and grow their workforce. These two landing craft projects are critical to the Albanese Government’s continuous shipbuilding plan for WA, which is providing job security for generations to come, and making Australians safer.” Minister for Defence Industry Pat Conroy MP – end of statement – First weld on block 1 of the first LCM vessel at Austal in late September, 2026. Image from footage by Austal via Australian DoD. Naval News comments: The announcement for first steel cut on the Landing Craft – Heavy (LCH) amphibious landing ships in late October follows a similar milestone met for the Landing Craft – Medium (LCM)-effort on 29 September 2026. As Naval News has outlined in previous coverage , both efforts are now effectively occurring in parallel due to earlier delays on moving LCM from design to construction. Austal is capable of constructing the LCM-vessels with a displacement of approximately 500 tons within its existing facilities at Henderson and on Hope Valley Road. For the construction of the far larger LCH based on Damen’s LST 100 displacing nearly 4,000 tons however the government-designated strategic shipbuilder will need to utilise facilities within the wider Henderson Defence Precinct, notably the Common User Facility (CUF). The yard intends to move LCH-production to a yet to be established “permanent” production facility at a later date, according to a previous contract-announcement by the Australian government. Australia has ordered 18 LCM and eight LCH for expanded amphibious capability operated by the Australian Defence Force. The post Austal Cuts First Steel on Landing Craft Heavy for Australian Army appeared first on Naval News .

立法院社会福利与环境卫生委员会的议员们同意使用人工智能阅读《痴呆症基本法》拟议修正案的 15 个版本，这是该法案审查开始前的标准程序。
委员会主席陈菁徽表示，人工智能最初以正常速度的 1.5 倍阅读 10 分钟，后来立法者表示他们没有困难，随后增加到正常速度的两倍，并在 70 分钟内完成阅读。
国民党立法委员陈表示，立法人员需要大约2小时11分钟来阅读全部15项提案。
她希望人工智能的首次使用将为立法机构更广泛采用人工智能铺平道路。
这个想法是在陈在2024年的一次全体会议上失去声音并使用人工智能生成的声音向卓荣泰总理提问后产生的。
陈说，立法院院长韩国瑜此后鼓励立法院探索人工智能的使用，并成立了一个工作组来研究其应用。
她说，在周三的会议之前，该委员会与立法机关信息技术部合作测试该应用程序并确保其准确性。

Lawmakers on the Legislature's Social Welfare and Environmental Hygiene Committee listen as AI reads out 15 versions of proposed amendments to the Dementia Basic Act in Taipei on Wednesday. CNA photo Nov. 11, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 11 (CNA) The Legislative Yuan used artificial intelligence (AI) to read proposed legislation aloud for the first time on Wednesday.
Lawmakers on the Legislature's Social Welfare and Environmental Hygiene Committee agreed to use AI to read 15 versions of proposed amendments to the Dementia Basic Act, a standard procedure before the bill's review began.
The AI initially read at 1.5 times its normal speed for 10 minutes before increasing to twice the normal speed after lawmakers said they had no difficulty keeping up, completing the reading in 70 minutes, committee chair Chen Ching-hui (陳菁徽) said.
Chen, a Kuomintang (KMT) lawmaker, said legislative staff would have needed about two hours and 11 minutes to read all 15 proposals.
She hoped the first use of AI would pave the way for its wider adoption in the Legislature.
The idea came after Chen once lost her voice and used an AI-generated version of her voice to question Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) during a plenary session in 2024.
Chen said Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu (韓國瑜) has since encouraged the Legislature to explore AI use and established a task force to study its applications.
Before Wednesday's meeting, the committee worked with the Legislature's Information Technology Department to test the application and ensure its accuracy, she said.

宏碁的创办人施振荣将带领台湾代表团参加APEC会议图像来源: Sam Yeh/AFP
（德国之声中文网）台湾总统府周三（11月11日）表示，电脑制造商宏碁的创办人施振荣将作为领袖代表，出席下周在中国举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会。台湾同时要求北京履行书面保证，确保台湾能够平等参与。
亚太经合组织是台湾参加的少数几个国际组织之一。中国声称台湾是其领土。中国是今年的东道主，领导人峰会将于下周在南部城市深圳举行。
然而，台北与北京的关系极为紧张。中国拒绝与台湾总统赖清德对话，称他是“分裂分子”，中国军队每天都在台湾周边活动。
台湾总统府发言人郭雅慧在宣布施振荣的委任时声明说，台湾一直依照平等原则参与APEC的各项活动。
她强调，平等参与是APEC长期以来的惯例，与所谓的“一中原则”无关。一中原则指的是北京的立场，即台湾海峡两岸同属一个国家。
郭雅慧说，APEC各经济体过去已多次达成“全员平等参与”的共识。
她表示，台湾期盼中国履行主办经济体的责任及相关书面保证，确保台湾代表团能在平等、尊严及安全的前提下，参与本届APEC各项会议。
中国国台办当天早些时候表示，中国“一贯按照一个中国原则和APEC有关谅解备忘录的规定及惯例”处理台湾参会事宜。只要按照上述做法，台湾可以参会。
国台办发言人张晗在提及台湾时，使用的是中国官方用语“台湾地区”。
To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video
台湾的民选政府不接受北京的主权主张，主张只有台湾人民才能决定自己的未来。两岸政府互不正式承认。
台湾的劳动部长和财政部长今年已经到中国出席过APEC会议，没有发生意外。
但台湾外交部长林佳龙上周表示，中国并未遵循惯例派特使亲自递交邀请函，而是以电子邮件寄送。林佳龙表示，台湾已经在第一时间向中国表达抗议。
为避免政治问题，台湾通常派前官员或企业高管担任APEC领袖代表。他们一般会利用这一机会，与美国、日本等友好国家代表团的高级成员交谈。
美国总统特朗普预计将在深圳与中国国家主席习近平举行今年的第三次会晤。
施振荣曾于2007年担任台湾领袖代表出席澳大利亚APEC峰会。

据称，五家参展商被当局禁止参展，且没有给出任何解释，香港独立书展的组织者呼吁公开和透明。香港独立书展Duk6 Duk6的海报。照片：Duk6 Duk6。 Duk6 Duk6是一个推广自行出版作品的“独立叙事图书节”，第四届将于11月14日至15日在荃湾南丰纱厂举行。据本地创作者非营利团体 Yun Hyun 介绍，今年的展会将有约 125 家参展商展示漫画、小说、杂志、动画和游戏。但组织者周末表示，由于“不可抗力”，五家参展商被取消了参展资格。 “我们最近收到有关部门的通知，称由于许可过程中出现不可抗力问题，某些参展商无法参加，”尹炫在社交媒体上用中文发帖表示，但没有具体说明涉及的政府部门。不可抗力——涵盖双方无法控制的事件的合同条款——是场地和活动合同的主要内容。然而，近年来，对于许多香港人来说，这个词越来越成为隐秘政治压力和审查制度的代名词。尹贤没有透露哪些参展商必须退出，只表示受影响的参展商包括漫画、小说作家和插画家。
该组织补充说，他们的作品主题广泛，从香港本土文化到科幻小说。该组织还呼吁当局明确审查制度，以便活动组织者能够更好地合作。 “近年来，类似的活动经常遇到类似的情况。希望相关部门能够有一个更加公开透明的机制，让创作者和组织者更容易合作。”尹贤说。 “我们不知道界线在哪里” 一位因担心遭到报复而不愿透露姓名的艺博会策展人告诉《香港新闻社》，组织者一直在向食物环境卫生署（食环署）寻求临时公众娱乐场所许可证。馆长表示，申请必须经过多个部门的审核。 “有一个部门打电话告诉我们，要么这五家参展商必须被移除，要么整个活动将被取消，但没有给出任何解释，”策展人说。食环署发言人周二回复《香港新闻报》时表示，食环署已于十月初收到Duk6 Duk6的临时公众娱乐场所牌照申请，并正在就“公共秩序及安全、消防安全、楼宇安全、机电设备、人群控制及卫生”等事宜咨询相关政府部门。食环署没有证实其或其他政府部门是否禁止某些参展商参加活动。
策展人补充说，上一届书展于 2025 年初举办，也遭遇了场馆管理部门针对特定参展商的审查。2025 年的 Duk6 Duk6 书展。照片：Duk6 Duk6。 “鉴于这次经历，并看到最近每一个类似的活动都面临着同样的障碍，我们当然做好了准备，”策展人说。 “不过，我们没想到一下子就有五个参展商被 DQ [取消资格]。”策展人表示，所有 125 家参展商均经过精心挑选，以确保不出现人工智能生成或抄袭的材料，并补充说，此次活动的布局是为了让

【原文 English Original】
Organisers of an independent Hong Kong book fair have called for openness and transparency after five exhibitors were allegedly barred by authorities without explanation. The poster of Duk6 Duk6, an independent book fair in Hong Kong. Photo: Duk6 Duk6. Duk6 Duk6, an “indie narrative book fest” that promotes self-published works, is set to hold its fourth edition on November 14 and 15 at The Mills in Tsuen Wan. This year’s fair will feature about 125 exhibitors showcasing comics, novels, zines, animation and games, according to Yun Hyun, a non-profit collective of local creators. But organisers said over the weekend that five exhibitors had been disqualified from the event due to “force majeure.” “We recently received notifications from relevant authorities stating that, owing to force majeure issues arising during the licensing process, certain exhibitors cannot participate,” Yun Hyun said in a social media post written in Chinese, without specifying the government departments involved. Force majeure – a contract clause covering events beyond the parties’ control – is a staple of venue and event contracts. Yet for many in Hong Kong in recent years, the phrase has increasingly become shorthand for covert political pressure and censorship . Yun Hyun did not name the exhibitors that had to withdraw, only saying that the affected exhibitors included comic and novel writers and illustrators. The themes of their works range from local Hong Kong culture to science fiction, the group added. The group also called on the authorities to provide clarity regarding censorship, so that event organisers can better cooperate. “In recent years, similar events have frequently encountered similar situations. It is hoped that relevant departments will have a more open and transparent mechanism to make it easier for creators and organisers to cooperate,” Yun Hyun said. ‘We don’t know where the line is’ A curator of the fair, speaking on condition of anonymity citing fear of reprisals, told HKFP that organisers had been seeking a Temporary Places of Public Entertainment Licence from the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD). The application had to go through multiple departments for vetting, the curator said. “One department called and told us that either these five exhibitors had to be removed, or the whole event would be cancelled, without giving any explanation,” the curator said. In an emailed reply to HKFP on Tuesday, an FEHD spokesperson said the department received Duk6 Duk6’s Temporary Places of Public Entertainment Licence application in early October and is consulting relevant government departments regarding “public order and safety, fire safety, building safety, mechanical and electrical equipment, crowd control, and hygiene.” The FEHD did not confirm whether it or other government departments had barred certain exhibitors from the event. The curator added that the last edition of the book fair, held in early 2025, also encountered censorship against specific exhibitors by venue management. The Duk6 Duk6 book fair in 2025. Photo: Duk6 Duk6. “Given that experience, and seeing how every similar event lately has faced the same roadblocks, we were of course braced for it,” the curator said. “Still, we never imagined five exhibitors would be DQ’d [disqualified] in one go.” The curator said all 125 exhibitors were hand-picked to ensure no AI-generated or plagiarised material was featured, adding that the event’s layout was drafted to bring like-minded artists together. Losing five exhibitors at this stage added significantly to the team’s workload in vetting replacements and threatened to disrupt the carefully planned layout, the curator said. The sudden exclusions also dealt a heavy blow to the vendors, who had spent months preparing to debut new work at the event, the curator said. “Actually everyone wants to continue, but we don’t know where the line is drawn,” the curator said. “And we are not even trying to cross any lines, but even harmless things could be DQ’d.” “The economic environment in recent years has been poor, and coupled with the impact of AI, the entire creative community is facing great challenges,” the curator added. “As organisers, we hope that every creator and their work can be seen. But there’s only so much we can do.”

content: 作者： 徒步的骑手   2026年11月9日   徒步的騎手播客 #244 黄仁勋间谍门 Preview   Listen now   #244 黄仁勋间谍门 黄仁勋触碰了美国哪根高压线？知情不报还是故意视而不见？商业利益与国家安全撞车，谁说了算？｜英伟达48亿美元芯片去了哪里？ 10月29日，《纽约时报》刊发重磅报道，说美国政府正在调查一个名叫黄乐的中国女人，她跟英伟达老板黄仁勋关系密切。黄乐曾经在英伟达的大客户Megaspeed公司担任高管。美国情报机构怀疑，她是中国间谍，涉嫌帮助中国规避美国的AI芯片出口禁令，非法获得英伟达先进芯片。 短短两年中，Megaspeed从英伟达购买了超过48亿美元的芯片。美国情报部门在调查黄乐和Megaspeed公司的时候，发现她跟黄仁勋的关系远远超出一般商业往来。根据《纽约时报》的后续报导，美国情报官员认为，黄乐被中国国家安全部招募，任务就是接近黄仁勋，获取有关英伟达和美国AI芯片政策的情报。 对《纽约时报》的报导，黄仁勋和英伟达先是否认。但美国国会开始采取行动。11月4日，众议院三个委员会的主席联名致函黄仁勋，要求他11月18日到国会接受闭门简报质询。 是哪三个委员会呢？第一，外交事务委员会；第二，美中战略竞争特别委员会；第三，常设情报特别委员会。这里简单提一句，三个委员会的现任主席全部是共和党人。他们要求黄仁勋说明他跟黄乐的关系，英伟达是如何防止外国情报机构渗透的，是不是泄漏过敏感信息。 众议院三个委员会的主席发出质询函以后，黄仁勋和英伟达改了口。11月8日，黄仁勋承认了《纽约时报》报导的绯闻部分。同一天，英伟达董事会宣布，由独立董事组成调查委员会，而且将聘请外部律师，调查黄仁勋是否受到外国情报活动的影响。 美国情报部门和国会要调查的真正问题，不是黄仁勋中了美人计，而是美国的国家安全。具体来说，有这么几点：一是，黄仁勋知不知道黄乐的身份？二是，黄仁勋有没有向她泄漏敏感信息，甚至泄漏机密？第三，他们之间的关系有没有影响英伟达的商业决策？第四，她有没有通过黄仁勋来影响美国政府的芯片出口政策？ 现在，根据美国情报部门的判断，黄仁勋是中国情报活动的目标，但是，除了黄乐，是不是还有其他中国情报人员，也在攻这个目标？他们是不是跟黄乐一样，成功攻下了这个目标？这些问题要看调查结果，现在下结论为时尚早。 不过，我对黄仁勋陷入这场风波，并不觉得特别意外。 几年前，黄仁勋公开叫板拜登政府的芯片出口禁令。当时，我隐隐约约有一种预感，这家伙在玩火。具体说，他在激化一场商业利益与国家安全的冲突。 这场冲突在当时， 就已经受到美国政府职能部门和国会的审视， 而且这种审视肯定会越来越严格。 这几年，英伟达如日中天，它的芯片是AI竞争的命门。中国的土皇帝上台以后，跟美国正面对抗，把美国当成假想敌，美国政府禁止英伟达向中国出口最先进的芯片。禁令一出，中国的各路人马八仙过海，通过第三国、空壳公司、层层转手，想方设法弄英伟达芯片。这些事，媒体一直有报道，美国司法部也起诉过好几起走私案。说黄仁勋对此一无所知，很难让人相信。 美国对中国的芯片管制，是从2022年10月开始的。拜登政府禁止向中国出口最先进的AI芯片。英伟达怎么应对呢？它把芯片性能降一格，刚好卡在管制线下面，造出专供中国市场的A800和H800。2023年10月，美国商务部收紧了标准，这两款也被禁了。英伟达再降一格，又造出H20。2023年12月，当时的商务部长雷蒙多，公开向英伟达喊话：你要是围着管制线兜圈子，设计出来一个，我第二天就禁一个。 英伟达跟美国政府玩这种猫捉老鼠的游戏，玩了好几年。不但如此，黄仁勋还公开向美国政府施压，要求放开对中国的芯片出口。川普上台后，他成功游说川普，放松了对中国的芯片出口管制。2025年4月，他在北京见中国官员，说英伟达会坚定不移服务中国市场。同年5月，他在台北的Computex展会上说：“All in all, the export control was a failure”——“总而言之，出口管制失败了。” 有他在那里上下其手，美国的芯片出口管制当然不会成功。 这里就有个问题。一个掌握美国关键技术的企业家，公开反对美国政府的技术出口限制；同时，他的重要客户涉嫌把芯片非法输送到中国，用各种手段规避出口管制。企业家的商业利益跟国家安全发生冲突的时候，究竟谁说了算？...

title: 黄仁勋婚外情牵出间谍疑云：美中媒体如何讲述同一个故事？
summary: 资料照片：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在北京中国国际供应链博览会开幕式后，被媒体包围。(2025年7月16日) 华盛顿 — 英伟达(Nvidia)首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情，引发美国和中国舆论关注。不过，与一般的企业高管私人生活丑闻不同，这起事件还牵涉有关中国情报活动的指控，以及美国超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)芯片产业面临的国家安全问题。 美国主流媒体的报道主要围绕黄仁勋与一名被怀疑可能与中国情报机构有关的女性有婚外情，并探讨这段关系是否可能涉及商业机密泄露，甚至危及美国国家安
content: 资料照片：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在北京中国国际供应链博览会开幕式后，被媒体包围。(2025年7月16日) 华盛顿 — 英伟达(Nvidia)首席执行官黄仁勋承认婚外情，引发美国和中国舆论关注。不过，与一般的企业高管私人生活丑闻不同，这起事件还牵涉有关中国情报活动的指控，以及美国超级智能(通常称人工智能或AI)芯片产业面临的国家安全问题。 美国主流媒体的报道主要围绕黄仁勋与一名被怀疑可能与中国情报机构有关的女性有婚外情，并探讨这段关系是否可能涉及商业机密泄露，甚至危及美国国家安全。 中国官方媒体则采取了明显不同的报道角度。它们提及黄仁勋的婚外情，但着重质疑有关中国间谍活动的说法，指责西方媒体借此炒作中国威胁论，甚至可能试图破坏美中关系。 美媒：从私人关系延伸到国家安全 美国《纽约时报》、《华尔街日报》以及其他西方媒体的报道，将这起事件置于美国与中国围绕超级智能技术展开竞争的大背景下。 相关报道指出，与黄仁勋有关系的女性黄乐(Alice Huang)据称与一家总部位于新加坡的数据中心企业超速国际(Megaspeed International)有关联。这家公司涉及英伟达先进超级智能芯片的商业活动，因此引起美国方面的关注。 《纽约时报》报道说，美国情报部门怀疑黄乐可能与中国情报机构存在联系，并向北京提供过信息。不过，这些指控目前尚未通过公开的司法程序得到证实。 《华尔街日报》星期一(11月9日)以时间线方式，详细报道从与黄乐有关的Megaspeed于2023年从一家中国公司分拆成立开始，回顾黄仁勋与黄乐在2024年、2025年同场出现，以及美国商务部随后调查Megaspeed是否将英伟达先进芯片转运至中国。 报道还梳理了特朗普政府对英伟达对华出口政策的讨论，以及美国情报部门在2026年春季向政府高层传阅机密备忘录的说法。到了11月8日，黄仁勋承认对妻子不忠，英伟达董事会随即启动独立调查。 黄仁勋事件之所以引人关注，与英伟达在美国科技产业和国家安全领域的重要地位密切相关。 作为全球领先的超级智能芯片制造商，英伟达不仅是美国科技产业的重要企业，也处于华盛顿对华高科技出口管制政策争论的中心。 黄仁勋过去多次公开反对过度限制美国企业向中国市场销售先进芯片，认为过于严厉的出口限制可能削弱美国企业的竞争力，同时推动中国加快发展自己的半导体产业。 目前没有公开证据证明黄仁勋明知对方从事情报活动，也没有确凿证据表明英伟达的商业机密已经因此泄露。 中国官方媒体：质疑间谍指控，强调政治动机 中国官方媒体对这起事件的报道呈现出明显不同的侧重点，主要通过否认和质疑间谍指控，批评美国媒体的报道方式及其背后的政治动机。 中国官媒《环球时报》将事件与当前美中关系联系起来，质疑有关指控出现的时机，认为有关报道可能意在制造美中之间的对立。 《环球时报》星期一发布题为《黄仁勋出轨，还能扯上中国？》的快评，称这一事件“让美国媒体为之疯狂”，并批评《纽约时报》有关黄仁勋婚外情对象可能是中国间谍的报道捕风捉影。 《环球时报》写道：“仅仅是几张有东方面孔的照片、英伟达此前推动放宽对华贸易限制的行动，在其中加入了所谓“知情人士”的话和媒体的“怀疑”，就足以将事情添油加醋为“中国女间谍渗透美国芯片公司”。向来自诩“客观”的美国媒体正是这样生产故事的。” 环球之后说，在美中关系趋于缓和之际，出现此类新闻，是有些人“在背后放冷枪”。 这篇评论随后被凤凰网、新浪、网易、腾讯等多家中国媒体转载，使其观点在中国网络媒体上得到进一步传播。 与美国媒体相比，这些报道较少深入讨论美国情报部门提出的具体疑点，也没有将相关情报指控作为报道的主要调查方向。报道的重点更多放在质疑美国媒体的消息来源、证据基础以及报道动机上。 中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆星期一在回应有关报道时，也否认中国从事相关间谍活动，称“所谓‘中国间谍’的论调纯属捕风捉影，污蔑抹黑。” 中国社交媒体：对婚外情的关注不亚于间谍疑云 中国社交媒体上的讨论则呈现出更加多元的面貌。 微博上，部分网民对黄仁勋的私人生活表示惊讶或失望。黄仁勋长期以来在中国科技界和商业界拥有较高知名度，不少中国公众将他视为华人科技企业家的代表人物。 在小红书上，除了讨论黄仁勋的婚外情及其可能涉及的间谍疑云，也有不少网友关注事件对英伟达股价的影响。 星期一早间，英伟达股价一度下跌超过8%，引发投资者讨论。有网友调侃说：“他犯的错，我买单。” 这些讨论显示，对不少中国网民来说，黄仁勋的私人生活、公众形象以及英伟达的市场表现，都是这起事件值得关注的方面。相比之下，间谍指控并非所有讨论的中心。

title: USNI News Western Pacific Pulse: Nov. 6, 2026

content:
以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。在新加坡 西奥多·罗斯福号航母战斗群于周五驶入新加坡进行港口访问。该打击群包括西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰（CVN-71）及其第11舰载机联队（CVW）、长津号巡洋舰（CG-65）以及保罗·汉密尔顿号驱逐舰（DDG-60）和迪凯特号（DDG-73）。西奥多·罗斯福号、长津号和保罗·汉密尔顿号停靠在樟宜海军基地，而迪凯特号则停靠在三巴旺。预计该打击群将在港口访问后穿过马六甲海峡前往中东。上周末，西奥多·罗斯福号CSG与舰队加油船USNS Tippecanoe (T-AO-199)在菲律宾和南中国海与日本海上自卫队(JMSDF)驱逐舰JS Onami (DD-111)进行了跨甲板和通信演习。 2026 年 11 月 4 日，尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 在南海与澳大利亚皇家海军供应级补给油船 HMAS Stalwart (A304) 进行海上补给。美国海军照片澳大利亚皇家海军舰队加油船 HMAS Stalwart (A304) 正在南海执行澳大利亚皇家海军的区域存在部署。周三，西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰与“坚定”号进行了海上补给。美国海军还发布了一段 RAS 的视频。在菲律宾海 十一月发布的一张图片
2026 年 12 月 3 日，台湾国家安全委员会秘书长吴钊燮发表。 台湾国家安全委员会图片 根据台湾国家安全委员会秘书长吴钊燮发布的图片，截至周三，辽宁舰航母战斗群正在吕宋岛东北部的菲律宾海执行任务。辽宁舰CSG包括辽宁号航空母舰（16艘）、鞍山号巡洋舰（101艘）和无锡号巡洋舰（104艘）以及淮南号驱逐舰（123艘）。日本横须贺 日本海上自卫队上尉 Nakazawa Noriya，巡逻和防卫第一中队指挥官，印度海军中将 A.N.美国海军副参谋长普拉莫德、美国海军第七舰队司令帕特·汉尼芬中将、日本海上自卫队多任务隐形护卫舰最上号（FFM 1）舰长吉田胜也、澳大利亚皇家海军少将澳大利亚舰队司令安妮塔·威廉姆斯和日本海上自卫队总司令、自卫队中将大町克志在船上会面2026 年马拉巴尔演习期间，最上位于日本横须贺，2026 年 11 月 5 日。美国海军照片 美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度于周四拉开了 2026 年马拉巴尔四方演习的序幕，参与演习的舰艇目前停靠在港口，进行岸上演习阶段。日本海上自卫队派出直升机驱逐舰 JS Ise (DDH-182)、护卫舰 JS Mogami (FFM-1)、一艘潜艇和一架 P-1 海上巡逻机参加演习。
印度海军部署了 INS Sahyadri (F49) 护卫舰，澳大利亚将部署 HMAS Stuart (FFH153) 护卫舰和澳大利亚皇家空军 P-8A Poseidon MPA。美国将派出两栖运输船坞舰 USS Anchorage (LPD-23) 和 USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) 以及 P-8A Poseidon MPA 参加。安克雷奇和约翰·P·穆萨号两栖攻击舰以及马金岛号两栖攻击舰 (LHD-8) 和组成马金岛两栖准备大队的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队，该部队自 10 月 26 日起一直停靠在横须贺进行港口访问。拉尔夫·约翰逊号驱逐舰 (DDG-114) 返回其指挥官舰队活动的母港

The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week. In Singapore The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group pulled into Singapore on Friday for a port visit. The strike group includes aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) with embarked carrier air wing (CVW) 11, cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65) and destroyers USS Paul Hamilton (DDG-60) and USS Decatur (DDG-73). Theodore Roosevelt, Chosin and Paul Hamilton docked into Changi Naval Base while Decatur docked into Sembawang. The strike group is expected to transit the Malacca Strait to head to the Middle East following the port visit. Last weekend , the Theodore Roosevelt CSG with fleet oiler USNS Tippecanoe (T-AO-199) carried out cross deck and communication exercises with Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF) destroyer JS Onami (DD-111) in the Philippine and South China seas. In the South China Sea Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) conducts a replenishment-at-sea with Royal Australian Navy Supply-class replenishment oiler HMAS Stalwart (A304), Nov. 4, 2026. US Navy photo Royal Australian Navy fleet oiler HMAS Stalwart (A304) is operating in the South China Sea for the Royal Australian Navy’s regional presence deployment. content:
香港：人权组织谴责对黄之锋的不公正判决 zevans@freedom… 星期四，11/05/2026 - 15:23 输入联合声明 国家香港页面屏蔽 我们，以下签名组织，谴责香港高等法院 11 月 5 日对香港民主倡导者黄之锋判处 10 年徒刑。这是他第二次根据北京实施的国家安全法被判刑，该法导致香港的基本自由迅速恶化。三周前，约书亚在监狱里度过了自己的 30 岁生日，十几岁时，他作为学生团体学民思潮的联合创始人而声名鹊起，该团体反对将亲北京的宣传引入香港学校。他帮助领导了 2014 年历史性的雨伞运动，并于 2016 年创建了亲民主的众志党，该党在 2020 年《国家安全法》获得批准后被迫解散。他因其民主行动主义而获得国际赞誉，包括多次获得诺贝尔和平奖提名。由于这种宣传，约书亚一再入狱，自2020年11月以来一直被拘留。2024年，他因参加第一次也是唯一一次全市民主初选而被以阴谋颠覆罪判处四年零八个月监禁。
他预计将于 2027 年 1 月获释，但在 2025 年 6 月面临额外指控，罪名是因之前的活动而与外国势力合谋。 作为这些指控的一部分，检察官提到了约书亚与美国政府官员（包括当时的参议员马可·卢比奥）的会面。这是中国共产党一系列令人担忧的尝试之一，不仅限制和控制中国公民和香港人可以会见哪些人，还限制和控制外国政府官员可以联系谁以及他们可以收到哪些信息。此外，北京支持的香港政府强烈劝阻居民观看并考虑对获奖纪录片《约书亚：青少年与超级大国》采取进一步行动，该片记录了约书亚早期的活动，进一步表明其压制香港民主运动独立报道的努力。约书亚的拘留也凸显了中共如何继续藐视《中英联合声明》。该条约是 1997 年香港主权移交过程​​中谈判达成的，其中规定了“一国两种制度”的原则，该原则本应持续到 2047 年。中共对这一原则的漠视——约书亚因行使基本自由而被拘留就证明了这一点——令人质疑中共在贸易或其他问题上谈判达成的协议是否会得到遵守。
我们呼吁香港当局立即无条件释放约书亚，并要求民主政府更有力地要求释放他。具体来说，我们要求白宫和国务院承诺在唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平即将举行的双边会晤中提出约书亚的案件并呼吁释放他，特别是在我们即将于11月在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）会议和12月在佛罗里达州举行的20国集团（G20）峰会之际。特朗普政府在优先释放世界各地政治犯方面做了值得称赞的工作。政治犯金明日牧师从中国拘留所获释

Hong Kong: Human Rights Organizations Condemn Unjust Sentencing of Joshua Wong zevans@freedom… Thu, 11/05/2026 - 15:23 Type Joint Statement Countries Hong Kong Page blocks We, the undersigned organizations, condemn the November 5th sentencing of Hong Kong prodemocracy advocate Joshua Wong to a 10-year sentence by the Hong Kong High Court. This is the second time he has been sentenced under the Beijing-imposed National Security Law (NSL), which has contributed to the rapid deterioration of basic freedoms in Hong Kong. Joshua, who marked his 30th birthday in prison three weeks ago, rose to prominence as a teenager as the cofounder of the student group Scholarism, which opposed the introduction of pro-Beijing propaganda into Hong Kong's schools. He helped lead the historic 2014 Umbrella Movement and in 2016 created the prodemocracy Demosistō party, which was forced to disband after the approval of the NSL in 2020. He has received international acclaim for his democratic activism, including multiple nominations for the Nobel Peace Prize. As a result of this advocacy, Joshua has been repeatedly imprisoned, and has been detained continuously since November 2020. In 2024, he was sentenced to four years and eight months’ imprisonment on charges of conspiracy to commit subversion in connection with him taking part in the first and only city-wide democratic primary. He was expected to be released in January 2027, but faced additional charges in June 2025 of conspiring to collude with foreign forces for his earlier activism. As part of these charges, prosecutors referred to meetings that Joshua had with US government officials, including then Senator Marco Rubio. This is among a worrying series of attempts by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to restrict and control not only who Chinese citizens and Hong Kongers may meet, but also who foreign government officials may contact and what information they can receive. Additionally, the Beijing-backed Hong Kong government is strongly discouraging residents from viewing and considering further action on the award-winning documentary Joshua: Teenager vs. Superpower, which chronicles Joshua's early activism, further demonstrating its efforts to suppress independent accounts of Hong Kong's prodemocracy movement. Joshua's detention also highlights how the CCP continues to flout the Sino-British Joint Declaration. That treaty, negotiated as part of Hong Kong's 1997 handover, enshrines the "one country, two systems" principle that was supposed to prevail until 2047. The CCP's disregard for that principle—demonstrated by Joshua's detention for exercising his fundamental freedoms—calls into question whether deals the CCP negotiates on trade or other issues will be honored. We call on Hong Kong authorities to release Joshua immediately and unconditionally, and we ask that democratic governments more forcefully demand his release. Specifically, we request that the White House and the State Department commit to raising Joshua’s case and calling for his release in the upcoming bilateral meetings between President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, particularly as we look to the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting in November in Shenzhen, and the Group of 20 (G20) Summit in Florida in December. The Trump administration has done a commendable job prioritizing the release of political prisoners around the world. The release of political prisoner Pastor Ezra Jin Mingri from detention in China earlier this year demonstrates that when the president of the United States intervenes directly, it can make a real, lifesaving difference.
