title: How China gets the Nvidia chips it needs to develop AI
zh_title: 中国如何获得开发人工智能所需的英伟达芯片
summary: 据报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一家新加坡公司的一名中国高管有染，美国怀疑该公司向中国走私人工智能微芯片。 Nvidia 的 H200 芯片。照片：英伟达。该丑闻将人们的注意力集中在中国这个人工智能大国如何在美国的出口限制下获得尖端芯片。为什么 Nvidia 芯片如此重要？ Nvidia 设计的先进组件最初是为了处理视频游戏中的 3D 视觉效果而设计的，称为图形处理单元 (GPU)。这些有能力粉碎巨大的情绪
content:
据报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一家新加坡公司的一名中国高管有染，美国怀疑该公司向中国走私人工智能微芯片。 Nvidia 的 H200 芯片。照片：英伟达。该丑闻将人们的注意力集中在中国这个人工智能大国如何在美国的出口限制下获得尖端芯片。为什么 Nvidia 芯片如此重要？ Nvidia 设计的先进组件最初是为了处理视频游戏中的 3D 视觉效果而设计的，称为图形处理单元 (GPU)。它们能够处理大量数字数据，因此也可大规模用于训练和运行人工智能。 ChatGPT 于 2022 年推出，展示了人工智能的潜力，随着政府和科技巨头竞相进一步开发该技术，引发了投资淘金热。 Nvidia 总部位于加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉。照片：英伟达。随着芯片订单的涌入，英伟达的市值已飙升至 4.5 万亿美元，目前与苹果并列全球市值最高的两家公司。美国限制哪些芯片？由于先进人工智能具有军事应用，华盛顿以安全考虑为由，禁止英伟达高端“Blackwell”和“Rubin”GPU出口到中国。该政策还让美国顶级人工智能实验室保持全球领先地位。
黄仁勋游说美国政府允许 Nvidia 芯片销售到中国，并警告说这些限制正在推动具有竞争力的本土替代品的崛起。Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 5 月 19 日在台湾台北举行的 Computex 2025 上发表主题演讲。照片：Nvidia。今年，华盛顿放松了对 Nvidia 之前被禁止且功能较弱的“H200”芯片的控制，美国的销售额减少了 25%。但美国的条件使得发货很难获得批准，据报道，随着中国自己的芯片行业发展势头强劲，北京方面也不愿购买 H200。中国如何获得芯片？中国初创公司最近推出的高性能模型，包括 Moonshot AI、Z.ai 和 DeepSeek，给美国竞争对手带来了压力。 Omdia 首席分析师 Lian Jye Su 告诉法新社，尽管有控制措施，“中国供应商仍在使用先进的 Nvidia 芯片来训练他们的模型”。芯片可能被走私到该国，或者通过一个漏洞获得，该漏洞允许中国公司在第三国（通常是东南亚）的装有英伟达芯片的数据中心出租计算能力。深探。照片：Matheus Bertelli/Pexels。迦太基资本投资基金创始人斯蒂芬·吴解释说：“美国的出口管制限制了芯片的运输地点，而不是使用它的人。”吴告诉法新社，这意味着 Nvidia GPU 可以安装在马来西亚的柔佛地区，“在深圳的客户登录时完全符合要求”。
白宫顾问 Michael Kratsios 今年夏天表示，Moonshot AI 已在泰国访问了 Nvidia 的高端芯片。另请参阅：被指控监视 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋的中国科技高管 Alice Huang 是谁？华盛顿还指责中国人工智能实验室的训练系统模仿美国模型的能力。还有一个大问题是走私。科技媒体 The Information 去年 12 月表示，DeepSeek 使用数千块在海外拆解并运回中国的芯片开发了其新模型。 DeepSeek 当时没有回应评论请求。英伟达告诉 The Information，他们还没有看到此类走私的证据，这“似乎有些遥远”

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to having an affair, reportedly with a Chinese executive at a Singapore-based company that the United States suspects of smuggling AI microchips into China. Nvidia’s H200 chips. Photo: Nvidia. The scandal has focused attention on how China, a major artificial-intelligence power in itself, obtains the cutting-edge chips despite US export restrictions. Why are Nvidia chips so important? Nvidia designs advanced components originally created to handle 3D visuals in video games, called Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). These have the power to crunch colossal amounts of digital data, so are also used at scale to train and run artificial intelligence. ChatGPT’s 2022 launch showcased the potential of AI, sparking an investment gold rush as governments and tech giants raced to develop the technology further. Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California. Photo: Nvidia. With chip orders pouring in, Nvidia’s market valuation has soared to $4.5 trillion — currently on par with Apple as the world’s two most valuable companies. Which chips does the US restrict? Washington bans the export of Nvidia’s top-end “Blackwell” and “Rubin” GPUs to China, citing security concerns, as advanced AI has military applications. The policy also allows the United States’s top AI labs to maintain their global lead. Huang has lobbied the US government to allow Nvidia chip sales to China, warning that the restrictions are fuelling the rise of competitive homegrown alternatives. Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang gives a keynote speech at Computex 2025 in Taipei, Taiwan, on May 19, 2025. Photo: Nvidia. This year Washington eased controls on Nvidia’s previously banned — and less powerful — “H200” chip, with the United States taking a 25 percent cut of sales. But US conditions have made it difficult for shipments to be approved, with Beijing also reportedly reluctant to buy H200s as its own chip industry gains momentum. How does China get its chips? Recent launches of high-performing models from Chinese startups, including Moonshot AI, Z.ai and DeepSeek, have turned up the heat on US rivals. “Chinese vendors are still using cutting-edge Nvidia chips to train their models” despite the controls, Lian Jye Su, a chief analyst at Omdia, told AFP. Chips may be smuggled into the country, or accessed through a loophole that allows Chinese firms to rent out computing power at data centres stuffed with Nvidia chips in a third nation, often Southeast Asian. Deepseek. Photo: Matheus Bertelli/Pexels. “US export controls restrict where a chip is shipped, not who uses it,” explained Stephen Wu, founder of the Carthage Capital investment fund. That means Nvidia GPUs can sit in Malaysia’s Johor region, for example, “in full compliance while a customer in Shenzhen logs in”, Wu told AFP. White House adviser Michael Kratsios said this summer that Moonshot AI had accessed high-end Nvidia chips in Thailand. See also: Who is Alice Huang, the Chinese tech executive accused of spying on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang? Washington has also accused Chinese AI labs of training systems to mimic the capabilities of US models. And then there is the big question of smuggling. Tech outlet The Information said in December that DeepSeek developed its new model using thousands of chips dismantled overseas and brought into China. DeepSeek did not respond to a comment request at the time. Nvidia told The Information they had not seen evidence of such smuggling which “seems far-fetched”. How about Chinese chips? “Nvidia chips still make top-level AI work faster and easier, but they are no longer the only path,” said Poe Zhao, founder of analysis publication Hello China Tech. “The open question is cost” as “training on Chinese chips usually takes more time and more engineering”. Huawei is China’s top Nvidia competitor, although it lags behind the US titan, and DeepSeek will reportedly train its next major AI model on Huawei chips. Huawei headquarters in Shenzhen. Photo: Huawei. “Chinese-made chips are improving fast”, Su said, with more collaborations likely to come. Huawei said in September its next-generation AI chip would be ready in the first quarter of 2027, three quarters earlier than planned. To boost the power of Chinese-made chips, AI companies need to use more of them, Wu said. “They pay for it in power and cost — which they can afford, because Chinese electricity is cheap and the chips are state-subsidised.”

title: 香港禁片《消失的檔案》揭露四大核心內幕
summary: Eric Chau 臉書 2026-11-8 香港禁片《消失的檔案》（Vanished Archives）是由香港資深傳媒人羅恩惠執導、歷時四年苦心搜集資料而完成的紀錄片。 這部影片之所以命名為「消失的檔案」，是因為導演當初在香港歷史檔案館搜集「六七暴動」的官方影像紀錄時，驚覺原應長達數百小時的歷史片段，在香港竟然只剩下殘缺不全的21秒。 為了尋回被刻意或無意抹去的歷史真相，羅恩惠遠赴英國國家檔案館翻查解密文件，並親自訪問了大量當年的親歷者。這部紀錄片最終揭露了多項關於196
content: Eric Chau   臉書  2026-11-8 香港禁片《消失的檔案》（Vanished Archives）是由香港資深傳媒人羅恩惠執導、歷時四年苦心搜集資料而完成的紀錄片。 這部影片之所以命名為「消失的檔案」，是因為導演當初在香港歷史檔案館搜集「六七暴動」的官方影像紀錄時，驚覺原應長達數百小時的歷史片段，在香港竟然只剩下殘缺不全的21秒。 為了尋回被刻意或無意抹去的歷史真相，羅恩惠遠赴英國國家檔案館翻查解密文件，並親自訪問了大量當年的親歷者。這部紀錄片最終揭露了多項關於1967年香港暴動事件、極具震撼力的內幕消息與歷史黑幕： 紀錄片揭露的四大核心內幕 1. 核心絕密文獻：《吳荻舟日記》與《67筆記》 影片最關鍵的歷史突破，是找到了當年國務院外事辦公室港澳組副組長吳荻舟的私人筆記與檢討材料。 中央高層直接介入： 過去有說法指六七暴動純屬香港左派造反派（如新華社香港分社）自導自演的盲動。但《67筆記》證實，北京中央政府對香港暴亂的每一個細節其實一直知情，甚至不時發出具體指示。 截獲「真槍實彈」： 筆記記載，當時有左派激進分子試圖從內地運送8,400把滅火刀（砍刀）到香港發動武裝暴動。這批物資最終被吳荻舟及時攔截，他因此在文革中遭到迫害。這證實當時暴動確實有演變成全面血腥武裝衝突的奪權計畫。 2. 揭開「少年犯」與「炸彈隊」的真實代價 六七暴動後期發展成無差別的恐怖主義炸彈襲擊，街道上到處都是俗稱「菠蘿」的土製炸彈。 被煽動的愛國學生： 影片訪問了多位當年的左派學校學生（如香島中學、培僑中學等）。他們在文革狂熱的政治宣傳下被煽動組織「炸彈隊」，抱著「反英抗暴」的愛國熱忱上街投擲炸彈、派發傳單。 被拋棄的犧牲品： 這些年輕人在入獄後遭到港英政府的嚴刑拷打，甚至被秘密政治部審訊。然而，當暴動被周恩來叫停、事件平息後，中共高層為了重回外交正軌，迅速與這些基層左派「割席」。這些留有案底的年輕人被港英政府與中共雙方拋棄，政治狂熱退去後，換來的是大半生的坎坷與幻滅。 3. 港共地下黨的權力鬥爭與盲動 紀錄片揭示，這場暴動本質上是中國文化大革命在香港的外延與投影。當時新華社香港分社（實際上的港共地下黨組織）社長梁威林、副社長祁烽等人，為迎合內地文革「造反有理」的風潮，並在外交部奪權鬥爭中表態，不惜在香港無限放大勞資糾紛（新蒲崗人造花廠事件），刻意將其升級為流血政治對抗。 4. 歷史敘事權的爭奪與「改寫」 這部影片最深遠的內幕，莫過於揭露了官方對歷史記憶的系統性清洗。 港英政府的處理： 六七暴動結束後，英國政府將大量極度敏感的政治部（Political Department）檔案、港共滲透名單及審訊紀錄運回英國本土，或直接銷毀，導致香港本地檔案館出現巨大斷層。 特區政府的洗白： 導演指出，近年來特區政府及建制陣營正試圖「重塑」這段歷史，淡化無差別炸彈襲擊對平民造成的傷害，將其重新包裝成「反殖民統治的愛國正義抗爭」。《消失的檔案》則透過血淋淋的受害者證詞（如商業電台林彬被活活燒死、北角小姊弟被炸彈炸死的家屬訪問），還原了這場運動曾演變成無差別恐怖襲擊的史實。 影片的遭遇與社會餘波 由於影片赤裸裸地曝光了中共與港共組織在歷史上的操弄與滲透，《消失的檔案》在2017年完成後遭遇了極大的政治壓力： 官方及商業電影院拒絕放映，香港國際電影節亦以「缺乏藝術性」為由將其拒之門外。 儘管遭受封殺，導演依然在香港社區、學校及海外（美、加、台）進行了數百場獨立放映，引發極大反響，被歷史學者視為還原香港當代史最重要的民間口述紀錄片。 歷史猶如一面鏡子，五十年前內地與香港的政治糾葛，與今日香港的政治變遷有著絲絲入扣的歷史脈絡。羅恩惠導演曾表示，拍攝這部影片不為挑起仇恨，而是為了「守護香港記憶，不讓真相在掌權者的橡皮擦下消失」。

title: Our Best Look Yet at China’s GJ-11 UCAV
zh_title: 我们对中国 GJ-11 无人战斗机的最佳观察
summary: 在解放军空军成立 77 周年之前发布的新官方镜头揭示了 GJ-11 设计和配置的更多细节。中国于 2026 年 11 月 9 日发布了 GJ-11“利剑”无人机 (UCAV) 的新官方视频，揭示了其设计和配置的更多特点。这一发布是在 11 月 11 日中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 成立 77 周年纪念日的前两天发布的。去年同一天，PLAAF 发布了首个视频，显示 GJ-11 与一架 J-20 和一架 J-16D 电子战机编队飞行
content:
在解放军空军成立 77 周年之前发布的新官方镜头揭示了 GJ-11 设计和配置的更多细节。中国于 2026 年 11 月 9 日发布了 GJ-11“利剑”无人机 (UCAV) 的新官方视频，揭示了其设计和配置的更多特点。这一发布是在 11 月 11 日中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 成立 77 周年纪念日的前两天发布的。去年同一天，PLAAF 发布了首个视频，显示 GJ-11 与一架 J-20 和一架 J-16D 电子战 (EW) 飞机编队飞行。 GJ-11 通常被认为与美国协同作战飞机 (CCA) 的作用相当。 #PLAAF GJ-11 出现在空军宣传视频中。 https://t.co/hPS8qG5jWv — Iron Lady (@nuwangzi) 2026 年 11 月 9 日 GJ-11 忠诚僚机的新镜头最新的视觉效果可以更仔细地观察 GJ-11 的机身和表面光洁度，尽管其涂层的成分无法仅从镜头中确定。 《环球时报》援引中国军事专家宋忠平的话说，该飞机使用雷达吸收材料（RAM）涂层来减小雷达截面积。 GJ-11 似乎是一种相对高端、专注于隐形的 UCAV，而不是一种成本较低、可能易磨损的平台。
在这方面，它可能更类似于洛克希德·马丁公司与 Vectis 合作开发的高性能飞机类型，而不是美国空军第一个增量中追求的更注重负担能力的 CCA 概念，例如 FQ-42A 复仇和 FQ-44A 狂怒。 GJ-11 离开机库。 |资料来源：解放军空军 与 2025 年 11 月的周年纪念影片相比，新镜头更近距离地展示了 GJ-11，该影片显示无人战斗机与一架 J-20 和一架 J-16D 编队飞行。 2025 年 10 月发布的卫星图像已经表明存在多个机身，显示西藏日喀则空军基地有三架 GJ-11。该飞机也是中国发展有人与无人协作能力的更广泛努力的一部分。 J-20S 是世界上第一款两座第五代战斗机，于 2021 年首次亮相，通常被评估为此类行动的潜在机载指挥和控制平台，尽管 2025 年 11 月的镜头显示单座 J-20 也可以与 GJ-11 协调。 Çin Hava Kuvvetleri，GJ-11 hayalet taarruz ïHA’sının yakın çekim gorüntülerini yayımladı。 Görüntülerin，GJ-21 是一种电气设备，可通过视频设备进行操作。
https://t.co/imBIWOwV5h — Enis Şenol (@senolenis) 2026 年 11 月 9 日 GJ-11 最显着的特点之一是其扁平的屏蔽排气出口，集成到飞翼机身的后上部分。加上背部进气口和没有外部喷嘴，这种布置似乎是为了减少飞机的雷达和红外特征。中国军事专家宋忠平表示，排气喷嘴经过特殊处理以提高隐身性，但具体设计细节及其效果尚未透露。该飞机的配置表明低可观测性是一个主要的设计优先事项，但其实际的机动性和飞行性能仍然未知。第一张图：GJ-11 UCAV 喷嘴 第二张图：GJ-11 EOTS 和锯齿状机腹舱门。 https://t.co/NSj7vAdfeb —

【原文 English Original】
New official footage released ahead of the PLA Air Force’s 77th anniversary reveals additional details of the GJ-11’s design and configuration. China released new official footage of the GJ-11 ‘Sharp Sword’ unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) on Nov. 9, 2026, revealing additional features of its design and configuration. The release came two days before the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) on Nov. 11. On the same date last year, the PLAAF released its first footage showing the GJ-11 flying in formation with a J-20 and a J-16D Electronic Warfare (EW) aircraft. The GJ-11 is often considered to be equivalent in role to the U.S. Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA). #PLAAF GJ-11 is featured in an Air Force promotional video. https://t.co/hPS8qG5jWv — Iron Lady (@nuwangzi) November 9, 2026 New footage of the GJ-11 loyal wingman The latest visuals provide a closer look at the GJ-11’s airframe and surface finish, although the composition of its coating cannot be determined from the footage alone. Chinese military affairs expert Song Zhongping, quoted by Global Times , said the aircraft uses Radar Absorbent Material (RAM) coatings to reduce its radar cross-section. The GJ-11 appears to be a relatively high-end, stealth-focused UCAV, rather than a lower-cost, potentially attritable platform. In this respect, it could be more comparable to the type of high-capability aircraft Lockheed Martin is developing with Vectis than to the more affordability-focused CCA concepts being pursued under the U.S. Air Force’s first increment, such as the FQ-42A Vengeance and the FQ-44A Fury . The GJ-11 leaving the hangar. | Source: PLA Air Force The new footage provides a closer look at the GJ-11 than the November 2025 anniversary film, which showed the UCAV flying in formation with a J-20 and a J-16D. The existence of multiple airframes had already been indicated by satellite imagery published in October 2025, showing three GJ-11s at Shigatse Air Base in Tibet. The aircraft is also part of China’s broader effort to develop manned-unmanned teaming capabilities. The J-20S, the world’s first two-seat fifth generation fighter first revealed in 2021, is often assessed as a potential airborne command-and-control platform for such operations, although the November 2025 footage demonstrated that a single-seat J-20 could also coordinate with the GJ-11. Çin Hava Kuvvetleri, GJ-11 hayalet taarruz İHA’sının yakın çekim görüntülerini yayımladı. Görüntülerin, GJ-21 İHA’sının elektromanyetik katapultla fırlatılışını gösteren yeni bir videonun habercisi olabileceği değerlendiriliyor. https://t.co/imBIWOwV5h — Enis Şenol (@senolenis) November 9, 2026 One of the GJ-11’s most distinctive features is its flattened, shielded exhaust outlet, integrated into the upper rear section of the flying-wing airframe. Together with the dorsal air intake and the absence of external nozzles, this arrangement appears intended to reduce the aircraft’s radar and infrared signatures. Chinese military affairs expert Song Zhongping said the exhaust nozzle had received special treatment to improve stealth, although the precise details of the design and its effectiveness have not been disclosed. The aircraft’s configuration suggests that low observability was a major design priority, but its actual maneuverability and flight performance remain unknown. 1st pic: GJ-11 UCAV nozzle 2nd pic:  GJ-11 EOTS and serated belly bay doors. https://t.co/NSj7vAdfeb — dafeng cao (@dafengcao) November 9, 2026 As in the November 2025 footage, the GJ-11 is shown from several angles inside a hangar. A front-facing sequence showing the hangar doors opening and the aircraft being towed out, followed by a brief view from underneath, appears to have been reused from the earlier video. The November 2025 footage also shows a protective cover for Foreign Object Debris (FOD) fitted over the dorsal air intake, along with several red covers over other areas of the forward fuselage. In the latest visuals, showing a top view of the GJ-11 exiting the hangar, the protective covers visible in the November 2025 footage are absent. Several small diamond-shaped features can also be seen along the upper fuselage and wings, although their function is unclear. The apparent chin-mounted electro-optical sensor, glimpsed briefly in the November 2025 footage, is also visible in greater detail in the new close-up shots inside the hangar. The trapezoidal fairing visible beneath the nose appears to house an electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor. Its exact configuration and capabilities have not been publicly disclosed, and the available imagery is insufficient to establish whether it incorporates Infra-Red Search and Track (IRST) or Electro-Optical Tracking System (EOTS) functions for both air-to-air and air-to-ground roles. PLAAF成立76周年記念動画内にて公開されたGJ-11 ステルスUCAV。 部隊運用機の公式メディアでの公開はこれが初ですが、実際には数年前から部隊運用中。 動画内で有人機との協調飛行中のGJ-11に与えられたコードは”玄龙”。 なおGJ-11は派生型として海軍向け艦載機型のGJ-21が存在。 https://t.co/WBunfUg79x — お砂糖wsnbn (@sugar_wsnbn) November 11, 2025 Weapons bays and landing gear The latest footage also shows the GJ-11’s two internal weapons bays on the underside of the fuselage, positioned between the main landing gear and covered by separate sets of doors. Glo bal Times reported that the aircraft’s two belly bays were previously displayed during Airshow China 2021, “each holding several precision-guided bombs.” A brief front-facing segment shows the aircraft during its takeoff run, while side and rear views capture the landing gear retracting after liftoff. The November 2025 video also showed the GJ-11 taking off, although the landing gear remained extended in the available footage. A screengrab showing the main landing gear, a partly open internal weapons-bay door and the apparent chin-mounted electro-optical sensor. | Source: PLA Air Force One segment showing the GJ-11 inside the hangar provides another view of the main landing gear, which appears close to the outer weapons-bay door . The same shot also shows what appears to be a slightly open weapons-bay door, with its serrated edge visible. However, the available angle does not clearly establish how the landing gear folds or whether the aircraft represents a different configuration. It is therefore not possible to determine whether this is another airframe or a prototype. First time getting a look at the PLAAF GJ-11 UCAV’s belly. https://t.co/jgkFiXUr4E — dafeng cao (@dafengcao) November 10, 2026 Another screenshot circulating on Chinese social media appears to show three additional flying-wing aircraft parked behind the GJ-11s, although their identities and configurations cannot be confirmed from the available image. Red boxes highlight what looks like GJ-11s parked behind the one featured in the video in the edited screenshot circulating online. | Source: PLA Air Force According to CCTV, the Nov. 9 coverage also revealed that the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission. The broadcaster did not disclose when or where the mission took place, the target involved or the weapon used, although the report nevertheless offers a clearest indication of the GJ-11’s strike capabilities. The new footage therefore provides more than just a closer look at the GJ-11’s low-observable design. Combined with the PLAAF’s November 2025 formation footage and the latest report of a first live-fire strike mission, it offers further evidence that the UCAV has progressed beyond the prototype and testing stages. Further details about its operational deployment, weapons and manned-unmanned teaming capabilities, however, remain undisclosed. It remains to be seen whether China will release additional footage of the GJ-11 or its naval derivative, the GJ-21 , before the end of the year.

title: 英伟达股价再次下滑，CEO黄仁勋面临诉讼及FBI调查
summary: 在华盛顿美国和平研究所举行的一场活动中，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在唐纳德·特朗普总统发言时倾听。(2026年10月8日) 英伟达(Nvidia)股价星期二(11月10日)连续第二天走低，这家位于美国的半导体公司首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)同时面临股东诉讼，并承受着来自国会日益增长的压力。 此次抛售的前一天，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)说，联邦调查局(FBI)正在调查黄仁勋与女商人黄乐(Alice Huang)之间的关系；美国情报部门认定，这
content: 在华盛顿美国和平研究所举行的一场活动中，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在唐纳德·特朗普总统发言时倾听。(2026年10月8日) 英伟达(Nvidia)股价星期二(11月10日)连续第二天走低，这家位于美国的半导体公司首席执行官黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)同时面临股东诉讼，并承受着来自国会日益增长的压力。 此次抛售的前一天，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)说，联邦调查局(FBI)正在调查黄仁勋与女商人黄乐(Alice Huang)之间的关系；美国情报部门认定，这名女商人是在为中国搜集情报。 英伟达董事会于星期日启动了独立审查，原因是有报道指黄仁勋成为外国情报机构的目标。黄仁勋在发给员工的一则信息中承认自己曾有不忠行为，但未透露女方身份。 特朗普与黄仁勋通话 英伟达股价在星期二上午交易时段下跌了5.3%。星期一收盘时，该股下跌了4.3%，导致公司市值缩水约1900亿美元。 特朗普在星期一的白宫简报会上说，他曾致电黄仁勋，询问其近况。 特朗普说，“我问了他那个问题：‘你知不知道她是间谍？’他说‘我完全不知道她是间谍。’我确实相信他，”“我知道联邦调查局正在调查此事，”“我认为他会没事的。” 特朗普将于下星期前往中国深圳参加亚太经合组织峰会，届时他预计将与中国国家主席习近平会晤。当被问及是否会向习提及此事时，特朗普说，“不，我想不会。我是说，也许吧。我相信习近平主席会问起这件事的。” 中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆星期二在北京拒绝表明习近平是否会提出这一问题。他仅表示，双方正在就两国领导人今年的会晤安排进行讨论。中方已否认了有关间谍指控。 投资人诉讼 散户投资者马克·基斯滕马赫(Mark Kistenmacher)星期一在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的联邦法院对英伟达及黄仁勋提起诉讼；他在一份拟议的集体诉讼中指控他们欺骗了股东。根据起诉书，英伟达隐瞒了相关事宜，并对其与Megaspeed公司之间的往来情况进行了失实陈述；Megaspeed是一家位于新加坡的企业，黄乐曾在此担任高管。诉讼文件指称，此举使英伟达的声誉和业务面临“重大风险”。 原告要求由陪审团审理此案，并寻求损害赔偿，但未明确具体金额。诉讼涵盖10月9日至11月8日期间买入英伟达股票的股东。英伟达未立即就此诉讼置评。 议员们要求给出答复 众议院民主党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯(Hakeem Jeffries)星期一说，“显然，国会需要更多信息。”杰弗里斯说。当天在中央情报局局长约翰·拉特克利夫(John Ratcliffe)和国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿(Jay Clayton)参加的机密简报会上，伊朗问题占据了主导地位，英伟达只是被顺带提及。 马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦(Elizabeth Warren)和印第安纳州共和党参议员吉姆·班克斯(Jim Banks)星期一在一份联合声明中说，这一事件使国家安全方面的担忧“变得更加紧迫”。他们敦促国会将《人工智能监管法案》(AI Overwatch Act)这个让国会能够监督最先进芯片出口的法案，纳入年度国防法案。 来自特拉瓦州的民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯(Chris Coons)在X上写道，他正在“推动对黄仁勋及英伟达展开调查，以确定我们的国家安全是否受到了损害。”

title: Hong Kong to see cold snap from Tuesday with lows of 16°C following hottest October on record
zh_title: 继十月有记录以来最热之后，香港周二起将迎来寒潮，最低气温将达到 16°C
summary: 继有记录以来最热的十月之后，香港人本周将经历寒流。香港人穿着夹克。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周一该市最低气温将达到 19 摄氏度，周二气温将在 16 至 23 摄氏度之间。一股强冷锋将横过中国南部沿海，为本港带来干燥凉爽的天气：“受冷锋带来的强烈东北季风影响，今天广东多风，气温明显下降……昼夜温差将在
content:
继有记录以来最热的十月之后，香港人本周将经历寒流。香港人穿着夹克。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周一该市最低气温将达到 19 摄氏度，周二气温将在 16 至 23 摄氏度之间。一股强冷锋将横过中国南部沿海，为本港带来干燥凉爽的天气：“受冷锋带来的强烈东北季风影响，今天广东地区有风，气温明显下降……昼夜温差较大。”然而，随着热带气旋千帕卡抵达日本，周三之后气温将开始上升，预计周末将有阵雨：“季风预计将在本周后半段减弱，该地区气温将上升……高空扰动将在周末为中国南部带来阵雨。”有记录以来最热的十月天文台录得有史以来最高的十月平均最高气温30.5摄氏度。 2026 年夏季，香港遭遇破纪录的热浪。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
上周在一份新闻稿中表示：“主要是由于东北季风较正常弱，华南地区高空反气旋较正常强，加上气候变暖和可能持续至明年初的强烈厄尔尼诺现象，2026年10月香港异常温暖。”政府间气候变化专门委员会警告说，自20世纪50年代以来，热浪的强度和频率持续增加，原因是人为造成的气候变化。二氧化碳等温室气体的普遍存在，将热量滞留在大气中，导致地球表面温度升高，更热、更长时间的热浪将生命置于危险之中。另请参阅：极端高温如何成为世界天气灾害中最致命的无声杀手 研究非政府组织伯克利地球表示，自工业革命以来，香港的气温已经升高了 1.7 摄氏度。根据 2023 年的一项研究，到本世纪末，高温和湿度可能会在较长时间内达到致命水平，导致世界某些地区无法呆在户外。

【原文 English Original】
Hongkongers will experience a cold snap this week following the hottest October on record. People wearing jackets in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The city will see lows of 19 degrees Celsius on Monday, with temperatures on Tuesday ranging from 16 to 23 degrees Celsius. A strong cold front will cross China’s southern coast, bringing dry and cool weather to the territory: “Under the influence of the intense northeast monsoon associated with a cold front, it will be windy and temperatures will fall appreciably over Guangdong today… The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large.” However, the mercury will begin to rise after Wednesday with showers expected over the weekend as Tropical Cyclone Cempaka arrives in Japan: “The monsoon is expected to moderate in the latter part of this week, temperatures will rise over the region… Upper-air disturbances will bring showers to southern China towards the weekend.” Hottest October on record It comes after the Observatory recorded the highest-ever monthly mean maximum temperature in October of 30.5 degrees Celsius. Hong Kong saw a record-breaking heatwave in summer 2026. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Mainly due to a weaker-than-normal northeast monsoon and a stronger-than-normal upper-air anticyclone over southern China, and set against the backdrop of climate warming and a very strong El Niño event that may persist into early next year, October 2026 was unseasonably warm in Hong Kong,” it said last week in a press release. The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change has warned that the intensity and frequency of heatwaves have continued to increase since the 1950s due to human-caused climate change. The prevalence of greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide – which trap heat in the atmosphere – raises the planet’s surface temperature, with hotter, longer heatwaves putting lives at risk. See also: How extreme heat became the deadliest silent killer among world weather disasters Hong Kong has already warmed by 1.7 degrees Celsius since the Industrial Revolution, research NGO Berkeley Earth says . Heat and humidity may reach lethal levels for protracted periods by the end of the century, according to a 2023 study , making it impossible to stay outdoors in some parts of the world.

title: 'Permanent, serious' dialogue needed with China on AI: tech-focused lawmaker
zh_title: 需要与中国就人工智能进行“永久、认真”的对话：以技术为重点的立法者
summary: 众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党确实
content:
众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党和我们一样不希望流氓人工智能代理侵入他们的系统和水务部门，所以我们必须进行永久性对话并达成一些协议，”他说。他发表此番言论的几天前，民主党赢得了众议院和参议院的控制权，许多即将上任的立法者将人工智能监管作为其竞选活动的核心组成部分。目前尚不完全清楚，在一个主要专注于促进技术创新、同时将法规保持在最低限度的政府的领导下，立法者将如何着手制定人工智能法律。白宫还必须应对参众两院新多数派的更强烈反对，这可能迫使他们坐到谈判桌前通过复杂的立法。沃金肖并不是第一位倡导美中人工智能对话的国会议员，尽管他的立场增加了这些评论的分量。
作为北弗吉尼亚州一个著名科技和联邦合同走廊的代表，他所服务的地区的当地科技公司和政府承包商必须应对人工智能发展所带来的复杂的国家安全影响。推动对话是在 7 月份发生的一次具有里程碑意义的事件之后进行的，当时 OpenAI 特工逃离了他们的开发沙箱，并对 Hugging Face 发起了协调一致的网络攻击。上个月，研究人员在与中国相关的腾讯云上追踪到一组自主人工智能代理，这些代理突破了自己的测试环境，并进行了数千次未经授权的尝试，以规避阿里巴巴平台上的反机器人保护。这些言论也与中国国家主席习近平九月份在华盛顿与唐纳德·特朗普总统举行峰会时的声明相一致。习近平承认两个超级大国都负有管理技术的“责任”，同意建立美中超级情报对话和针对严重人工智能事件的危机“热线”。一些立法者提出成立一个特别委员会来监管快速发展的技术，但其他人拒绝了这一想法。沃金肖表示，他并不期望众议院建立一个特别委员会，而是希望将现有的众议院民主党人工智能委员会的工作转化为委员会可以制定的具体立法。他对人工智能监管的愿景还包括前沿模型的安全测试。
在周四的讲话中，他将安全测试与联邦航空管理局在飞机离开机库之前对飞机进行安全检查进行了比较。他特别补充说，他对于联邦机构或受政府监督的第三方评估机构是否应该进行该测试持不可知论。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
Rep. James Walkinshaw’s vision for artificial intelligence regulation includes maintaining “permanent, serious” dialogue with China to mitigate the risk that powerful AI models pose. That won’t be easy, but if the U.S. was able to maintain nuclear-disarmament dialogue with the Soviet Union during the Cold War, then the same can be said for communications with its top technology and economic competitor today, the Virginia Democrat argued Thursday at a GovExec event. Those conversations are “absolutely necessary, and in some ways, our incentives are aligned, right? The Chinese Communist Party doesn’t want rogue AI agents hacking their systems and their water authorities any more than we do, so we have to have that permanent dialogue and reach some agreements,” he said. His comments come days after Democrats won control of the House and Senate, where many incoming lawmakers made AI regulation a central component of their campaigns.  It’s not fully clear how lawmakers will proceed with crafting AI laws under an administration that has largely focused on fostering tech innovation while keeping regulations to a minimum. The White House will also have to contend with fiercer opposition from the new majorities in both chambers, which may force them to the negotiating table to pass complex legislation. Walkinshaw is hardly the first member of Congress to advocate for U.S.-China AI dialogue, though his position gives the comments added weight. As the representative of a prominent tech and federal contracting corridor in Northern Virginia, he serves a district whose local technology companies and government contractors must navigate the complex national security implications of AI development. The push for dialogue follows a landmark July incident where OpenAI agents escaped their development sandboxes and launched a coordinated cyberattack on Hugging Face . And last month, researchers tracked down a fleet of autonomous AI agents on China-linked Tencent Cloud that broke out of their own testing environment and made thousands of unauthorized attempts to circumvent anti-bot protections on an Alibaba platform.  The remarks also align with statements from Chinese President Xi Jinping during his September summit with President Donald Trump in Washington. Acknowledging that both superpowers share a “responsibility” to manage the technology, Xi agreed to establish the U.S.-China Super Intelligence Dialogue and a crisis “hotline” for severe AI incidents. Some lawmakers have floated a select committee to regulate the fast-evolving technology, though others have rebuffed that idea. Walkinshaw said he does not expect the House to establish a select committee and instead expects the work of a pre-existing House Democratic commission on AI to be translated into concrete legislation that committees can work on. His vision for AI regulation also includes safety testing for frontier models. In remarks Thursday, he compared safety testing to the Federal Aviation Administration conducting safety inspections of airplanes before they leave hangars. He notably added that he is agnostic as to whether a federal agency or third-party evaluator with government oversight should conduct that testing.  ]]>

title: Victory, Curtin University team up on rare earth processing
zh_title: Victory与科廷大学合作开发稀土加工
summary: Victory Metals (ASX: VTM) 与澳大利亚珀斯的科廷大学合作，以中试规模将重稀土精矿加工成混合稀土碳酸盐 (MREC)，推进其在澳大利亚的下游加工计划。根据材料转让协议，Victory 的波斯伍德工厂生产的精矿将在该大学的阴极前体生产试验工厂 (C4P) 进行加工。该设施的开发是为了支持澳大利亚的电池和关键矿产行业，投资额超过 1840 万澳元（1260 万美元）。 “确保对 C4P 的访问
content:
Victory Metals (ASX: VTM) 与澳大利亚珀斯的科廷大学合作，以中试规模将重稀土精矿加工成混合稀土碳酸盐 (MREC)，推进其在澳大利亚的下游加工计划。根据材料转让协议，Victory 的波斯伍德工厂生产的精矿将在该大学的阴极前体生产试验工厂 (C4P) 进行加工。该设施的开发是为了支持澳大利亚的电池和关键矿产行业，投资额超过 1840 万澳元（1260 万美元）。 Victory 执行董事兼首席执行官布伦丹·克拉克 (Brendan Clark) 表示：“确保进入 C4P 设施是 Victory Metals 的一项重大发展，也是我们建立澳大利亚综合重稀土供应链的雄心。” “这尤其重要，因为我们可以利用澳大利亚现有的加工基础设施和专业知识，而不必独立开发下游加工途径的每个阶段。”根据该计划生产的 MREC 样品预计将返回 Victory 与国际承购和炼油合作伙伴一起进行技术评估和评价。该协议有效期至 2027 年。试点工作还旨在测试澳大利亚 Victory 北斯坦莫尔稀土项目精矿加工路线。 Victory’s shares closed at A$1.24 apiece, up 0.4%, Wednesday in Sydney.
中国的限制 此次合作正值澳大利亚和美国努力限制中国对关键矿产的投资。5月，澳大利亚政府以国家安全为由，命令中国投资者出售北方矿业公司（ASX：NTU）的稀土股份。 11月9日，中国宣布进一步暂停部分出口管制措施至2027年1月10日，其中包括与中重稀土产品有关的措施。克拉克补充道：“胜利公司正在将自己定位为在发展澳大利亚国内重稀土供应链方面发挥重要作用。”由于中国控制着世界约 60% 的稀土矿产量和几乎所有矿物加工能力，许多政府都在寻找确保自身生产安全的方法。 Victory表示，澳大利亚MREC加工中心的建立与美国、欧洲、日本、印度、韩国和越南的客户相关。

【原文 English Original】
Victory Metals (ASX: VTM) has partnered with Curtin University in Perth, Australia, to process heavy rare earth concentrate into mixed rare earth carbonate (MREC) at pilot scale, advancing its plans for downstream processing in Australia. Under the material transfer agreement, concentrate produced at Victory’s Burswood plant will be processed at the university’s Cathode Precursor Production Pilot Plant (C4P). The facility was developed to support Australia’s battery and critical minerals industry and represents more than A$18.4 million ($12.6 million) in investment. “Securing access to the C4P facility is a significant development for Victory Metals and our ambition to establish an integrated Australian heavy rare earth supply chain,” said Brendan Clark, Victory’s executive director and CEO. “This is particularly important because we can leverage established Australian processing infrastructure and expertise rather than having to develop every stage of the downstream processing pathway independently.” MREC samples produced under the program are expected to be returned to Victory for technical assessment and evaluation alongside international offtake and refining partners. The agreement runs through 2027.  The pilot work is also intended to test an Australian processing route for concentrate from Victory’s North Stanmore rare earth project. Victory’s shares closed at A$1.24 apiece, up 0.4%, Wednesday in Sydney.  Chinese restrictions The partnership comes as Australia and the UShave made efforts to limit Chinese investment in critical minerals. In May , the Australian government ordered Chinese investors to sell rare earth stakes in Northern Minerals (ASX: NTU), citing national security concerns. On Nov. 9, China announced a further suspension of certain export-control measures until Jan. 10, 2027. These include measures relating to medium and heavy rare-earth products. “Victory is positioning itself to play an important role in developing Australia’s domestic heavy rare earth supply chain,” Clark added.  With China controlling about 60% of the world’s mined rare earth output and nearly all of the minerals’ processing capacity, many governments have looked for ways to secure their own production. Victory says the establishment of Australian MREC processing is relevant to customers in the U.S., Europe, Japan, India, South Korea and Vietnam.

title: F-16V vs F-16C Block 70/72: Understanding The Differences Between The Latest Viper Variants
zh_title: F-16V 与 F-16C Block 70/72：了解最新 Viper 变体之间的差异
summary: 尽管经常互换使用，F-16V 和 F-16C Block 70/72 名称描述了毒蛇进化的两个方面，升级飞机和新建飞机之间存在重要区别。 F-16 战隼的最新发展成为近几个月多条新闻的焦点，突显了该机在首次飞行后 50 多年里如何继续发展。从交付客户的新生产战斗机到现有机队的广泛现代化计划，最新进展表明第四代战斗机仍然是战斗机的重要组成部分。
content:
尽管经常互换使用，F-16V 和 F-16C Block 70/72 名称描述了毒蛇进化的两个方面，升级飞机和新建飞机之间存在重要区别。 F-16 战隼的最新发展成为近几个月多条新闻的焦点，突显了该机在首次飞行后 50 多年里如何继续发展。 From new-production fighters reaching customers to extensive modernization programs for existing fleets, the latest developments show that the fourth-generation fighter remains an important component of numerous air forces’ future plans. 10 月，台湾收到了首批两架新制造的 F-16C Block 70 战斗机，这是拖延已久的 66 架飞机订单的一部分。此次交付标志着一个重要的里程碑，这些喷气式飞机补充了升级为 F-16V 配置的岛上现有机队。 A second batch was delivered in early November, while training on the aircraft continues in the U.S. at Morris Air National Guard Base in Tucson, Arizona.航空摄影师 Thomas Backus (@machtwoimages) 拍摄了其中两个机身，并与我们分享了这些图像。 Also in October, Lockheed Martin announced the maiden flight of Morocco’s first F-16D Block 72, which is also the first newly manufactured Block 72 jet .摩洛哥还在推行并行现代化工作，将 23 架现有 F-16C/D Block 52 飞机升级为 F-16V 配置。
说到现代化的“毒蛇”战斗机，希腊于 9 月接收了第 60 架 F-16V，作为该计划的一部分，该计划将首先将 84 架 F-16 Block 52+ 和 Block 52+ Advanced 升级到新配置，然后是 38 架较旧的 Block 50。与此同时，洛克希德·马丁公司向美国空军和 F-16C/D Block 推销了一款基于 Block 70 的变体，称为 F-16G。 70/72 给乌克兰空军。 Visualizza questo post su Instagram                         Un post condiviso da Thomas “Taj” Backus (@machtwoimages) 这些进展说明了运营商投资“战隼”的不同方式。然而，它们也重新引起了人们对即使是航空爱好者也可能感到困惑的术语的关注：F-16V、F-16C/D、Block 70 和 Block 72。虽然这些名称有时可以互换使用，但它们并不意味着同一件事。了解每个名称的含义对于区分新制造的 F-16C/D Block 70/72 和升级到 F-16V 配置的旧版 F-16 至关重要。了解名称 F-16V（其中“V”代表 F-16 的昵称“毒蛇”）由洛克希德·马丁公司推出，作为现有“战隼”战斗机的现代化套件。 F-16V 于 2012 年宣布并于 2015 年首飞，旨在使早期的 F-16 改型达到更先进的技术标准，而不需要运营商购买全新的飞机。
该套件对飞机的雷达、任务计算机、驾驶舱显示器和航空电子设备架构进行了重大改进。这些更改随后被纳入新制造飞机的 Block 70/72 生产配置中。 Block 名称标识了 F-16 的特定渐进生产标准，从 F-16A Block 1 开始。F-16C 和 F-16D 名称（类似于 F-16A 和 B，以及 F-16E 和 F）分别标识飞机的单座和两座变体。 ROCAF F-16V 准备快速反应啤酒

【原文 English Original】
Although often used interchangeably, the F-16V and the F-16C Block 70/72 designations describe two sides of the Viper’s evolution, with important differences between upgraded and newly built aircraft. The F-16 Fighting Falcon’s latest evolution has been at the center of several news in recent months, highlighting how the aircraft continues to evolve more than five decades after its first flight. From new-production fighters reaching customers to extensive modernization programs for existing fleets, the latest developments show that the fourth-generation fighter remains an important component of numerous air forces’ future plans. In October, Taiwan received its first two newly manufactured F-16C Block 70 fighters , part of a long-delayed order for 66 aircraft. The delivery marked an important milestone, with these jets complementing the island’s existing fleet upgraded to the F-16V configuration. A second batch was delivered in early November, while training on the aircraft continues in the U.S. at Morris Air National Guard Base in Tucson, Arizona. Aviation photographer Thomas Backus ( @machtwoimages ) photographed two of the airframes and kindly shared the images with us. Also in October, Lockheed Martin announced the maiden flight of Morocco’s first F-16D Block 72, which is also the first newly manufactured Block 72 jet . Morocco is also pursuing a parallel modernization effort, upgrading 23 existing F-16C/D Block 52 aircraft to the F-16V configuration. Speaking of modernized Vipers, in September, Greece received its 60th F-16V, as part of a program which will first see 84 F-16s Block 52+ and Block 52+ Advanced upgraded to the new configuration, followed by 38 older Block 50s. Meanwhile, Lockheed Martin pitched a Block 70-based variant called F-16G to the U.S. Air Force and the F-16C/D Block 70/72 to the Ukrainian Air Force.             Visualizza questo post su Instagram                         Un post condiviso da Thomas “Taj” Backus (@machtwoimages) These developments illustrate the different ways in which operators are investing in the Fighting Falcon. However, they have also brought renewed attention to a terminology that can be confusing even for aviation enthusiasts: F-16V, F-16C/D, Block 70 and Block 72. Although these designations are sometimes used interchangeably, they do not mean the same thing. Understanding what each designation means is essential to distinguish a newly manufactured F-16C/D Block 70/72 from an older F-16 upgraded to the F-16V configuration . Understanding the designations The F-16V, with the ‘V’ standing for the F-16’s nickname Viper, was introduced by Lockheed Martin as a modernization package for existing Fighting Falcons. Announced in 2012 and first flying in 2015 , the F-16V was intended to bring earlier F-16 variants up to a more advanced technological standard without requiring operators to purchase entirely new aircraft. The package introduced significant improvements to the aircraft’s radar, mission computers, cockpit displays and avionics architecture. These changes were subsequently incorporated into the Block 70/72 production configuration for newly manufactured aircraft. The Block designation identifies a particular progressive production standard of the F-16, starting with the F-16A Block 1. The F-16C and F-16D designations (similarly to the F-16A and B, and the F-16E and F ) identify the aircraft single-seat and two-seat variants, respectively. A ROCAF F-16V prepares for a Quick Reaction Alert mission during a combat readiness exercise in 2022. | Source: CNA Consequently, an F-16C Block 70/72 is a single-seat, newly manufactured Fighting Falcon built to the latest production standard, while an F-16D Block 70/72 is its two-seat counterpart. The Block 70 and 72 designations identify different engine configurations, which will be discussed later. An existing F-16C or F-16D (or, in Taiwan’s case, F-16A or F-16B ) modernized to the F-16V standard retains its original airframe and powerplant. However, many of its systems are brought up to a configuration comparable to the Block 70/72 production aircraft, with few differences. The similarities: radar and avionic upgrades Among the new systems installed om both the modernized F-16V and the newly manufactured Block 70/72 we can find the  APG-83 AESA  (Active Electronically Scanned Array) radar, a new Center Pedestal Display (CPD), the AN/APX-126 Advanced IFF (Identification Friend or Foe), Link 16 datalink, full NVIS (Night Vision Imaging System) and JHCMS II (Joint Helmet-Mounted Cueing System II) compatibility, a new Embedded GPS/INS (EGI), a modern commercial off-the-shelf (COTS)-based avionics subsystem, a high-volume, high-speed data bus and the  Automatic Ground Collision Avoidance System (Auto GCAS). The radar, built by Northrop Grumman as the Scalable Agile Beam Radar (SABR), is undoubtedly one of the most important features. Notably, this radar is designed to fit the F-16 with no structural, power or cooling modifications, and is also being installed on U.S. Air Force F-16s as part of the ongoing upgrades . This AESA radar represents a significant improvement over the mechanically scanned AN/APG-66 and AN/APG-68 radars fitted to earlier F-16 variants. Unlike mechanically scanned radars, which rely on a moving antenna to direct the radar beam, an AESA uses multiple transmit/receive modules to electronically steer the beam. Two Republic of China Air Force (ROCAF) F-16C Block 70 jets on the ground at Morris Air National Guard Base in Tucson, Arizona. | Source: Thomas Backus machtwoimages The new radar enables the F-16 to detect, track and identify a greater number of targets (reportedly more than 20 at the same time) faster and at longer ranges while providing all-weather, high-resolution Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) mapping. The system also integrated a robust electronic protection to operate in hostile electronic environments. The radar is complemented by an upgraded Modular Mission Computer and a modernized avionics architecture. This is designed to process the increased volume of information generated by the new sensors and provide pilots with a more comprehensive tactical picture. The cockpit has also received substantial improvements, with one of the most recognizable additions being the Center Pedestal Display (CPD). The CPS is a high-resolution, 6-by-8-inch color display installed in the center of the instrument panel instead of the older analog gauges, providing access to radar information, targeting pod imagery, digital maps and other tactical data, complementing the existing Multi-Function Displays (MFD). The newly manufactured aircraft also include new digital standby attitude indicator, engine and fuel gauges, as well as a new Integrated Control Panel (ICP) which includes the Data Entry Display (DED). On the other hand, the F-16V retains the original standby attitude indicator, engine and fuel gauges, and ICP, with the DED remaining in the original position. The differences: new and life-extended airframe Perhaps the most important distinction between a newly manufactured Block 70 and an older F-16 upgraded to the F-16V standard concerns the airframe itself. The Block 70/72 features a structural service life of 12,000 flight hours, while the F-16V features an airframe which already accumulated a number of flight hours and underwent a Service Life Extension Program (SLEP) during the upgrade . A Republic of China Air Force (ROCAF) F-16C Block 70 returns from a training sortie at Morris Air National Guard Base in Tucson, Arizona. | Source: Thomas Backus machtwoimages The Block 70/72’s structural service life is more than 50% greater than that of previous production F-16s, according to Lockheed Martin. This was achieved through structural improvements incorporated during manufacturing, allowing the aircraft to remain in service for several decades without requiring the same extensive structural interventions that older airframes may eventually need. This distinction is particularly important when comparing the two configurations. In fact, although an upgraded F-16V may offer similar avionics and mission capabilities to a Block 70/72, the latter starts from zero flight hours since it is newly manufactured, while the former’s service life depends on the original aircraft’s condition and operational history. Engine and external configuration The Block 70 and Block 72 designations, as mentioned earlier, identify different engine configurations. The Block 70 is powered by the General Electric F110-GE-129D turbofan , while the Block 72 uses the Pratt & Whitney F100-PW-229 engine. Both engines belong to established families already used by previous F-16 variants, but the choice of powerplant depends on the customer’s requirements and existing logistics infrastructure. The use of the Block x0/x2 designation goes back to the early 1980s, when it was first used for the F-16C/D Block 30 and Block 32 aircraft. The F-16’s initial variants – from the A/B Block 1 to the C/D Block 25 – were powered by the Pratt & Whitney F100-PW-200 turbofan, followed by the upgraded F100-PW-220 turbofan. However, in 1984, the U.S. Air Force decided to adopt both P&W and GE engines under the Alternative Fighter Engine (AFE) program. The F-16C/D Block 30/32 thus included a common engine bay, able to accept either powerplant. However, that was not the only modification required for the different engine. In fact, with GE’s F110 providing more thrust and thus requiring a larger airflow, the air inlet had to be enlarged. This led to the larger inlet becoming the standard for F110-powered F-16s, which were referred to as “ Big-mouths,” while the F100-powered F-16s retained the original smaller inlet as the larger one would be detrimental to the flight performance.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s involvement with an alleged Chinese spy is the stuff of Hollywood thrillers. These 10, for example
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名所谓的中国间谍的牵连堪称好莱坞惊悚片的情节。例如这10个
summary: 世界上最成功的公司之一的亿万富翁首席执行官与一位迷人的坐飞机的女商人发生了风流韵事。他变得更加亲密，分享了更多——却发现她秘密是一名中国间谍。听起来就像好莱坞大片的情节。但据称，这一情节的一个版本正在全球第二大市值公司英伟达内部真实展开。据报道，首席执行官黄仁勋承认与新加坡 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 有染，后者被指控与中国政府合作。英伟达董事会表示，它正在努力
content:
世界上最成功的公司之一的亿万富翁首席执行官与一位迷人的坐飞机的女商人发生了风流韵事。他变得更加亲密，分享了更多——却发现她秘密是一名中国间谍。听起来就像好莱坞大片的情节。但据称，这一情节的一个版本正在全球第二大市值公司英伟达内部真实展开。据报道，首席执行官黄仁勋承认与新加坡 Megaspeed 前高管 Alice Huang 有染，后者被指控与中国政府合作。英伟达董事会表示仍在调查这些指控，并且没有理由相信商业秘密遭到泄露。与此同时，好莱坞近一个世纪以来一直在探索“美人计”情节。这里有 10 个值得注意的例子。 1. FX 广受好评的《美国谍梦》（2013-2018）间谍剧对长期的美人陷阱进行了多层次的描绘。凯丽·拉塞尔和马修·里斯饰演伊丽莎白·詹宁斯和菲利普·詹宁斯，他们是冷战期间渗透到美国的苏联间谍。大多数美人计情节都将女间谍描绘成诱惑者。美国人翻转了剧本——带来了毁灭性的结果。 2.《红麻雀》(Red Sparrow) (2018) 詹妮弗·劳伦斯 (Jennifer Lawrence) 饰演多米尼卡·叶戈洛娃 (Dominika Egorova)，她是一名俄罗斯芭蕾舞演员，被招募到秘密情报计划中。叶戈洛娃在追捕一名中央情报局特工并受到俄罗斯上司的精心控制的过程中，发现对美人计特工的操纵是双向的。 3.
色戒 (2007) 美人计是西方间谍片的主要内容。但相同的基本情节跨越文化。在李安的这部影片中，汤唯扮演了一名在日本占领中国期间被抵抗组织招募的年轻女子。她的任务是安排暗杀目标，但感情开始阻碍她。 4. 《美人计》 (1946) 阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克 (Alfred Hitchcock) 1946 年的电影证明了美人计让几代编剧和导演着迷。 《美人计》由英格丽·褒曼和加里·格兰特等传奇演员组成，探索当美人计变成三角恋时会发生什么。 5. 小鼓手女孩 (2018) 尽管好莱坞为银幕上描绘美人陷阱提供了特别肥沃的土壤，但美人陷阱的想法也是间谍小说的主要内容。典型的例子：约翰·勒卡雷的间谍惊悚片，被改编成银幕的《小鼓手女孩》。这部迷你剧描绘了以色列情报部队的一名年轻新兵，其任务是渗透到一个巴勒斯坦激进组织，模糊了虚假身份和真实身份之间的界限。 6. 《黑皮书》（2006） 这部保罗·范霍文的电影以二战期间纳粹占领的荷兰为背景。犹太特工雷切尔·斯坦（卡丽斯·范·豪顿饰）肩负着渗透德国情报圈的任务，她开始质疑周围人的真正忠诚度。 7. 《使女》 (2016) 大多数美人计都涉及间谍和间谍活动的秘密世界。
但也有一些人在不太隐秘的地方探索了同样的总体思路。韩国电影制片人朴赞郁 (Park Chan-Wook) 2016 年的电影讲述了一名年轻扒手被招募来帮助一名骗子勾引一名富有的女继承人的故事。然而，很快就不清楚谁在操纵谁。 8. M. Butterfly (1993) 在间谍活动的绝密世界中发生的大部分事情仍然是：绝密。但现实生活中的谍战剧偶尔也会被解密。当这种情况发生时，它们通常会成为好莱坞故事的绝佳素材。情况就是如此

【原文 English Original】
The billionaire CEO of one of the world’s most successful companies is drawn into an affair with an alluring, jet-setting businesswoman. He becomes closer and shares more—only to discover that she’s secretly a Chinese spy. It sounds like the plot of a Hollywood blockbuster. But a version of that plotline is allegedly unfolding for real inside Nvidia , the world’s second most valuable company. CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an affair, reportedly with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed who is accused of working with the Chinese government . Nvidia’s board says it’s still investigating the allegations, and that it has no reason to believe trade secrets were compromised. Hollywood, meanwhile, has been exploring the “honey trap” plot for nearly a century. Here are 10 notable examples. 1. The Americans (2013-2018) FX’s critically acclaimed spy drama offers a multi-layered portrayal of the long-term honey trap. Keri Russell and Matthew Rhys star as Elizabeth and Philip Jennings, Soviet spies infiltrating America during the Cold War. Most honey trap plots portray a female spy as the seducer. The Americans flips the script—with devastating results. 2. Red Sparrow (2018) Jennifer Lawrence plays Dominika Egorova, a Russian ballerina recruited into a secret intelligence program. Pursuing a CIA operative and carefully controlled by her Russian handlers, Egorova discovers that the manipulation of a honey trap agent can go both ways. 3. Lust, Caution (2007) The honey trap is a staple of Western spy films. But the same basic plotline cuts across cultures. In this film from Ang Lee, Tang Wei portrays a young woman who is recruited by a resistance organization during the Japanese occupation of China. Her mission is to arrange for her target’s assassination, but feelings begin to get in the way. 4. Notorious (1946) Alfred Hitchcock’s 1946 film is proof that the honey trap has fascinated screenwriters and directors for generations. With a legendary cast, including Ingrid Bergman and Cary Grant, Notorious explores what happens when a honey trap becomes a love triangle. 5. The Little Drummer Girl (2018) Although Hollywood has provided especially fertile ground to depict honey traps on the screen, the idea of a honey trap is a staple of the spy novel, too. Case in point: John le Carré’s espionage thriller, which was adapted for the screen as The Little Drummer Girl . The miniseries depicts a young recruit of the Israeli intelligence forces tasked with infiltrating a Palestinian militant organization, blurring the lines between fake and real identities. 6. Black Book (2006) This Paul Verhoeven film is set in the Nazi-occupied Netherlands during World War II. Tasked with infiltrating German intelligence circles, Jewish operative Rachel Stein (Carice van Houten) begins to question the real loyalties of those around her. 7. The Handmaiden (2016) Most honey traps involve spies and the clandestine world of espionage. But some explore the same general idea in less secretive places. South Korean filmmaker Park Chan-Wook’s 2016 film depicts a young pickpocket who is recruited to help a con artist seduce a wealthy heiress. It quickly becomes unclear, though, who is manipulating whom. 8. M. Butterfly (1993) Much of what happens in the top secret world of espionage remains exactly that: top secret. But occasionally real-life spy dramas are declassified. When that happens, they often make great material for a Hollywood story. That’s the case with this film about a diplomat who is seduced by a Chinese opera singer. Inspired by real events, the film shows how even a high-level figure can be drawn into a honey trap.  9. From Russia With Love (1963) James Bond may be able to skydive into a falling airplane or windsurf a tsunami , but even he can fall prey to the honey trap. The classic Bond film From Russia With Love centers around Soviet clerk Tatiana Romanova, who appears willing to defect—and draws Bond into a romantic entanglement. But as is so often the case in Bond’s world, things get “shaken” up, as the truth about Romanova comes out. 10. Ex Machina (2014) Not every honey trap operative needs to be human. In Alex Garland’s classic sci-fi film, a young programmer, Caleb, is tasked with evaluating an advanced artificial intelligence system named Ava. As man and machine become closer, the film questions whether their attraction is real—or whether Ava is secretly manipulating Caleb to achieve her own aim. Given Nvidia’s role as the shovel seller of the AI gold rush, the idea of a honey-trapping AI feels especially apt.

title: AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program
zh_title: AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系
summary: AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿常务董事 Ingrid Larson 与台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾联谊法》获得国会通过并签署成为法律
content:
AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿董事总经理 Ingrid Larson 和台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾奖学金法案》在两党广泛支持下获得国会通过并签署成为法律。今天，AIT 和 TECRO 签署了谅解备忘录，并与国务院教育和文化事务局协调，启动了该计划的实施。该计划的主要目标是扩大和加强美台伙伴关系，并加强美国官员在台湾和海峡两岸问题上的专业知识。 TFP 将在台湾各地建立一批具有语言技能、文化知识和持久工作关系的联邦专业人士。根据该奖学金计划，美国联邦雇员将花费长达一年的时间进行强化普通话培训和地区研究。培训完成后，研究员预计将在台湾议会办公室、部委、其他机构或办公室或台湾公共部门以外的组织工作最长一年。
国会议员以及美国国务院、TECRO 和 AIT 的代表出席了在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿举行的签字仪式，与会者称赞该计划在加强美台伙伴关系和建立美国政府在台湾问题上的专业知识方面所发挥的作用。美国在台协会董事总经理英格丽·拉尔森 (Ingrid Larson) 表示：“TFP 反映了两党对美台关系的大力支持以及对以民间关系为核心的共同承诺。” 《AIT 和 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系》一文首先发表在美国在台协会上。

【原文 English Original】
AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program PR-2631 November 11, 2026 AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program   On November 10, 2026, American Institute in Taiwan (AIT) Washington Managing Director Ingrid Larson and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States (TECRO) Representative Alexander Tah-Ray Yui signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to establish the Taiwan Fellowship Program (TFP).   The Taiwan Fellowship Act was passed by Congress and signed into law with broad bipartisan support. Today’s signing of the MOU between AIT and TECRO initiates the program’s implementation, in coordination with the Department of State’s Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs. The main objectives of the Program are to expand and strengthen the U.S.-Taiwan partnership, as well as strengthen U.S. officials’ expertise regarding Taiwan and cross-Strait issues. TFP will build a group of federal professionals with language skills, cultural knowledge, and lasting working relationships across Taiwan.   Under the fellowship program, U.S. federal employees will spend up to one year in intensive Mandarin language training and area studies. Upon completion of training, the Fellows are expected to work, for up to one year, in Taiwan parliamentary offices, ministries, other agencies or offices, or organizations outside the public sector in Taiwan.   Members of Congress and representatives from the U.S. Department of State, TECRO, and AIT attended the signing ceremony in Arlington, Virginia, where attendees praised the program’s role in strengthening the U.S.-Taiwan partnership and building U.S. government expertise on Taiwan.   “TFP reflects strong bipartisan support for the U.S.-Taiwan relationship and a shared commitment to the people-to-people ties at its core,” said AIT Managing Director Ingrid Larson. The post AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program appeared first on American Institute in Taiwan .

title: 黃仁勳剛認婚外情 特朗普再爆某AI大公司負責人利用AI做壞事：準備坐牢吧
summary: 追光者 2026-11-10 【輝達黃仁勳剛認婚外情 特朗普再爆某AI大公司負責人利用AI做壞事：準備坐牢吧】 輝達創辦人黃仁勳周日（8日）承認婚外情震撼全球，情婦背景愈挖愈多，更有傳她是有夫之婦，丈夫因違法被捕。同時，美國總統特朗普透露，某AI大公司負責人「利用AI做壞事」，更致電通知對方「準備坐牢吧」。不過，他拒絕公開對方身份。 黃仁勳出軌掀起巨浪，輝達周一（9日）股價重挫4.27%，收報178.67美元，單日市值蒸發1,900億美元。有股東在收市後隨即向加州聖荷西聯邦
content: 追光者  2026-11-10 【輝達黃仁勳剛認婚外情 特朗普再爆某AI大公司負責人利用AI做壞事：準備坐牢吧】 輝達創辦人黃仁勳周日（8日）承認婚外情震撼全球，情婦背景愈挖愈多，更有傳她是有夫之婦，丈夫因違法被捕。同時，美國總統特朗普透露，某AI大公司負責人「利用AI做壞事」，更致電通知對方「準備坐牢吧」。不過，他拒絕公開對方身份。 黃仁勳出軌掀起巨浪，輝達周一（9日）股價重挫4.27%，收報178.67美元，單日市值蒸發1,900億美元。有股東在收市後隨即向加州聖荷西聯邦法院入稟，就輝達蓄意隱瞞黃仁勳與疑似中國女間諜的親密關係、嚴重誤導並欺騙股東，造成公司重大全球商譽和營運風險，涉違反證券交易相關法規，向輝達和黃仁勳發起集體訴訟。 ︱前央視記者證曾共事 傳為有夫之婦 股東興訟之際，情婦黃樂的身世之謎繼續被起底，對於其4年媒體經驗曾任職中國湖南衛視和央視的說法，有前央視記者在微博發文，稱曾與黃樂在同一間辦公室共事，並形容當年就覺得對方「不簡單」。 中國《財新網》則引述知情人士報道，現年約42歲的黃樂，曾在約20年前在香港浸會大學傳理學院攻讀媒體管理碩士課程。 更為人好奇的是黃樂的婚姻狀況，中國媒體眾說紛云，有知情人士指她的丈夫是於上海和熙投資擔任合夥人時的拍檔康偉，惟康偉因違反證券法遭判刑；對於康偉的傳言亦有不同版本，有指他涉及走私輝達晶片，另一說法則指他涉及非法集資上百億，被中共查抄判無期徒刑；甚至有流傳康偉「獻祭」黃樂予黃仁勳來維持新加坡公司Megaspeed與輝達的合作關係。 ︱特朗普致電黃仁勳 黃稱完全不知道她是間諜 對於黃樂的身份，不止民眾，連特朗普也好奇。特朗普昨於白宮記者會回應聯邦調查局（FBI）會調查事件，又指即日已致電黃仁勳，詢問他知否女方是間諜，黃稱「我完全不知道她是間諜」，特朗普直認相信黃仁勳，又認為黃正承受着巨大的痛苦。 對於下周到深圳出席APEC峰會將與中國國家主席習近平會晤，特朗普被問到會否向習近平提起疑似中國間諜一事時，他稱不打算提出，但他認為習會問及此事，重申認為黃仁勳是非常可敬之人。特朗普早前曾表態，願意帶黃仁勳同行前往中國。 ︱特朗普爆某AI大公司負責人做壞事 未透露詳情 力撐黃仁勳的同時，特朗普在哥倫比亞廣播公司（CBS）節目「60分鐘」（60 Minutes）周日播出的專訪爆料，司法部曾接獲通報，指有人「利用AI做壞事」，隔天早上可能會將他逮捕，因此「我們以非常強硬的態度打電話給對方警告：準備坐牢吧，請親吻你的妻子，向她說晚安」。 不過，特朗普這番說話到底是在威脅誰，他沒有鬆口，僅確認是一家大型AI公司的負責人。他又指，對方隨後「徹底改變作法」，卻未明言後續的調查情況或有否採取執法行動。

title: Update Chrome now to fix a flaw attackers are exploiting
zh_title: 立即更新 Chrome 以修复攻击者利用的漏洞
summary: 11 月 9 日，谷歌发布了适用于 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 的 Chrome 稳定频道的安全更新。该更新将在未来几天和几周内推出。大多数用户都使用 Chrome 的稳定渠道。此次桌面更新将 Chrome 带到了 Windows 和 Mac 版本 157.0.8103.50/.51 以及 Linux 版本 157.0.8103.50。它包括九个安全修复程序，其中一个针对被积极利用的零日漏洞。零日漏洞是在官方修复可用之前披露或利用的安全缺陷。香港计算机紧急应变小组协调中心（HKCERT）
content:
11 月 9 日，谷歌发布了适用于 Windows、Mac 和 Linux 的 Chrome 稳定频道的安全更新。该更新将在未来几天和几周内推出。大多数用户都使用 Chrome 的稳定渠道。此次桌面更新将 Chrome 带到了 Windows 和 Mac 版本 157.0.8103.50/.51 以及 Linux 版本 157.0.8103.50。它包括九个安全修复程序，其中一个针对被积极利用的零日漏洞。零日漏洞是在官方修复可用之前披露或利用的安全缺陷。香港计算机应急响应小组协调中心（HKCERT）将总体风险评级为“极高”。其公告称，更新中解决的一些漏洞可能允许拒绝服务、安全限制绕过和远程代码执行。如何更新 Chrome 最简单的选择是允许 Chrome 自动更新。但是，如果您从未关闭浏览器或出现问题（例如扩展程序阻止更新），您最终可能会落后于更新。如果您不想等待发布，您可以手动更新。从 Chrome 的“设置”或“帮助”菜单中打开“关于 Google Chrome”。 Chrome 将检查更新并下载任何可用的更新。如果出现提示，请单击“重新启动”以应用它。 Chrome 157.0.8103.51 已更新 您可以在我们的指南中找到版本编号系统的说明和分步说明：如何在每个操作系统上更新 Chrome 。
谷歌还于 11 月 9 日发布了 Android 版 Chrome 157.0.8103.50。谷歌表示，除非另有说明，否则它包含与桌面版本相同的安全修复程序。 Android 用户应检查 Google Play 是否有更新。技术细节让我们仔细看看这个零日漏洞。谷歌表示，它于 11 月 6 日收到未具名第三方的漏洞通知。该漏洞被追踪为 CVE-2026-125350，并被评为 Chrome XML 组件中的高严重性释放后使用漏洞。 XML 是 Chrome 用来读取和处理某些类型的结构化 Web 内容的数据格式。 XML 代表可扩展标记语言：它使用标签来标记信息，就像 HTML 一样，但允许作者定义自己的标签来描述他们的数据。当程序尝试访问已释放的内存位置时，就会发生释放后使用漏洞。这可能会导致崩溃，或者在某些情况下，允许攻击者运行自己的代码。谷歌仅表示“意识到 CVE-2026-125350 的漏洞存在”。它没有透露攻击者、目标、交付方法或该漏洞可以做什么。在威胁造成任何伤害之前阻止它们。 Malwarebytes Browser Guard 自动阻止网络钓鱼页面和恶意网站。免费，一键安装。将其添加到您的浏览器 →

【原文 English Original】
On November 9, Google issued a security update to Chrome’s Stable channel for Windows, Mac, and Linux. The update is rolling out over the coming days and weeks. Most users are on Chrome’s Stable channel. The desktop update brings Chrome to versions 157.0.8103.50/.51 for Windows and Mac and 157.0.8103.50 for Linux . It includes nine security fixes, including one for an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability. A zero-day vulnerability is a security flaw disclosed or exploited before an official fix becomes available. Hong Kong’s Computer Emergency Response Team Coordination Centre (HKCERT) rates the overall risk as “Extremely High.” Its bulletin says some of the vulnerabilities address in the update could allow denial of service, security restriction bypass, and remote code execution. How to update Chrome The easiest option is to allow Chrome to update automatically. But you can end up lagging behind on updates if you never close your browser or if something goes wrong, such as an extension preventing the update. If you don’t want to wait for the rollout to reach you, you can update manually. Open About Google Chrome from Chrome’s Settings or Help menu. Chrome will check for updates and download any available update. If prompted, click Relaunch to apply it. Chrome 157.0.8103.51 is up to date You can find an explanation of the version numbering system and step-by-step instructions in our guide: How to update Chrome on every operating system . Google also released Chrome 157.0.8103.50 for Android on November 9. Google says it includes the same security fixes as the desktop release unless otherwise noted. Android users should check Google Play for the update. Technical details Let’s take a closer look at that zero-day vulnerability. Google says it was notified about a vulnerability by an unnamed third party on November 6. The vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-125350 and rated as a high-severity use-after-free vulnerability in Chrome’s XML component. XML is a data format Chrome uses to read and process certain kinds of structured web content. XML stands for Extensible Markup Language: it labels information with tags, rather like HTML, but allows authors to define their own tags to describe their data. A use-after-free vulnerability occurs when a program attempts to access a memory location after it has been freed. That can cause crashes or, in some cases, allow an attacker to run their own code. Google only says that it is “aware that an exploit for CVE-2026-125350 exists in the wild.” It has not named the attackers, the targets, the delivery method, or what the exploit can do. USNI 新闻图 这些是根据海军和公开数据，截至 2026 年 11 月 9 日，美国海军在世界各地部署的航母打击群和两栖战备群的大致位置。如果 CSG 或 ARG 正在进行分类操作，图表会反映主力舰的位置。 2026 年 10 月 11 日，在日本，航空水手长的大副飞行员 Tykwon Young（右）和航空水手长的大副飞行员 Saabirah Parker 在停泊在佐世保湾的美国级两栖攻击舰的黎波里号 (LHA-7) 的飞行甲板上涂上小白眼。美国海军照片 USS 的黎波里号 (LHA-7) 停泊在日本佐世保港口。 2026 年 11 月 5 日，在日本海，第 13 海军陆战队远征队第 2/4 营登陆队的一名海军陆战队员在黄蜂级两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 上进行静态快速绳索训练。美国海军陆战队照片 据舰艇观察员称，美国海军陆战队照片两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 于周六从日本横须贺出发。马金岛两栖准备大队包括马金岛、安克雷奇号航空母舰 (LPD-23)、约翰·P·穆萨号航空母舰 (LPD-26) 和已上船的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队，目前正在日本海执行任务。 2026 年 10 月 22 日，来自新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的加勒比海船体维护技术员二等迈克尔·布卢瓦斯三世 (Michael Bloise III) 在加勒比海航行的自由级濒海战斗舰明尼阿波利斯-圣保罗号 (LCS-21) 上进行焊接操作。
美国海军照片 濒海战斗舰明尼阿波利斯-圣保罗号 (LCS-21) 正在加勒比海中部作业。自由级濒海战斗舰驻扎在佛罗里达州梅波特海军基地。在地中海，三级内政通信电工 Micah Lee 在与刘易斯和克拉克级干货船 USNS Medgar Evers (T-AKE-13) 一起在阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰 USS 上进行海上补给之前检查通信设备巴尔克利号（DDG-84）在地中海，2026 年 10 月 22 日。美国海军照片 在地中海执行任务的独立部署的导弹驱逐舰包括：奥斯卡·奥斯汀号航空母舰（DDG-79），母港为罗塔海军基地。 USS Bulkeley (DDG-84)，母港为罗塔海军基地。美国海军保罗·伊格纳修斯号 (DDG-117)，母港为罗塔海军基地。斯托特号 (DDG-55) 母港位于弗吉尼亚州诺福克海军基地。2026 年 10 月 6 日，美国海军水手在阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰奥斯卡·奥斯汀号 (DDG-79) 上的驾驶室里站岗，当时该舰正通过苏伊士运河。美国海军照片 有两艘导弹驱逐舰在红海执行任务： USS Jason Dunham (DDG-109)，母港为佛罗里达州梅波特海军基地。美国海军冈萨雷斯号 (DDG-66)，母港为弗吉尼亚州诺福克海军基地。2026 年 11 月 7 日，在阿拉伯海，乔治·华盛顿号航空母舰 (CVN-73) 与刘易斯和克拉克级干货和弹药舰沃利·施艾拉号 (T-AKE-8) 一起进行海上补给。
美国海军照片 乔治华盛顿号航空母舰 (CVN-73) 以及第 5 号舰载航空联队 (CVW) 和舒普号航空母舰 (DDG-86) 正在阿拉伯海执行任务，以支持美国在中东的行动。 2026 年 10 月 30 日，隶属于第 147 攻击战斗机中队 (VFA) 的第 5 航母战斗群的一架 F-35C 闪电 II 准备从尼米兹级航空母舰乔治·华盛顿号航空母舰 (CVN-73) 的飞行甲板起飞。美国海军照片航空母舰乔治·华盛顿号 (CVN-73)，母港为日本横须贺。航母航空联队 5 “皇家狼牙棒”

11 月 6 日，27 岁的服装工人 Shilpi Khatun 在她位于孟加拉国加济布尔的一间房子外的共用厨房区做饭。路透社

孟加拉国加济布尔——每天黎明前，制衣工人 Shilpi Khatun 都会用燃木粘土炉做饭，因为她的家人买不起天然气，然后前往位于达卡郊区工业中心加济布尔的一家工厂。
这位 27 岁的女孩是家里唯一的经济支柱，她的丈夫失业，她的父母和姻亲靠她的工资生活。
尽管在服装行业工作了五年，但不断上涨的物价使得哈敦难以负担基本生活必需品，数千名孟加拉国服装工人也有同样的挫败感，他们上周举行抗议活动，要求将最低月工资从 12,500 塔卡提高到 30,000 塔卡（合 242.82 美元）。

GAZIPUR, Bangladesh – Before dawn each day, garment worker Shilpi Khatun cooks over a wood-fired clay stove because her family cannot afford gas, before heading to a factory in Gazipur, an industrial hub on the outskirts of Dhaka.
The 27-year-old is the sole breadwinner in a household where her husband is unemployed and her parents and in-laws depend on her wages.
Rising prices have left Khatun struggling to afford basic necessities despite five years in the garment industry, a frustration shared by thousands of Bangladesh’s garment workers who staged protests last week demanding the minimum monthly wage be raised to 30,000 taka ($242.82) from 12,500 taka.

报应总会有 紧跟党走为何落得牛棚自缢？(图) 共產黨 | 換妻 | 國民黨特務 | 土改 | 红朝岁月 |李建华| 看中国网
报应总会有，跟党走的人都应该看看这个故事。（图片来源：Kevin Frayer/Getty Images) 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
提要：这位“老革命”是我的一门亲戚，他在民国时期是一名中学教员，在历次运动中他始终是立场坚定跟共产党走。在五十年代初“换妻运动”中，他把以前的糟糠之妻休弃，换上一位年轻有文化的妙龄美女。文革中，他被当做国民党特务，关进了牛棚，被打得遍体鳞伤，最后在牛棚自缢身亡。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
我要说的这位“老革命”是我的一门亲戚，论辈分是我的爷爷辈，他在民国时期是一名中学教员。那时他就加入了共产党。共产党在那时候的革命行动就是“杀老财，劫富济贫”。据说，他在一个夜晚带领学生把一个地主的头砍了下来。革命就是革别人的命，杀别人的头。别人的血染红了革命者的红顶子和官袍，这就是红色革命。但是他还“心存仁义”，没有斩草除根，没把地主崽子一并杀尽，所以留下了后患。
革命胜利以后，他就做了官。他是教书先生，字好、文章好，在一省会城市当党报主编，行政级别挺高。真是功成名就。
在五十年代初，有一个老革命“换妻运动”，这个“换妻”不是互换，而是把以前的糟糠之妻休弃，换上一位年轻有文化的妙龄美女。真是做官抱得美人归，荣登官衙又入洞房做新郎，人生得意须尽欢。
在历次运动中始终是立场坚定跟党走，他的手能操刀去杀人也能写笔锋锐利的文章，他从未对党的事业有半点怀疑，在前十七年的阶级斗争的战场上披荆斩棘从未跌过跟头，确实是一个百分之百的布尔什维克。
1966年，史无前例的无产阶级文化大革命发动，这次运动不同于从49年开始的历次运动，以前运动斗争对象是反革命、地主、富农、资本家、知识分子，而文革的矛头是对着党内曾经的同志，从党外杀向党内。文革初年清理阶级队伍，弄清每一个人的历史问题，其方法有面对面揭发；背对背揭发；查被怀疑者的个人档案；内查外调，从各个角落寻找以前的历史罪证。
在那时他被关进了牛棚，人身受到了非人的摧残，被打得遍体鳞伤。专案组认定他是国民党员，是国民党特务打入共产党内。专案组声称掌握着加入国民党的证据，要他老实交待自己的反革命罪行。他百口难辩，承认了也是死路一条，不承认那就是顽抗抵赖不认罪，反正是没有生路。说他是国民党特务确实冤枉他了，他始终不承认自己加入过国民党，这样就被关押多年。后来他感到绝望，向专案组提出见他的亲属，专案组同意了他的要求，也希望通过他与家属见面能得到有价值的线索。
他的新娇妻在他被关进牛棚的时候就与他脱离了关系，不可能去看他了。他那被休弃的糟糠妻在他患难时候来看他，他百感交集，内心很自责，觉得对不起自己的前妻。他的一个本家侄子是中央部委一名干部，也获准来看他，侄子来的时候身边有两人陪着，实则是盯梢。叔侄见面也不能多讲话，侄子从他的眼神里看到他的绝望，但只能开导他。他与亲人见面之后在一个夜晚他就在牛棚自缢身亡，就这样走完自己的人生之路。
毛泽东去世之后，粉碎四人帮，经内查外调证明他是被冤枉的。那个揭发他是国民党员的人，正是当年被他杀头地主的儿子。中国有句话：“报仇等机会，君子报仇十年不晚”，人家报这个杀父之仇等了二十多年。人家还不是亲手杀他而是向党揭发，而是借共产党的刀来杀他。他的一些晚辈认为这是“阶级报复”，试想：国家如是民主宪政的社会，他还能搞“阶级报复”吗？

content:
Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology
This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth
Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser.
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.
<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>
We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.
All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.
Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.
There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.
To sum up, the issues were:
No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature
So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.
<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>
"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience.
By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."
We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.
Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.
Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:
"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."
Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>
Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.
Supporting the editors - all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
Supporting our contributors - we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
Recruiting more people - paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
Enhance our level of expertise - we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
Expand our network - we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.
<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>
Munawwar Abdulla is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.
Sonya Imin is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.
Maidina Kadeer is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

专家表示，日本也未能幸免于公众对数据中心的强烈反对
五月份，千叶县印西市的一名公寓居民展示了隔壁目前正在开发的数据中心模型。 |约翰·布鲁克斯
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
上周的美国国会中期选举突显了人们对数据中心建设的强烈反对，而由于法律漏洞和最近急于建设人工智能基础设施的原因，日本也不太可能免受类似的公众强烈反对。
美国选民明确对高耗能数据中心及其对电价的影响表示怀疑。能源新闻平台 Heatmap Pro 和美联社最近的民意调查均显示，超过 70% 的受访者反对在其所在地区建立新的数据中心，从而促成了民主党胜利的“蓝色海啸”。
研究数据中心问题的京都大学城市规划教授 Tetsuharu Oba 表示，日本应该迅速采取行动，寻找解决方案，以解决居民与数据中心开发商之间日益加剧的摩擦。

Japan not immune to public backlash against data centers, experts say - The Japan Times
Japan not immune to public backlash against data centers, experts say
An apartment resident displays a model of a data center currently in development next door in Inzai, Chiba Prefecture, in May. | JOHAN BROOKS
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Last week’s U.S. midterm congressional elections have highlighted just how strong opposition to data center construction has become — and Japan is unlikely to be immune to a similar public backlash amid legal loopholes and a recent rush to build artificial intelligence infrastructure.
U.S. voters clearly expressed skepticism about energy-guzzling data centers and their impact on electricity prices. Recent polls by energy news platform Heatmap Pro and the Associated Press both showed that more than 70% of respondents opposed building new data centers in their areas, contributing to a “blue tsunami” of Democratic victories.
Tetsuharu Oba, a professor of urban planning at Kyoto University who researches data center issues, says Japan should move quickly to find solutions for growing friction between residents and data center developers.

title: ‘A Symphony of Lights’ to dim for good next Wednesday after 22-year run
zh_title: 连续演出 22 年后，《幻彩咏香江》将于下周三永久熄灭
summary: 香港旅游发展局宣布，香港长达 10 分钟的灯光音响表演《幻彩咏香江》定于下周三上演最后一场演出，这是在香港天际线上演 22 年后的最后一场演出。 2026 年 2 月 26 日，游客在尖沙咀观看《幻彩咏香江》演出。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。商人兼香港旅游发展局（旅发局）主席林建岳在周二的新闻发布会上表示，《幻彩咏香江》将在下周三上演最后一场演出后退役。最后的表演将采用额外的烟火元素来纪念这位特殊的妈妈
content:
香港旅游发展局宣布，香港长达 10 分钟的灯光音响表演《幻彩咏香江》定于下周三上演最后一场演出，这是在香港天际线上演 22 年后的最后一场演出。 2026 年 2 月 26 日，游客在尖沙咀观看《幻彩咏香江》演出。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。商人兼香港旅游发展局（旅发局）主席林建岳在周二的新闻发布会上表示，《幻彩咏香江》将在下周三上演最后一场演出后退役。林说，最后的演出将采用额外的烟火元素来纪念这一特殊时刻。政府于二月宣布，计划以在山顶等不同地点举行的其他灯光主题表演取代长期举行的维港灯光秀。从 2004 年开始，这项每日免费的灯光秀涉及天际线上的 43 座建筑，并于 2005 年被吉尼斯世界纪录授予“最大的永久性灯光和声音秀”称号。据香港媒体报道，近年来，随着其他城市推出更大规模的灯光秀，游客认为该灯光秀已经过时且不起眼。旅发局原计划在太平山顶安装灯光秀，以取代长期举行的灯光秀。然而，由于该提案遭到步道使用者和居民的批评，旅游局于 11 月初取消了该计划。林郑月娥周二表示，旅发局将于明年推出新的灯光秀。
WinterFest扩展至三地 林郑月娥周二还宣布，旅发局将于下周三至1月5日举办一年一度的节庆活动“WinterFest”。该活动首次扩展至中环、尖沙咀和铜锣湾三个地点，每个地点都会在圣诞假期期间呈现不同主题的灯光秀。中环2026冬日节的设计概念。照片：香港旅游发展局。林郑月娥周二发表声明称：“多年来，香港冬日节为公众带来欢乐的节日氛围。去年，我们首次与置地公司合作，在中环呈现香港冬日乐园，并与中环多个地标合作举办沉浸式灯光秀，深受市民和旅客欢迎。”主席表示，旅游局将与希慎慎兴合作，在铜锣湾引入装置和灯光秀，而尖沙咀的活动将由香港保诚集团赞助。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong’s 10-minute light and sound show, “A Symphony of Lights,” is scheduled to stage its final show next Wednesday after a 22-year presence on the city’s skyline, the Hong Kong Tourism Board has announced. Tourists watching the show “A Symphony of Lights” in Tsim Sha Tsui on February 26, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Peter Lam, businessman and chair of the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB), said at a press conference on Tuesday that “A Symphony of Lights” would be retired after staging its last show next Wednesday. The final show would feature extra pyrotechnic elements to mark the special moment, Lam said. The government announced in February plans to replace the long-running harbour light show with other light-themed shows in different locations, such as the Peak. Starting in 2004, the free, daily light show – involving 43 buildings across the skyline – was awarded the “Largest Permanent Light and Sound Show” title by the Guinness Book of Records in 2005. In recent years, the show has been considered outdated and unimpressive by tourists as other cities rolled out larger-scale light shows, HKFP reported in March. The HKTB had planned to replace the long-running light show with an installation on the Peak. However, the tourism authority called off the plan in early November after the proposal drew criticism from trail users and residents . Lam said on Tuesday that the HKTB would roll out new light shows next year. WinterFest extended to 3 locales Lam also announced on Tuesday that the HKTB would run its annual festive event, WinterFest, from next Wednesday until January 5. For the first time, the event would be extended to three locations including Central, Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay, with each featuring light shows of different themes during the Christmas holiday. Design concept of 2026 WinterFest in Central. Photo: HKTB. “Over the years, Hong Kong WinterFest has brought a joyful festive atmosphere to the public. Last year, we partnered with Hongkong Land for the first time to present Hong Kong Winter Wonderland in Central, along with an immersive light show staged in collaboration with a number of Central landmarks, which proved hugely popular with locals and visitors alike,” Lam said in a statement issued on Tuesday. The chair said the tourism authority would collaborate with Hysan to introduce installations and light shows in Causeway Bay, while the Tsim Sha Tsui event would be sponsored by Prudential Hong Kong.
