title: Cathay Pacific orders 11 more Airbus A330neos, raising total to 41
zh_title: 国泰航空再订购 11 架空客 A330neo，总数增至 41 架
summary: 根据 2026 年 11 月 11 日发布的香港证券交易所文件，国泰航空已行使另外 11 架空客 A330-900 飞机的购买权，使该型飞机的确定订单达到 41 架。这些权利可以追溯到国泰航空与空客于 2024 年签订的购买协议，根据该协议，国泰航空订购了 30 架 A330-900 飞机，并获得了再购买 30 架的权利。国泰航空预计这11架新飞机将在2031年至2035年期间交付。20​​24年，它表示最初的30架飞机将在2031年底前抵达。空中客车公司同一天宣布，国泰航空集团已下了14架AI的确定订单。
content:
根据 2026 年 11 月 11 日发布的香港证券交易所文件，国泰航空已行使另外 11 架空客 A330-900 飞机的购买权，使该型飞机的确定订单达到 41 架。这些权利可以追溯到国泰航空与空客于 2024 年签订的购买协议，根据该协议，国泰航空订购了 30 架 A330-900 飞机，并获得了再购买 30 架的权利。国泰航空预计这11架新飞机将在2031年至2035年期间交付。20​​24年，该公司表示最初的30架飞机将在2031年底前抵达。空中客车公司同一天宣布，国泰集团已确定总共购买14架飞机，包括11架A330-900和3架A321neo。这些窄体飞机增加了 2023 年 32 架 A321neo 和 A320neo 飞机的订单，但最新的证券交易所备案文件未涵盖这些飞机。 A330neos将取代国泰航空老化的宽体机队新型A330-900将逐步取代国泰航空现有的中型宽体飞机，主要服务于亚洲的支线航线，未来可灵活运营长途服务。根据国泰航空公司的数据，国泰航空拥有 43 架 A330-300 飞机，平均机龄为 18.2 年。
国泰航空首席运营及服务交付官 Alex McGowan 表示，新增飞机将支持该​​集团在亚太地区的区域运营，同时“为运营更长的航班提供更大的灵活性”。空客对 A330neo 采购给予大幅折扣 该文件对这 11 架飞机的基本价格约为 51.1 亿美元（399 亿港元）。不过，国泰航空表示，空客已给予“大幅价格优惠”，使实际购买价格低于该数字。香港联交所授予国泰航空豁免权，允许其保留最终商定的价格。每架飞机将分八期现金支付，其中七期在交付前支付，其余余额在移交时支付。国泰航空可能通过银行贷款、融资租赁、售后租回安排、运营现金或这些来源的组合来为购买提供资金。该交易不需要股东​​批准。国泰航空扩大其空客和波音订单渠道最新订单进一步丰富了国泰航空更广泛的机队更新计划。 2025 年 8 月，该航空公司行使了另外 14 架波音 777-9 的购买权，使对该型号飞机的坚定承诺达到 35 架。该集团还于2026年5月行使了另外两架空客A350F货机的权利。根据其中期报告，截至2026年6月30日，国泰集团拥有105架飞机的确认订单和另外87架飞机的购买权。这些数字早于最新的空客交易。
这一新承诺是国泰集团首席执行官林中基在 2026 年 6 月的国际航空运输协会年度大会上发表评论后作出的，当时他表示将进一步订购宽体机、窄体机和货机。国泰航空又订购了 11 架空客 A330neo，使总数达到 41 架。

【原文 English Original】
Cathay Pacific has exercised purchase rights for 11 additional Airbus A330-900 aircraft, bringing its firm orders for the type to 41, according to a Hong Kong Stock Exchange filing published on November 11, 2026. The rights date back to Cathay’s 2024 purchase agreement with Airbus, under which the airline ordered 30 A330-900s and secured the right to acquire 30 more. Cathay expects the eleven new aircraft to be delivered between 2031 and 2035. In 2024 , it said the original 30 would arrive by the end of 2031. Airbus announced the same day that the Cathay Group had placed a firm order for 14 aircraft in total, comprising the eleven A330-900s and three A321neos. The narrowbodies add to a 2023 order for 32 A321neo and A320neo aircraft and are not covered by the latest stock exchange filing. A330neos to replace Cathay Pacific’s aging widebody fleet The new A330-900s will progressively replace Cathay Pacific’s existing mid-size widebody aircraft, primarily serving regional routes in Asia, with the flexibility to operate longer-haul services in the future. Cathay Pacific operates 43 A330-300s with an average age of 18.2 years, as per ch-aviation data . Cathay Chief Operations and Service Delivery Officer Alex McGowan said the additional aircraft would support the group’s regional operations across Asia-Pacific while “providing greater flexibility to operate longer flights.” Airbus grants significant discounts on A330neo purchase The filing values the eleven aircraft at a basic price of approximately $5.11 billion (HK39.9 billion). However, Cathay said Airbus had granted “significant price concessions,” bringing the actual purchase price below that figure. The Hong Kong Stock Exchange granted Cathay a waiver allowing it to withhold the final agreed price. Each aircraft will be paid for in eight cash installments, with seven due before delivery and the remaining balance payable upon handover. Cathay may finance the purchase through bank loans, finance leases, sale-and-leaseback arrangements, operating cash, or a combination of these sources. The transaction does not require shareholder approval. Cathay expands its Airbus and Boeing order pipeline The latest order adds to Cathay’s wider fleet renewal program. In August 2025, the airline exercised purchase rights for 14 additional Boeing 777-9s , bringing its firm commitment for the type to 35 aircraft. The group also exercised rights for two additional Airbus A350F freighters in May 2026. As of June 30, 2026, Cathay Group had 105 aircraft on firm order and purchase rights for another 87, according to its interim report. Those figures predate the latest Airbus transaction. The new commitment follows comments by Cathay Group CEO Ronald Lam at the International Air Transport Association annual general meeting in June 2026, when he signaled further orders for widebody, narrowbody and freighter aircraft. content:
Belize Jungle & Island Glamping Adventure Tour, Sun, Nov 29, 2026, 7:00 AM | Meetup
Belize Jungle & Island Glamping Adventure Tour
Join our Belize Jungle Adventure Tour & Glamping adventure trip for women only! Spend 8 glorious days staying active in a tropical paradise! Explore the rainforest jungle, try waterfall rappelling, discover ancient Mayan ruins, snorkel, zip-line, and more! Enjoy all of this, plus luxurious glamping on a remote Caribbean island.
Trade endless staff meetings for a heart-thumping collision of mainland jungle exploration and tropical island glamping on a UNESCO-designated Marine Preserve?! Forgive us, but you aren’t going to BELIZE this trip.
Your adventure in Belize will encompass the best adrenaline-pumping jungle activities on the mainland and the serene, remote island experience in the middle of the Caribbean Sea on a UNESCO-designated Marine Preserve.
During the first half of your jungle adventure, you’ll explore Mayan ruins, navigate caves featuring 3,000-year-old artifacts, and immerse yourself in the Belizean Jungle embarking on new adventures each day.
WATERFALL RAPPELLING, ZIP-LINING, AND CAVING
Learn to rappel and descend 250 feet from the top of a waterfall with views as far as the turquoise Caribbean Sea. Zip-line 2.5 miles through Bocawina National Park over the jungle canopy enjoying Belize from a bird’s eye view. Then, channel your inner Indiana Jones as you strap on your headlamp and step back in time 3,000 years into the depths of a cave with Mayan artifacts and ceremonial alters.
To top it off, wander the archaeological grounds of Xunantunich. An ancient civilization of over 200,000 people thrived here until 1,000 years ago, when it was mysteriously abandoned. During your adventures on the mainland, stay in a Rainforest Eco-Lodge powered completely by hydroelectricity and solar with your gang of Explorer Chick gal pals.
SNORKELING, KAYAKING, AND SUP
On the second half of your Belize Jungle Tour Adventure, we’ll whisk you away from the mainland! Travel by boat 36 miles to a remote island Glamping base camp for the next 5 days and 4 nights.
Glover’s Reef Marine Preserve is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is one of only four atolls in the western hemisphere. The turquoise waters are host to over 700 patch reefs. It is one of the richest tropical marine environments in the Caribbean. The waters here are exceptionally clear because of its isolation from the mainland making it a utopia for spotting marine life and water activities. Hello, coral reefs and all the fishies! 🐠
Fill your days with water activities exploring your remote island paradise. Grab snorkel gear and head out on a SUP to swim with sea turtles and colorful fish. Learn to use the wind to your advantage and kayak sail to coral destinations. Master the technique of line fishing from local Belizean guides and cook up your catch for dinner. Or, just kick it in a hammock with a good book as the wind rocks you gently. Oh, and you bet there will be dance parties as you learn Garifuna moves.💃
PRIVATE, REMOTE ISLAND GLAMPING
So, what really makes these last five days special? Your home away from home on a remote, 13-acre island! These digs are Pinterest-worthy tent-walled cabanas with real beds, wooden floors, a porch, and that essential ocean view right outside your screened door. 👌 Go to sleep each night to the sound of the sea lapping the shore from your Cabana.
Wake up each day to views of the Caribbean and learn a new definition of paradise. Embrace the Belizean way of life devoid of chaos and spend your days on Ocean Time. This is not to say our days will be spent like a fly and flop vacation, tanning on the beach. Heck no! Your days will be filled with the perfect amount of activity and relaxation to give you the ultimate and authentic Caribbean Island experience off the coast of Belize.
See the website for full itinerary, details and to book.

（中央社記者張淑伶北京11日電）中日關係持續緊張，外界關注下週登場的APEC深圳峰會上，日相高市早苗是否會與中國國家主席習近平會談，中國外交部發言人郭嘉昆未鬆口，表示中方已經多次對中日關係闡明立場。
北京青年報新媒體「政知見」報導，有外媒11日在外交部例行記者會上提問：中國領導人是否會在亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）領袖峰會上會見日本首相高市早苗？以及如果會的話，他們二位會談論什麼？
郭嘉昆僅表示，作為2026年APEC東道主，中方積極履行東道主義務，願同各方一道共同推動APEC中國年取得圓滿成功。關於中日關係，中方已經多次闡明立場。
日本共同社10日報導，多名日中關係消息人士指出，中國政府仍對高市早苗2025年11月在國會答詢時發表的涉台言論（「台灣有事」說）持強硬立場，拒絕她與習近平舉行正式會談，使雙方難以就領袖會談取得共識。
1名中方消息人士說，日本可能成為這次APEC峰會主要與會國中，唯一沒有與中方舉行雙邊會談的國家。
報導指出，日本政府仍在爭取促成高市早苗與習近平會談，但兩人在峰會期間握手或短暫交流，可能是「更現實的選項」。
日中關係自高市發表相關國會答詢以來持續惡化，即使本月7日屆滿1周年，惡化趨勢仍未停止。（編輯：廖文綺）1151111

title: China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV
zh_title: 中国揭开GJ-11神秘龙隐形无人机的面纱
summary: 中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人战斗机已经进行了多年的测试架次，包括在前方
content:
中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人作战飞机多年来已经进行了多次测试，包括在前沿作战地点，而且在此之前几乎无法想象是否进行过实弹武器投送。也许这是在转换过程中丢失某些东西的情况，例如使用新的内部传感器或新型武器发射。跑道上 GJ-11 的正面视图。 PLA screencap 这段视频昨天由中国国家电视台中央电视台播出，距离中国人民解放军空军成立 77 周年还有两天。随附的报告提供了有关该飞机预期任务集的更多详细信息，包括空袭和压制敌方防空系统（SEAD），以及它与有人战斗机的有人与无人编队（MUM-T）行动的整合。
新披露的信息让公众对 GJ-11 的配置有了最全面的了解，并进一步了解中国打算如何使用这款名为“玄龙”的隐形飞翼飞机。GJ-11 起飞。 PLA screencap 仔细观察 GJ-11 最暴露的视图之一显示了 GJ-11 的底面，清楚地暴露了其两个内部武器舱。腹侧舱位于飞机的混合翼体内，具有独立的门组，具有独特的锯齿状边缘——这是低可观察性飞机的常见特征。舱室的内部布局和尺寸仍不清楚，飞机可容纳的武器的精确范围也不清楚。然而，每个舱室似乎可以容纳至少 1,000 磅级武器，甚至可能容纳 2,000 磅级武器。 #GTMilitaryWatch 央视新闻军事频道周一发布了新镜头，以多角度特写镜头展示了中国人民解放军 (PLA) 空军的 GJ-11 隐形无人机。它还透露，空军首批自行训练的两架女无人机… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ —《环球时报》（@globaltimesnews）2026年11月9日 据央视报道，这两个舱可携带多种空对地/水面弹药。
此前，中国航空工业集团公司 (AVIC) 在 2021 年中国航展上展示的 GJ-11 模型中曾透露过武器舱配置，但新的镜头可以更好地展示实际飞机。机库中 GJ-11 的正面视图，武器舱门部分打开。 PLA screencap 内部武器架是 GJ-11 隐蔽性设计的核心，使其能够携带弹药，而不会受到与外部挂架和挂具相关的雷达信号（和空气动力学）影响。此前于 2025 年 11 月发布的视频显示，GJ-11 正在飞行，起落架仍处于伸出状态。然而，其中一个新序列显示飞机起飞，随后的侧视图和后视图捕捉到了其起落架在升空后收回的情况。起落架本身非常坚固，包括一个重型起落架

【原文 English Original】
China has provided us with the clearest look yet at its GJ-11 stealth uncrewed combat aerial vehicle (UCAV), with new official footage revealing previously unseen details of the flying-wing drone, including its internal weapons bays, landing gear, nose-mounted sensor installation, and distinctive exhaust arrangement. The release also comes alongside a claim from the People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) that the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, scoring a hit. This is somewhat puzzling, since the UCAV has racked up test sorties for years already, including at forward operating locations, and it seems almost inconceivable that a live weapons delivery would not have been conducted before now. Perhaps this is a case of something being lost in translation, such as the use of a new internal sensor or a new type of weapon delivery. Head-on view of a GJ-11 on the runway. PLA screencap The footage, broadcast by Chinese state television’s CCTV yesterday, comes two days ahead of the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PLAAF. Accompanying reporting provides additional details about the aircraft’s intended mission set, including airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD), as well as its integration into manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) operations with crewed fighters. The new disclosures offer the most comprehensive public look yet at the GJ-11’s configuration and provide further insight into how China intends to employ the stealthy flying-wing aircraft, which is named Xuanlong — Chinese for Mystery Dragon. A GJ-11 takes off. PLA screencap A closer look at the GJ-11 One of the most revealing views shows the underside of the GJ-11, clearly exposing its two internal weapons bays. Located within the aircraft’s blended wing-body, the ventral bays have separate sets of doors with distinctive serrated edges — a common feature on low-observable aircraft. The internal arrangement and dimensions of the bays remain unclear, as does the precise range of weapons the aircraft can accommodate. However, it would appear likely that each bay can accommodate at least a 1,000-pound-class and likely a 2,000-pound-class weapon. #GTMilitaryWatch CCTV News military channel released new footage on Monday offering a close-up, multi-angle look at the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force's GJ-11 stealth drone. It also revealed that two of the Air Force's first batch of self-trained female drone… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ — Global Times (@globaltimesnews) November 9, 2026 According to CCTV , the two bays can carry a variety of air-to-ground/surface munitions. The weapons bay configuration had previously been revealed in a model of the GJ-11 displayed by the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) at Airshow China in 2021, but the new footage provides a much better look at the actual aircraft. Head-on view of a GJ-11 in the hangar, with the weapons bay doors partially open. PLA screencap Internal weapons carriage is central to the GJ-11’s low-observable design, allowing it to carry munitions without the radar signature (and aerodynamic) penalties associated with external pylons and stores. Previous footage released in November 2025 showed the GJ-11 in flight with its landing gear remaining extended. However, one of the new sequences shows the aircraft taking off, with subsequent side and rear views capturing its landing gear retracting after liftoff. The landing gear itself is notably robust, including a heavy-duty twin-wheel nose unit. With that in mind, it may be the same landing gear as used in the GJ-21, a naval variant capable of operating from aircraft carriers and big-deck assault ships. A GJ-11 retracts its landing gear on takeoff. PLA screencap The new imagery also offers a closer look at a trapezoidal glazed fairing beneath the nose. This appears consistent with an electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor installation. Its precise configuration and capabilities have not been disclosed, but it’s worth noting that similar-looking installations also appear on the crewed J-20 and J-35 fighters, with these systems apparently being analogous to the electro-optical targeting system, or EOTS, found on the F-35 . If the sensor on the GJ-11 works like an EOTS, it would provide the drone with precision targeting and identification, lasing, as well as a secondary infrared search-and-track emulation function. A view of a GJ-11 showing the undernose EO/IR sensor installation. PLA screencap Perhaps the most distinctive external feature remains the GJ-11’s exhaust arrangement, for what is reported to be a WS-13 turbofan engine. A close-up of the rear of the aircraft shows the flattened exhaust outlet, shielded and integrated into the upper rear portion of the flying-wing airframe. Combined with the dorsal air intake and the absence of conventional exposed engine nozzles, this configuration is intended to reduce the aircraft’s radar and infrared signatures, especially from the most critical view aspects. The GJ-11’s tailless, blended-wing configuration is by now a defining feature of low-observable UCAV designs. Close-up of the tail section of a GJ-11. PLA screencap At least some of the GJ-11s shown have an air data boom on the nose. While normally associated with early flight testing, the GJ-11 is now far beyond that. The booms could still be fitted for some envelope expansion and other flight test work, although it may also simply involve earlier footage. Airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses Beyond the new imagery, one of the more interesting aspects of the CCTV coverage is its description of the GJ-11’s intended operational role. The broadcaster identified airstrikes and SEAD among the aircraft’s mission sets. The latter is particularly significant, as penetrating or operating within heavily defended airspace to locate and suppress or destroy enemy air defense systems is the most dangerous mission for a crewed combat aircraft. A stealthy uncrewed aircraft could contribute to these operations by carrying precision-guided weapons into more contested areas, providing additional sensing and targeting capacity, or forcing an adversary to expend valuable air defense resources. The two internal weapons bays provide the means to carry air-to-surface munitions while retaining the aircraft’s low-observable configuration. However, we don’t know which specific weapons have been integrated, their quantities, or whether the GJ-11 can employ dedicated anti-radiation weapons for SEAD missions. Alternative SEAD/DEAD loads could include multiple Small Diameter Bomb (SDB) equivalents, including those that are networked, as we have seen in previous concept videos . Many other types of standoff weapons could also be carried, with the platform itself using onboard sensors for fixing the target or acquiring targeting information from other sources via a tactical data network. Overhead view of a GJ-11 outside the hangar. PLA screencap First live-fire strike claim According to CCTV , the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, with two members of the PLAAF’s initial batch of female drone operators participating in the operation. One of the operators, Shi Xiaoran, described encountering cloud cover that initially obscured the target. After circling once more, she located it and released the weapon, scoring a hit. A drone controller flies a GJ-11 from a command-and-control trailer. PLA screencap One aspect that remains unclear is the extent to which the aircraft can independently identify and engage targets. A successful strike would demonstrate weapons employment, but not necessarily autonomous targeting or engagement. A view of a GJ-11 showing its triangular engine intake and undernose sensor installation. PLA screencap Manned-unmanned teaming with J-16 and J-20 fighters Perhaps the most strategically important aspect of the new coverage is its emphasis on manned-unmanned teaming. The CCTV footage showed mission planning involving a GJ-11 operating alongside J-16 Flanker multirole fighters and, in a separate sequence, J-20 fifth-generation stealth fighters. This provides a more explicit indication of the role China envisions for the GJ-11 within its broader combat aviation ecosystem. The J-16 provides a powerful multirole platform for strike and electronic warfare-related missions , while the J-20 offers a stealthy crewed counterpart for operations in highly contested airspace. An uncrewed aircraft operating alongside either type could extend the formation’s sensor coverage, carry additional weapons, conduct reconnaissance, or undertake particularly hazardous missions. A J-16D electronic warfare aircraft. via Chinese internet As a loyal wingman, the GJ-11’s role would extend beyond simply carrying weapons, with the UCAV able to act as an additional airborne sensor and strike platform, allowing crewed aircraft to distribute tasks across a larger formation. At the same time, the footage does not establish how the UCAVs communicate with their crewed counterparts, how targeting information is shared, or the level of autonomy available to the GJ-11. The new footage shows the drone being flown under man-in-the-loop (MITL) direct control, but it likely features, or will feature, semi-autonomous control modes, especially for teaming applications, which will require a high degree of onboard autonomy. We do know that China expects the UCAV to be controlled by crewed aircraft, as part of its basic concept. The PLAAF has at least trialed crewed aircraft as drone controllers , and this is one mission set that has frequently been ascribed to the two-seat J-20S . A stock photo of the two-seat J-20S. via X From prototype to operational platform After years of development involving the experimental Sharp Sword design , the much more evolved GJ-11 platform was publicly unveiled during China’s National Day military parade in Beijing in October 2019. Its development is associated with Hongdu Aviation Industry Group, part of the broader AVIC aviation-industrial structure. Two views of an early Sharp Sword UCAV demonstrator. via X A model displayed by AVIC at Airshow China in 2021 provided an early indication of the aircraft’s internal weapons-carrying arrangement. In November 2025, as we reported at the time , the PLAAF released footage of the GJ-11 flying alongside a J-20 and a J-16D electronic warfare aircraft, suggesting that it may have entered service or was at least being integrated into the service’s broader air combat architecture. A screencap from an earlier video showing a GJ-11 flying alongside a J-16D and a J-20. PLA screencap Development and testing of the GJ-11 have been underway for years, with notable activity at China’s secretive Malan test facility in Xinjiang. Satellite imagery reviewed by TWZ has documented repeated, and at times near-daily, GJ-11 activity there, including multiple aircraft operating together. The deployment of three GJ-11s to Shigatse in Tibet between August and September 2025 provided an additional indication that the program was moving beyond test work toward operational evaluation. Two GJ-11s seen on the ramp at Malan on July 12, 2024. PHOTO © 2024 PLANET LABS INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. REPRINTED BY PERMISSION Another image circulating on Chinese social media shows three additional GJ-11s parked alongside another example of the same type. Three GJ-11s in a hangar. PLA screencap Another hangar view with likely a fourth GJ-11 just visible on the right. PLA screencap According to Andreas Rupprecht, an expert on Chinese aviation and contributor to TWZ , numbers that can be seen on the drones themselves likely point to these aircraft being low-rate initial production (LRIP) examples. And what’s even more interesting is that, for the first time, numbers are clearly visible which – and I’m going to go out on a limb here – I believe are not serial numbers but rather design numbers. The numbers 0003, 0011 and 0012 are visible, so these are probably LRIP aircraft. pic.twitter.com/zH2D2Narr9 — @Rupprecht_A (@RupprechtDeino) November 10, 2026 The new releases come less than a month after China announced that the GJ-21 naval derivative had completed its first launch and recovery aboard the new Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan , which is equipped with an electromagnetic catapult and arresting gear. The milestone would pave the way for the PLA Navy to field a shipborne stealth UCAV for strike and reconnaissance missions. However, China has yet to release actual footage of the claimed operation, leaving it independently unverified. The Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan seen leaving Hudong-Zhonghua Shipyard for its first sea trials. Government of the People’s Republic of China The broader significance of the GJ-11 lies in the fact that it’s a genuine UCAV, not simply a loyal wingman designed to accompany a crewed fighter . Free of the endurance limitations imposed by a human crew, a platform of this class could likely offer at least twice the combat radius of a comparable crewed fighter. More importantly, it is intended to have the autonomy to conduct tactical missions independently, as well as operate alongside crewed aircraft. That opens up the possibility of extending China’s strike and reconnaissance reach considerably beyond what its existing low-observable crewed combat aircraft can achieve. The GJ-11’s flying-wing configuration, internal weapons bays, and emphasis on signature reduction suggest a platform approaching the very-low-observable (VLO) category. At the same time, China is now openly fielding a capability that the United States has conspicuously failed to bring into public operational service. In the late 2000s and early 2010s, the United States appeared to be leading the way in stealth UCAV development, with programs such as the Boeing Phantom Ray , X-45 , and X-47B demonstrating the potential of autonomous, long-range penetrating aircraft. Yet those ambitions effectively disappeared from the publicly acknowledged force-development agenda. The Pentagon has instead concentrated on lower-end and less capable Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), generally designed to operate in conjunction with crewed fighters . Northrop Grumman’s X-47B UCAV demonstrator. U.S. Navy Northrop Grumman’s much larger X-47B that also featured a ‘cranked kite’ planform. USN As we argued in our earlier examinations of the American UCAV gap , the absence of a publicly acknowledged, sizeable force of independent, long-range stealth combat drones remains a significant weakness in U.S. airpower planning. Classified programs may exist, and the U.S. military certainly operates highly sophisticated stealthy uncrewed reconnaissance platforms , but even a small clandestine combat capability would be unlikely to make a decisive difference in a major, sustained conflict. China, meanwhile, is moving towards making this class of aircraft a central part of its military inventory. Important questions about the GJ-11 remain, particularly regarding its actual weapons load, various specifications, its degree of autonomy, and its ability to operate in coordination with crewed fighters. However, the latest official coverage provides the clearest indication yet of how China intends to employ its stealth UCAV in a future conflict, and sheds a little more light on the Mystery Dragon. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV appeared first on TWZ .

title: 程万军遭遣返 台移民署：因自伤、抗拒曾采取“必要措施”
summary: 文章来源：rfa 记者：Alan Lu 流亡海外的中国媒体人程万军指控，台湾移民署在遣返他回泰国、押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 (图截取自程万军视频) 曾任中国央视《法律讲堂》主讲人的程万军，周二(3日)在台湾桃园机场寻求人道庇护，随后被遣返泰国。他11月4日公开指控，台湾移民署人员押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 程万军搭乘的班机原定从泰国曼谷经台湾转机返回北京，他11月2日抵达桃园机场后，向移民署人员表示自己遭受中共政治迫害，希望暂时留在台湾，等待前往
content: 文章来源：rfa 记者：Alan Lu 流亡海外的中国媒体人程万军指控，台湾移民署在遣返他回泰国、押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 (图截取自程万军视频) 曾任中国央视《法律讲堂》主讲人的程万军，周二(3日)在台湾桃园机场寻求人道庇护，随后被遣返泰国。他11月4日公开指控，台湾移民署人员押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 程万军搭乘的班机原定从泰国曼谷经台湾转机返回北京，他11月2日抵达桃园机场后，向移民署人员表示自己遭受中共政治迫害，希望暂时留在台湾，等待前往第三国寻求庇护。 不过，台湾主管机关审查后未同意其申请，并于3日晚间将他送返曼谷。 程万军4日向自由亚洲电台指控移民署人员在执行遣返过程中，将他捆绑押送，并以毛巾堵嘴、口罩蒙面及勒住手腕等方式限制行动。他还指控自己在机上遭到殴打，身体多处受伤，抵达曼谷后前往医疗机构接受急救。 程万军称，有移民署人员曾对他说“你的死活与我们无关”，并批评台湾陆委会没有详细审查其提交的材料，便决定将他遣返。他表示，将向台湾监察院及法院提出控告。 上述程万军有关遭捆绑、殴打及台湾官员言论的说法，本台无法独立核实。 台湾移民署回应表示，程万军未能就其诉求提出具体事证，不符合援助条件及资格，且没有有效入境许可，因此依《入出国及移民法》第50条，将他送返泰国曼谷。 移民署同时表示，程万军在登机过程中极力抗拒，并出现“自伤”行为，因此采取必要措施维护飞航安全，相关作为均属依法行政。移民署的声明未逐项回应程万军所称遭到殴打，以及有官员发表不当言论等指控。 程万军提供照片，称自己遭受殴打，以致身体多处受伤，并于抵达曼谷后前往医疗机构接受急救。  (程万军提供) 陆委会：无法核实遭迫害情形 台湾陆委会4日发布声明表示，每年都会发生多起中国人士在台湾机场寻求暂时留置的类似案件，政府必须建立甄别机制，不可能每件申请都予以接受。 陆委会指出，本案的主要关键，是政府无法核实程万军所称遭受迫害的情况。除当事人本人的声明外，目前没有其他第三方事证可以佐证；程万军也能够自由进出中国，没有受到人身自由限制。因此，主管机关只能依既有机制将他送回泰国。 陆委会强调，台湾政府对中国异议人士一向抱持尽量援助的立场，但有关申请仍须遵守台湾法律及国境管理制度。 程万军则表示，他离开中国后曾在泰国发表反对中共的言论，因此担心遭遣返回中国。目前他的泰国签证即将到期，正透过独立中文笔会及加拿大救援团队，申请前往第三国避难。 台湾学者：应评估未来风险 台湾华人民主书院协会理事长曾建元接受本台采访时表示，庇护审查不应只判断当事人过去是否已经遭受政治迫害，也应评估其未来遭迫害的风险。 他说，程万军能够合法离开中国，并不代表返国后没有风险。程万军在抵达泰国后发表的反共言论，可能增加他被遣返后遭到追究的危险。审查重点应是这种风险是否存在及程度高低，而不是等到迫害事实已经发生，才考虑是否提供保护。 曾建元指出，台湾至今没有通过《难民法》，政治庇护也缺乏完整的法律及行政程序。政府只能针对个案作出政治判断及职权裁量，容易受到不同时空、两岸关系及国际环境影响，也可能产生处理标准前后不一的问题。 他建议，即使《难民法》短期内难以通过，台湾政府至少应制定行政命令，明确申请条件、审查程序、所需证据及驳回理由，并让民间团体及申请人了解决定依据。 “每个个案都是政治决定，这并不好。”曾建元说，建立公开标准，才能使申请人知道可能面对哪些风险，也能让政府的处理立场较为一致。 近年已有多名中国维权人士在桃园机场转机时寻求庇护。2023年，陈思明在没有入境台湾的情况下，最终获准前往加拿大；今年9月，为北京锡安教会辩护的律师王夏红一家，也获台湾暂时人道安置。但其他数起申请者则遭送返前一出发地。 曾建元认为，台湾社会对于接纳难民仍缺乏高度共识，朝野政党也多半回避相关立法，因此《难民法》何时能够通过仍不乐观。程万军案再次凸显，在缺乏明确法律及审查标准的情况下，台湾如何处理中国异议人士的庇护申请，仍高度依赖政府对个案作出的行政裁量。

title: Nvidia stock gets its first boost of the Jensen Huang scandal era. What’s driving shares higher today?
zh_title: 英伟达股价在黄仁勋丑闻时代首次上涨。今天是什么推动股价走高？
summary: Nvidia Corp.（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）的股价周三盘前上涨超过 4%，这要归功于 CoreWeave。在首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍有婚外情的消息传出后，这家半导体巨头连续几天目睹其股价暴跌。过去五天股价下跌 15.61%，本月下跌 26.34%。现在，Nvidia 的股票似乎受益于 CoreWeave 的好消息。周二，这家云计算公司公布了第三季度收益，超出了华尔街的收入预期，并改善了前景。 CoreWeave 收入增至 36.6 亿美元
content:
Nvidia Corp.（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）的股价周三盘前上涨超过 4%，这要归功于 CoreWeave。在首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍有婚外情的消息传出后，这家半导体巨头连续几天目睹其股价暴跌。过去五天股价下跌 15.61%，本月下跌 26.34%。现在，Nvidia 的股票似乎受益于 CoreWeave 的好消息。周二，这家云计算公司公布了第三季度收益，超出了华尔街的收入预期，并改善了前景。根据 CNBC 援引的共识估计，CoreWeave 的收入升至 36.6 亿美元，高于预期的 35.5 亿美元。其收入同比增长 168%。该公司还将 2026 年全年收入预期从 130 亿美元上调至 133 亿美元。作为回应，CoreWeave 的股价（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）在周三盘前上涨了 15% 以上。为什么 CoreWeave 的成功对 Nvidia 有帮助？总体而言，当一家大型人工智能公司取得成功时，它有助于缓解投资者对人工智能泡沫破裂的担忧，从而提振其他人工智能股票。在这种情况下，Nvidia 可以从 CoreWeave 的成功中获益更多。今年1月，英伟达向CoreWeave投资20亿美元，成为该公司第二大股东。因此，当 CoreWeave 表现出色时，它会直接提升 Nvidia 的地位。此次上涨也标志着 CoreWeave 的好转，该公司的股价因担心人工智能超支而陷入困境。
像专门针对人工智能的云提供商 CoreWeave 这样的所谓新云公司最近受到的打击尤其严重。在发布财报之前，CoreWeave 的股价上个月下跌了 40.63%。英伟达会发生什么？英伟达的情况将如何改变，目前谁都在猜测。博彩市场预测黄仁勋不会辞去首席执行官一职——至少在短期内不会。公司董事会目前正在调查他的事件以及对公司的影响。与此同时，贝尔德刚刚将英伟达的股票评级从“跑赢大盘”下调至“中性”。据 CNBC 报道，摩根士丹利也放弃了英伟达的首选公司之一。

【原文 English Original】
Shares of Nvidia Corp. (Nasdaq: NVDA) rose over 4% in premarket on Wednesday, and it has CoreWeave to thank. The semiconductor giant has spent days watching its stock tumble following news that CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with a alleged Chinese spy. Shares were down 15.61% in the last five days and 26.34% for the month. Now, Nvidia’s stock appears to be benefiting from good news over at CoreWeave. On Tuesday, the cloud-computing company shared third-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street’s revenue estimates and included an improved outlook. CoreWeave’s revenue rose to $3.66 billion, higher than the expected $3.55 billion, according to consensus estimates cited by CNBC . Its revenue was up 168% year-over-year (YOY).  The company also raised its 2026 full year outlook for revenue from $13 billion to $13.3 billion.  CoreWeave’s shares (Nasdaq: CRWV) rose over 15% during premarket Wednesday in response.   Why does CoreWeave’s success help Nvidia? Overall, when one major AI company succeeds it helps ease investors’ concerns about the AI bubble bursting, buoying fellow AI stocks alongside it. In this case, Nvidia has even more to gain from CoreWeave’s success. In January, Nvidia invested $2 billion in CoreWeave , making it the company’s second largest shareholder. So, when CoreWeave does well, it directly boosts Nvidia’s standing. This jump also marks a turnaround for CoreWeave, which has seen its stock struggle amid fears of AI overspending . So-called neocloud companies like CoreWeave, a cloud provider specialized for AI, have been hit especially hard recently. Ahead of its earnings report, CoreWeave’s shares were down 40.63% in the last month. What will happen at Nvidia? How things at Nvidia will shake out is anyone’s guess right now. Betting markets predict that Huang won’t leave the CEO role —at least any time soon. The company’s board of directors is currently investigating his affair and any impact on the company. At the same time, Baird just downgraded Nvidia’s stock from “Outperform” to “Neutral.” Morgan Stanley also dropped Nvidia as one of its top picks, CNBC reports .

content:
2026年11月5日，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京（Vladimir Putin，左）在莫斯科会谈前，与伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书穆赫辛·雷扎伊（Mohsen Rezaei）握手。（图片来源：Alexey BABUSHKIN / POOL / AFP via Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月11日讯】（看中国记者路克编译/综合）伊朗重申不会将任何浓缩核材料运往国外，为美伊结束战争的外交努力再添阻力。此前，美国总统川普(特朗普)释放积极信号，带动市场对和平的期待，国际油价随之回落。但双方在核问题上的分歧，仍是达成协议的一道难关。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
据美国哥伦比亚广播公司新闻网（CBS News）2026年11月11日报道，伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书穆赫辛·雷扎伊（Mohsen Rezaei）当天表示，伊朗不会允许“哪怕一粒浓缩核材料”离开本国。
路透社同日报道，雷扎伊接受黎巴嫩迈亚丁电视台采访时，还警告美国不要发动新的打击，声称伊朗届时将把境外美军基地列为报复目标。他同时表示，德黑兰与华盛顿目前没有进行谈判。
这番表态显示，即使外界对外交突破抱有期待，伊朗在浓缩核材料去留这一关键问题上，仍坚持原有立场。
双方的分歧不仅涉及核材料，也涉及谈判应按什么顺序展开。
华盛顿要求，将核问题纳入旨在结束战争的初步谈判。伊朗则为讨论核方案设置前提。路透社援引一名伊朗高级官员的话报道，德黑兰已通过卡塔尔向美国递交核问题提案，但要求美国先满足伊方提出的七项条件。
据路透社引述的国际原子能机构估计，在2025年6月伊朗核设施遭到美以袭击前，伊朗拥有440.9公斤丰度为60%的浓缩铀，明显高于通常民用所需水平。这批材料有多少保存下来，目前仍不清楚。伊朗一直否认寻求核武器。
欧洲新闻台（Euronews）在2026年11月10日刊发的报道中指出，川普11月9日在白宫会见卡塔尔首相穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿勒萨尼（Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani）后，表示结束战争出现了“积极势头”，双方深入讨论了伊朗问题。
川普在“真实社交”平台发文称，美国已做好军事准备，但鉴于海湾地区主要盟友倾向于维持现状，他认为进一步发动打击的可能性很低。他此前接受美国有线电视新闻网采访时，也表达了类似判断。
当天早间，布伦特原油价格下跌1.31%，至每桶91.36美元；美国西得克萨斯中质原油下跌1.59%，至每桶85.47美元。
截至该报道发布时，两大原油基准价格当月累计跌幅均约为20%。交易员押注，持续约七个月的冲突有望得到解决，供应风险随之缓解。
不过，市场的和平预期仍有待谈判进展支撑。伊朗拒绝将浓缩核材料运出境，加上双方对谈判条件的分歧，意味着结束战争仍有关键障碍需要跨越。

title: Schneider Electric explores technology convergence in mining
zh_title: 施耐德电气探索采矿业技术融合
summary: 施耐德电气表示，它正在将电气化、自动化和数字智能结合在一起，帮助矿山作为人工智能驱动的软件定义平台运行，连接能源和工业智能。跨越三个互联层的人工智能 该公司描述了帮助矿业公司应用人工智能的三个层面： 互联设备：智能设备感知操作条件并提供数据和控制功能；边缘控制和计算：仿真和自动化使用AI来支持灵活、高效和有弹性的系统性能；以及应用程序、分析和服务：
content:
施耐德电气表示，它正在将电气化、自动化和数字智能结合在一起，帮助矿山作为人工智能驱动的软件定义平台运行，连接能源和工业智能。跨越三个互联层的人工智能 该公司描述了帮助矿业公司应用人工智能的三个层面： 互联设备：智能设备感知操作条件并提供数据和控制功能；边缘控制和计算：仿真和自动化使用AI来支持灵活、高效和有弹性的系统性能；应用程序、分析和服务：人工智能驱动的见解支持协作、明智的行动和企业价值。施耐德电气利用其技术组合将来自设备、边缘和分析层的过程和能源数据与采矿专业知识和生态系统集成相结合。这支持整个采矿作业生命周期（从设计和施工到运营和维护）的数字孪生。 Torngat Metals：综合稀土合作伙伴 Torngat Metals 在开发加拿大 Strange Lake 稀土项目时，正在利用这些专业知识和集成能力。两家公司签署了一份不具约束力的谅解备忘录（MoU），以探索战略工业合作伙伴关系，支持弹性和负责任的稀土价值链。
拟议的合作伙伴关系以努纳维克的奇异湖、拉布拉多的相关基础设施以及计划中的九岛分离设施为中心。它将通过端到端的合作，将上游资源开发、技术集成和未来工业需求联系起来。该谅解备忘录概述了潜在的 360° 合作伙伴关系，有两个目标： 支持项目开发：将施耐德电气在电气化、自动化、数字系统和可持续工业设计方面的专业知识应用于下一代采矿和加工项目；增强供应链弹性：改善施耐德电气长期获得安全、负责任和合规的稀土和磁体生态系统的战略应用。奇湖预计将生产可再生能源、数字基础设施和先进制造中使用的永磁体所必需的重稀土元素和轻稀土元素。施耐德电气表示，拟议的合作超出了项目支持的范围：它代表着迈向值得信赖的端到端关键矿产价值链的一步。
Torngat 计划在 Strange Lake 整合一座矿山、季节性通道和港口，以及一座年产 15,000 吨稀土的分离和加工厂（照片来源：Torngat Metals） 调整项目交付和未来需求 施耐德电气全球采矿、矿物和金属主管 Vivek Kapoor 表示，此类安排在战略意图上与早期承购关系类似。施耐德的同行通常会承担责任，同时激励两家公司实现项目 KPI。 “通过在如此早期阶段参与并探索未来工业需求如何支持该项目，我们对其长期成功进行了投资，”他上个月在伦敦举行的《金融时报》金属与矿业峰会间隙告诉 IM。 Torngat 计划将一座矿山、季节性通道和港口以及一座年产 15,000 吨稀土的分离和加工厂整合在一起。施耐德电气表示，它在支持这一国际化所需的四个领域拥有经验。

【原文 English Original】
Schneider Electric says it is bringing together electrification, automation and digital intelligence to help mines operate as AI-powered, software-defined platforms that connect energy and industrial intelligence. AI across three connected layers The company describes three layers through which it helps mining companies apply AI: Connected devices: Intelligent devices sense operating conditions and provide data and control capabilities; Edge control and computing: Simulation and automation use AI to support flexible, efficient and resilient system performance; and Apps, analytics and services: AI-driven insights support collaboration, informed action and enterprise value. Schneider Electric uses its portfolio of technologies to combine process and energy data from the device, edge and analytics layers with mining expertise and ecosystem integration. This supports digital twins throughout the mining operations lifecycle, from design and construction to operation and maintenance. Torngat Metals: an integrated rare earth partnership Torngat Metals is drawing on these expertise and integration capabilities as it develops the Strange Lake rare earth project in Canada. The companies have signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to explore a strategic industrial partnership supporting a resilient and responsible rare earth value chain. The proposed partnership centres on Strange Lake in Nunavik, associated infrastructure in Labrador and a planned separation facility in Sept-Îles. It would connect upstream resource development, technology integration and future industrial demand through an end-to-end collaboration. The MoU outlines a potential 360° partnership with two objectives: Support project development: Apply Schneider Electric’s expertise in electrification, automation, digital systems and sustainable industrial design to a next-generation mining and processing project; and Strengthen supply chain resilience: Improve Schneider Electric’s long-term access to a secure, responsible and compliant rare earth and magnet ecosystem for strategic applications. Strange Lake is expected to produce heavy and light rare earth elements essential to permanent magnets used in renewable energy, digital infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Schneider Electric says the proposed collaboration goes beyond project support: it represents a step towards a trusted, end-to-end critical minerals value chain.   Torngat plans to bring together a mine, seasonal access road and port, and a separation and processing plant capable of producing 15,000 t/y of rare earths at Strange Lake (photo credit: Torngat Metals) Aligning project delivery and future demand Vivek Kapoor, Schneider Electric’s Global Lead for Mining, Minerals & Metals, said arrangements of this kind are similar in strategic intent to an early-stage offtake relationship. He described them as going beyond what Schneider’s peers typically undertake, while giving both companies an incentive to deliver on project KPIs. “By engaging at such an early stage and exploring how future industrial demand could support the project, we are invested in its long-term success,” he told IM on the sidelines of the FT Metals & Mining Summit in London last month. Torngat plans to bring together a mine, seasonal access road and port, and a separation and processing plant capable of producing 15,000 t/y of rare earths. Schneider Electric says it has experience across the four areas needed to support that integrated approach: electrification, automation, digital systems and sustainable industrial design. Engineering and operational applications Connecting engineering and operations Through AVEVA engineering solutions, the CONNECT data services platform, AVEVA PI System and its advanced analytics ecosystem, Schneider Electric says it helps organisations unify operational technology, information technology and engineering technology data. This enables these organisations to apply AI-driven insights and put those insights into practice in near real time. AVEVA’s agentic AI capabilities, built into its unified engineering software solution, are already helping mining companies and engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) firms improve detailed engineering productivity, the company says. These capabilities automate repetitive tasks and comparisons, helping teams develop and optimise 3D models more efficiently. SQM: process optimisation At SQM’s operations, Kapoor says AI-powered predictive and optimisation models delivered: A 10-15% reduction in process variability; An increase in nitrate yield of up to 1%; and A 1-3% improvement in raw material efficiency. These improvements translate into higher productivity, less waste and improved sustainability. Roy Hill: a remotely connected pit-to-port operation Kapoor also highlighted Schneider Electric’s earlier work at the 55 Mt/y Roy Hill iron ore project in Western Australia. The company delivered remote operations and demand chain planning capabilities, integrating mine, plant, rail and port operations into a single remotely controlled ecosystem. These capabilities supported one of the industry’s most advanced greenfield deployments and helped optimise the journey from resource to market. “This really was a pit-to-port project for Roy HIll,” he said. For lead EPC provider Samsung C&T, Schneider Electric delivered the port facility’s complete power infrastructure, including 14 switch rooms, transformers, drives, backup power, cooling and power management systems. Image from the Roy Hill owner-operated mine and processing operations (credit: Roy Hill) Vale: centralised monitoring Schneider Electric and AVEVA, which Schneider Electric owns, have also worked with Vale in Brazil to integrate, centralise and remotely monitor operations across its Mariana and Itabira complexes. Schneider Electric says it is also applying hybrid advanced process control and AI to improve milling-circuit performance. In other industrial applications, these solutions have reduced furnace NOx emissions. Removing data silos and putting insights to work A shared data backbone Schneider Electric sees its ability to unify siloed operational data within a scalable, enterprise-ready architecture as a key market differentiator. That capability is also important to Torngat Metals’ integrated project approach. In traditional mining and processing environments, data from sensors, control systems and laboratories often sits in disconnected systems, limiting its usefulness, the company says. Schneider Electric says CONNECT provides a centralised data backbone on top of AVEVA PI System, enabling secure, near-real-time sharing between on-premises systems and cloud analytics platforms. At SQM, for example, operational data is made accessible in Databricks through Delta Sharing. This supports advanced AI, machine-learning and simulation workflows with near-real-time refresh cycles, according to Schneider Electric. “This architecture eliminates data silos and provides an open, developer-friendly environment for building and scaling AI solutions – an essential foundation for industrial transformation,” the company says. From recommendations to operational action Schneider Electric describes a “closed-loop approach” in which model outputs are fed back into operational systems, rather than remaining separate analytical insights. At SQM, predictive and optimisation models generate real-time recommendations for feed ratios, temperatures and flows. Schneider Electric says these outputs are written back into CONNECT and displayed in operator tools such as AVEVA PI Vision. Operators can then compare actual performance with AI-driven optimal conditions and act on the recommendations. Prescriptive setpoint optimisation similarly allows AI models to recommend and guide operational adjustments. In some cases, these adjustments can run automatically to support continuous performance improvement. “This integration transforms AI from a decision-support tool into an active driver of operational performance,” it says. Adapting AI models and scaling deployment Continuous model development Schneider Electric says its architecture supports rapid development and deployment of machine-learning models, hybrid simulation models and dynamic optimisation algorithms. In practice, this includes: Training and retraining machine-learning models using the large volumes of data held in AVEVA PI System, which is widely adopted at mining sites; Developing hybrid models that combine physics-based simulations with data-driven AI; and Running real-time scenario simulations to optimise production conditions. At SQM, Schneider Electric says predictive models achieved approximately 90% accuracy, increasing operator confidence and improving decision quality. Model retraining cycles were also significantly reduced, enabling faster adaptation to changing process conditions and continuous performance improvement. From individual use cases to enterprise-wide deployment Scalability is another key differentiator, according to Schneider Electric. The company says its architecture supports deployment across multiple plants, processes and business units, rather than being limited to individual use cases. At SQM, the success of nitrate optimisation has led to plans to expand into additional plants and incorporate richer datasets, including maintenance and laboratory analytics, the company claims. Schneider Electric presents this as an example of the progression from pilot projects to broader digital transformation. Looking ahead: an integrated mine-to-metal benchmark The MoU between Schneider Electric and Torngat Metals points towards a similarly integrated approach. Schneider Electric hopes the proposed mine-to-metal collaboration will establish a benchmark for digital transformation across Torngat’s operations. “By embedding sustainability, efficiency and digital performance across the project lifecycle, from design through operations, the partnership aims to set new standards for responsible resource development,” it says. title: 特朗普称下周或与习近平、普京在中国举行三方会谈
summary: 特朗普向记者表示，他将前往中国，并预计与习近平及普京会面。他说：“我将前往中国，而我认为其中一场会议将会是与普京总统及习近平主席举行，这将会很有意思。”他又表示，会谈将涉及多项议题，包括核裁军及结束伊朗战争。 中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，中方正与有关方面就三国元首会晤保持沟通。俄罗斯克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）证实，相关协调工作正在进行，希望未来数日内敲定安排。他说：“我们希望能在未来几天内敲定这件事。” 克里姆林宫早于10月21日已表示，三方会谈正在
content: 特朗普向记者表示，他将前往中国，并预计与习近平及普京会面。他说：“我将前往中国，而我认为其中一场会议将会是与普京总统及习近平主席举行，这将会很有意思。”他又表示，会谈将涉及多项议题，包括核裁军及结束伊朗战争。 中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，中方正与有关方面就三国元首会晤保持沟通。俄罗斯克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）证实，相关协调工作正在进行，希望未来数日内敲定安排。他说：“我们希望能在未来几天内敲定这件事。” 克里姆林宫早于10月21日已表示，三方会谈正在筹备。美国《华尔街日报》此前报道，普京希望透过会谈促成乌克兰和平协议，争取对莫斯科有利的安排。俄罗斯自2022年全面入侵乌克兰后，一直面对西方国家的外交孤立及制裁。 分析人士指出，普京可能是这场会谈的最大受益者。即使三方未能达成协议，只要普京能与特朗普及习近平同场亮相，已可向外界展示俄罗斯仍是国际重大外交事务的重要参与者，削弱西方孤立莫斯科的效果。 美国前总统奥巴马（Barack Obama）政府时期的国务院高级官员丹尼·罗素（Danny Russel）向Euronews表示，普京是最有可能从三方会谈中获益的领袖，即使三方未能达成协议，只要普京能与特朗普及习近平同场亮相，已可向外界展示俄罗斯仍是国际重大外交事务的重要参与者，削弱西方孤立莫斯科的效果。 俄罗斯方面也明显积极推动会面。他形容，这将是普京的一次“外交上的重大胜利”。 莫斯科政治分析人士亚历山大·布拉特斯基（Alexander Bratersky）接受半岛电视台访问时指出，三方会谈本身已足以让俄罗斯取得政治宣传成果。俄罗斯官员曾将这类会谈比作1945年的雅尔塔会议，暗示大国领袖可共同塑造战后国际秩序。布拉特斯基认为，普京与特朗普及习近平同坐谈判桌，有助塑造俄罗斯参与决定欧洲未来安全架构的形象。他说：“单是举行这场会议，本身就是一项成功。普京将能够在国内将此事作为成果宣传。” 特朗普方面则希望借会谈展示其处理国际重大问题的能力。伦敦城市圣乔治大学国际政治学教授因德吉特·帕马尔（Inderjeet Parmar）认为，特朗普希望透过与另外两个大国领袖直接接触，塑造自己是不可或缺的协议促成者，并展示美国仍掌握国际主导权，即使会谈实际内容有限。 中国的考量则有所不同。美国智库史汀生中心（Stimson Center）中国项目主任孙韵指出，北京希望取得会谈带来的外交形象效益，却不愿承担额外成本。她说：“中国想要的是形象，而不是成本。” 特朗普预计这次访华将是他今年第三次与习近平会面。美中两国目前维持脆弱的贸易休战安排，协议预计于明年1月届满。中国今年主办APEC领导人非正式会议，成员包括美国及俄罗斯。 分析人士也关注，三方会谈可能令美国的欧洲及亚洲盟友被边缘化。帕马尔指出，二战后美国通常会先与盟友协调，再与俄罗斯或中国处理重大外交议题，若三国领袖绕过盟友直接讨论国际安全及经济安排，将反映美国外交模式出现转变。他说：“一场独立进行的三方会谈，可能将这些盟友视为次要角色，仿佛他们的利益可以在事后才处理。” 美国智库民主防卫基金会（Foundation for Defense of Democracies）中国项目高级主任克雷格·辛格尔顿（Craig Singleton）则认为，会谈可能最终只是一场让普京与美中领袖同框的拍照活动。他指出：“场面可能具有历史意义，却未必能产生任何特别重大的实际成果。”

title: Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps
zh_title: 美国海军陆战队生日总统致辞
summary: 总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。带着荣誉、勇气和坚定不移
content:
总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。凭借荣誉、勇气和对维护和推进美国利益的坚定承诺，海军陆战队一再证明，无论困难如何，他们都会响应每一个召唤并完成任何任务。在海军陆战队庆祝保护美国并击败敌人 251 周年之际，我向每一位为我们的国家战斗和牺牲的海军陆战队员致以最深切的谢意，并向他们无与伦比的英勇遗产致敬。从我们共和国诞生之日起，海军陆战队就一直捍卫美国赖以建立的自由和自由的支柱。独立战争期间，海军陆战队出海夺取拿骚港，为大陆军提供大量军需物资增援。在整个第二次世界大战期间，海军陆战队在整个太平洋战区发挥了关键作用，对于美国在关岛、瓜达尔卡纳尔岛、冲绳岛和硫磺岛的胜利至关重要。
这些令人难以置信的“魔鬼犬”在美国历史上无数次冲突的前线服役，从未失败过保护我们国内外的公民，并在我们的对手面前无所畏惧地展示了美国的威力和力量。今天，通过我们勇敢的海军陆战队的英勇无私的服务，美国变得更加安全。美国海军陆战队的爱国男女不断提醒人们美国伟大和荣耀的真正源泉。作为总统，我是我国历史上最强有力的海军陆战队倡导者。通过超级情报的进步以及对导弹防御、下一代能力和造船的投资，我们正在为我们的海军陆战队提供击败美国敌人所需的一切资源，无论他们身在何处。在我的领导下，我们的海军陆战队员也回到家乡，得到他们应得的关怀和支持。我的政府恢复了退伍军人事务部的常识，使退伍军人能够寻求自己选择的医疗保健提供者，降低退伍军人及其家人的费用，并减少有害的积压。作为总司令，我将永远不会停止为我们的海军陆战队挺身而出，维护他们作为世界上最致命的战斗力量的声誉。在座右铭“Semper Fidelis”（意为“永远忠诚”）的指引下，美国海军陆战队在我们国家和全人类的历史上留下了自己的印记。
我们海军陆战队的坚定力量证明了美国精神的力量和美国武装部队的力量。一代又一代，海军陆战队忠实地充当了美国的捍卫者，他们将在未来的几个世纪里继续作为自由的忠实捍卫者。永远Fi！关于美国海军陆战队生日的总统致辞首先出现在白宫。

【原文 English Original】
Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps Search Select Category All News Briefings & Statements All Presidential Actions Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research All Briefings & Statements Presidential Actions All Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research For over two and a half centuries, the United States Marine Corps has stood as a living embodiment of the American Spirit.  With honor, courage, and unwavering commitment to preserving and advancing the interests of the United States, Marines have proven time and again that they will answer every call and complete any mission no matter the odds.  As the Marine Corps celebrates 251 years of protecting America and defeating her enemies, I extend my deepest gratitude to every Marine who has fought and sacrificed for our Nation and pay tribute to their unmatched legacy of valor. From the dawn of our Republic, Marines have defended the pillars of freedom and liberty that America was founded upon.  During the Revolutionary War, Marines took to the sea to seize the port of Nassau and reinforce the Continental Army with large quantities of military supplies.  Throughout World War II, Marines played a critical role across the Pacific Theater and were essential to American victories at Guam, Guadalcanal, Okinawa, and Iwo Jima.  These incredible Devil Dogs have served on the front lines of countless conflicts throughout American history, never failed to protect our citizens at home and abroad, and fearlessly demonstrated American might and power in the face of our adversaries.  Today, America is made safer through the heroic and selfless service of our brave Marines. The patriotic men and women of the United States Marine Corps are enduring reminders of the true source of American greatness and glory.  As President, I have been the strongest advocate for our Marines in the history of our country.  Through advancements in Super Intelligence and investments in missile defense, next-generation capabilities, and shipbuilding, we are providing our Marines with every resource they need to defeat America’s enemies wherever they may be. Under my leadership, our Marines also return home to the care and support they have so rightly earned.  My Administration has restored common sense at the Department of Veterans Affairs, empowering veterans to seek the healthcare providers of their choice, lowering costs for veterans and their families, and slashing harmful backlogs.  As Commander in Chief, I will never stop standing up for our Marines and upholding their reputation as the most lethal fighting force the world has ever seen. Guided by their motto, Semper Fidelis, meaning “Always Faithful,” the United States Marines have left their mark on the history of our Nation and all of mankind.  The steadfast strength of our Marines is a testament to the power of the American Spirit and the might of the United States Armed Forces.  Generation after generation, Marines have faithfully served as champions of America, and they will carry on as faithful defenders of liberty for centuries to come.  Semper Fi! title: US postpones ‘million-dollar’ China ship tax until January
zh_title: 美国将“百万美元”的中国船舶税推迟至一月

content:
根据周二在《联邦公报》上发布的通知，美国已将针对与中国相关的航运的暂停征收港口费的期限再延长两个月，并将该措施搁置至 2027 年 1 月 9 日。这一决定使华盛顿和北京有更多时间就影响海事、物流和造船业的中国政策进行谈判。美国贸易代表办公室表示，延期于 11 月 9 日生效，一直持续到晚上 11 点 59 分。东部时间 1 月 9 日。根据唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平宣布的贸易协议，自 2025 年 11 月 10 日开始暂停一年。暂停还继续涵盖该机构先前行动中指定的对中国船岸起重机和其他货物装卸设备的额外关税。

title: Topco Scientific Establishes Dresden Hub, Makes SEMICON Europa Debut
zh_title: Topco Scientific 建立德累斯顿中心，SEMICON Europa 首次亮相
summary: 在《欧洲芯片法案》和半导体本土化制造趋势的推动下，欧洲对材料、设备和技术服务的需求日益受到关注。半导体产业综合服务商拓普科科技股份有限公司（TAIEX：5434）宣布，其德国子公司拓普科德国有限公司（TOPCO GERMANY）将首次参加11月10日至13日在德国慕尼黑展览中心举行的SEMICON Europa 2026，与台湾、日本的供应商合作伙伴一起展示其跨界合作。
content:
在《欧洲芯片法案》和半导体本土化制造趋势的推动下，欧洲对材料、设备和技术服务的需求日益受到关注。半导体产业综合服务商拓普科科技股份有限公司（TAIEX：5434）宣布，其德国子公司拓普科德国有限公司（TOPCO GERMANY）将首次参加11月10日至13日在德国慕尼黑展览中心举行的SEMICON Europa 2026，与台湾、日本供应商合作伙伴展示其跨境资源一体化和本地化服务能力。拓普科德国于2026年8月正式成立，将亮相台湾馆，展示涵盖工艺材料、特种化学品、扩散工艺清洗设备、关键零部件的一站式解决方案。这些解决方案旨在支持欧洲代工厂和汽车电子制造商的晶圆厂建设和生产需求。作为欧洲最大的半导体集群之一，德累斯顿是博世、英飞凌、恩智浦和格罗方德等主要半导体公司的所在地。随着世界领先的铸造厂在德国落户，TOPCO SCIENTIFIC 正在加速向欧洲市场的扩张。
该公司利用德累斯顿当地团队提供及时的材料供应和技术支持，将来自台湾、日本和其他市场的领先材料、设备和耗材供应商与欧洲客户联系起来。这种集成服务模式可帮助客户在半导体工厂不断扩张的情况下减轻供应链中断风险，并降低资质和入厂成本。对于关键的前端工艺材料，拓普科将在展会上展示日本供应商SHIN-ETSU POLYMER的12英寸晶圆载具解决方案，满足欧洲12英寸代工厂和集成器件制造商（IDM）严格的清洁度和自动化要求。其前开式统一盒 (FOUP) 具有抗静电保护和一体式结构，有助于缩短清洁和干燥周期，同时有效减少颗粒的产生。该公司还将展示符合 SEMI 标准的前开式运输箱 (FOSB)，并具有坚固的密封结构，可在长途国际运输过程中保护晶圆。为了满足先进半导体工艺的微缩要求，拓普科引进日本先进的前驱体材料，为高端薄膜沉积工艺提供全面的解决方案，包括化学气相沉积（CVD）和物理气相沉积（PVD）。
这些材料具有超高纯度和出色的热稳定性，有助于提高器件性能和产量，支持可靠的先进半导体制造。对于蚀刻和薄膜沉积工艺，TOPCO SCIENTIFIC 将展示使用 TAIWAN E&M SYSTEMS 的定制精密加工能力制造的关键组件。这些组件由石英、硅、陶瓷和碳化硅 (SiC) 制成，与主要半导体设备平台兼容。结合专门的抗等离子和耐磨涂层技术，它们有助于延长设备耗材的使用寿命，使客户能够提高产量，同时支持更可持续的制造。

【原文 English Original】
Driven by the European Chips Act and the trend toward localized semiconductor manufacturing, demand for materials, equipment, and technical services in Europe has attracted growing attention. TOPCO SCIENTIFIC Co., Ltd. (TAIEX: 5434), an integrated services provider for the semiconductor industry, announced that its German subsidiary, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC Germany GmbH (TOPCO GERMANY), will participate for the first time in SEMICON Europa 2026, to be held at Messe München in Germany from November 10 to 13. Together with supplier partners from Taiwan and Japan, the company will showcase its cross-border resource integration and localized service capabilities. Officially established in August 2026, TOPCO GERMANY will exhibit at the Taiwan Pavilion, presenting one-stop solutions covering process materials, specialty chemicals, diffusion process cleaning equipment, and critical components. These solutions are designed to support the fab construction and production needs of European foundries and automotive electronics manufacturers. As one of Europe’s largest semiconductor clusters, Dresden is home to major semiconductor companies, including Bosch, Infineon, NXP, and GlobalFoundries. With the world’s leading foundry establishing a presence in Germany, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC is accelerating its expansion into the European market. Leveraging its local team in Dresden to provide timely materials supply and technical support, the company connects leading materials, equipment, and consumables suppliers from Taiwan, Japan, and other markets with European customers. This integrated service model helps customers mitigate supply chain disruption risks and reduce qualification and onboarding costs amid the ongoing expansion of semiconductor fabs. For critical front-end process materials, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC will showcase 12-inch wafer carrier solutions from Japanese supplier SHIN-ETSU POLYMER at the exhibition, addressing the stringent cleanliness and automation requirements of European 12-inch foundries and integrated device manufacturers (IDMs). Its Front Opening Unified Pod (FOUP), featuring antistatic protection and an integrated, one-piece construction, helps shorten cleaning and drying cycles while effectively minimizing particle generation. The company will also showcase Front Opening Shipping Box (FOSB) that comply with SEMI standards and feature robust sealing structures to protect wafers during long-distance international transportation. To address the scaling requirements of advanced semiconductor processes, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC introduces advanced precursor materials from Japan, offering comprehensive solutions for high-end thin-film deposition processes, including chemical vapor deposition (CVD) and physical vapor deposition (PVD). Featuring ultra-high purity and excellent thermal stability, these materials help enhance device performance and yield, supporting reliable advanced semiconductor manufacturing. For etching and thin-film deposition processes, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC will showcase critical components manufactured using customized precision machining capabilities from TAIWAN E&M SYSTEMS . These components, made from quartz, silicon, ceramics, and silicon carbide (SiC), are compatible with major semiconductor equipment platforms. Combined with specialized plasma-resistant and wear-resistant coating technologies, they help extend the service life of equipment consumables, enabling customers to improve yield while supporting more sustainable manufacturing. For semiconductor facility engineering and equipment maintenance, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC also offers solutions for the maintenance and servicing of critical equipment and precision components. In the diffusion process segment, the company introduces quartz cleaning equipment from Japanese supplier FIRST EXA to improve the cleanliness of quartz components. Using automated acid cleaning and nitrogen purging technologies, the equipment effectively removes residues from high-temperature deposition processes, reduces particle contamination, and extends the service life of quartz consumables, helping safeguard wafer yield. Charles Lee, President of TOPCO SCIENTIFIC, said, “The regionalization and localization of global semiconductor supply chains have become an irreversible trend. TOPCO SCIENTIFIC established its German subsidiary in August 2026, positioning Dresden as its European operational and technical service hub. This move not only strengthens our presence in Europe but also establishes an important strategic hub for global supply chain integration. Building on more than 35 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, we connect suppliers from Taiwan and Japan with local European customers, providing timely technical support and integrated services. Going forward, we will further strengthen strategic cooperation with leading European suppliers to build an international supply chain platform connecting Asia and Europe and serving customers worldwide, thereby enhancing global supply chain resilience.” The post Topco Scientific Establishes Dresden Hub, Makes SEMICON Europa Debut appeared first on Semiconductor Digest .

title: Ye olde server consolidation has made Cisco push top-of-rack switching to 100G
